66317.recognize_zh: 低倍下抹片中充滿大小相近、核圓至略凹、染色質細緻、細胞質中等量灰藍色的大型芽細胞，部分成群聚集，成熟單核球與中性球極少，型態符合急性單核球性白血病的單核母細胞（monoblast）增生。
features: Numerous large blasts dominating the nucleated cells, occurring singly and in loose clusters
Round to slightly indented or folded nuclei with fine chromatin; nucleoli faintly visible
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm, without obvious granules or Auer rods at this magnification
Occasional small lymphocytes and a rare neutrophil; few maturing myeloid cells
Low magnification limits evaluation of nucleoli, fine granules and cytoplasmic vacuoles
66317.describe_en: Smear (likely peripheral blood) at low power shows a marked increase in large blasts, which constitute the majority of nucleated cells. The blasts are relatively uniform, with round to slightly folded nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate amounts of grey-blue agranular cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen at this magnification. Maturing granulocytes are rare, with only occasional small lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry, flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b) and KMT2A rearrangement studies confirm the subtype.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are smaller with scant cytoplasm and higher N:C ratio, and are MPO/NSE negative with TdT and B- or T-lineage markers.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation or without maturation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have scant cytoplasm with occasional granules or Auer rods and lack monocytic markers such as CD14, CD64 and NSE positivity.
Microgranular APL shows bilobed or folded nuclei with fine granules, strong MPO, is HLA-DR/CD34 negative and carries PML::RARA.
Reactive monocytes are mature with condensed folded nuclei and vacuolated cytoplasm, without sheets of blasts with fine chromatin.

exam.answer_en: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation (acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia) — sheets of large blasts with folded nuclei and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍看整片大型芽細胞，問「急性白血病哪一系」；線索是豐富灰藍胞質與摺疊核，答 monocytic lineage。
細胞化學：nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate）陽性且 NaF 抑制；MPO 常弱或陰性。
Flow：CD14、CD64、CD11b、CD4 dim、CD36、lysozyme；CD34 常陰性。
遺傳關聯：KMT2A rearrangement（如 t(9;11) KMT2A::MLLT3）、NPM1 mutation，t(8;16) KAT6A::CREBBP 伴 erythrophagocytosis。
臨床：牙齦增生、leukemia cutis、CNS 侵犯；高白血球時注意 leukostasis、DIC 與 tumor lysis syndrome。
exam.pitfall_zh: 低倍下易誤判為 ALL；lymphoblast 細胞小、胞質少、核質比高且 NSE/MPO 陰性，monoblast 胞質豐富灰藍、核可摺疊。

quiz.q: 此抹片的芽細胞屬哪一系？用哪種細胞化學染色支持此判讀？
quiz.a: Monocytic（monoblast/promonocyte）；nonspecific esterase，NaF 可抑制。

66061.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一大團彼此融合、邊界不清的合胞體樣細胞團，內含約二十多個橢圓形、染色質均勻深染的細胞核，細胞質豐富深藍紫色；周圍是血液、脂肪空泡與零星小型造血細胞，這種黏聚性的外來細胞團提示轉移性癌。
features: Large cohesive syncytial aggregate of non-hematopoietic cells with indistinct cell borders
About two dozen oval to round nuclei with evenly dense chromatin, smooth contours and mild crowding/overlap
Abundant, deeply basophilic to violet cytoplasm forming a continuous sheet with an irregular outline
Background of red cells, fat vacuoles and sparse small hematopoietic cells (lymphocytes/erythroid precursors)
A second, smaller cytoplasmic fragment at lower right; nucleoli and mucin vacuoles not clearly resolved at this magnification
66061.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cohesive syncytial aggregate of atypical cells with oval, crowded nuclei, evenly dense chromatin and abundant basophilic cytoplasm, set in a background of blood, fat vacuoles and sparse hematopoietic cells. The cluster is clearly foreign to normal marrow elements. Fine nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma infiltrating the marrow, correlating with poorly differentiated mucin-producing adenocarcinoma on biopsy and the clinical picture of myelophthisis.

ddx.vs: An osteoclast is a single giant cell with many uniform, well-separated round nuclei with nucleoli and granular pink-purple cytoplasm, whereas here nuclei overlap and are crowded in a basophilic syncytium.
Megakaryocytes have one large multilobated nucleus with granular pink cytoplasm and budding platelets, not multiple discrete oval nuclei.
Osteoblasts show eccentric nuclei with a pale Golgi zone separated from the nucleus and form loose comet-like groups rather than a tight syncytium.
Stromal fragments contain elongated spindle nuclei within a fibrillary pink matrix rather than oval epithelioid nuclei in dense basophilic cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic carcinoma in bone marrow aspirate — large cohesive syncytial aggregate of crowded oval nuclei with abundant basophilic cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：指一大團多核結構問「osteoclast 還是轉移癌」；關鍵看核是否重疊擁擠（轉移癌）或均勻分散在同一細胞內（osteoclast）。
轉移癌細胞團常位於抹片尾端（feathered edge）與邊緣，低倍掃描邊緣是實務與考試技巧。
IHC：cytokeratin+、CD45−；黏液性腺癌可做 mucicarmine/PAS-D；原發部位推斷依 CK7/CK20 與器官特異標記。
Myelophthisis 常伴 leukoerythroblastosis 與骨髓纖維化，aspirate 可能 dry tap，trephine biopsy 敏感度較高。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 osteoclast；osteoclast 為單一巨細胞，核圓、大小一致、分散不重疊並有核仁，胞質粉紫色顆粒狀，轉移癌核擁擠重疊於深藍胞質中。

quiz.q: 此多核細胞團與 osteoclast 最關鍵的形態差異為何？
quiz.a: 轉移癌核擁擠重疊、多個細胞融合成合胞體且胞質深藍；osteoclast 核均勻分散不重疊、胞質粉紫顆粒狀。

66125.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一大團緊密黏聚的小圓藍細胞，核深染、彼此擠壓成形（nuclear molding）、胞質極少，細胞間夾雜粉紅色纖維狀物質（神經纖維網，neuropil），部分細胞圍繞其排列成玫瑰花樣，大小明顯異於周邊造血細胞，符合轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Large cohesive syncytial cluster of small-to-medium round tumor cells, distinct from dispersed hematopoietic cells
Hyperchromatic round-to-oval nuclei with nuclear molding and very high N:C ratio
Scant, wispy pale-blue cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Pink-violet fibrillary neuropil-like material within the cluster, with surrounding cells arranged in a rosette-like pattern
Background normal hematopoietic elements (segmented neutrophil, lymphocytes, erythroid precursors) and red cells
66125.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cohesive cluster of non-hematopoietic small round blue cells with hyperchromatic nuclei, prominent nuclear molding, scant cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders. Pink fibrillary neuropil-like material is present within the cluster, around which tumor cells are arranged in a Homer-Wright rosette-like pattern, although the rosette is not sharply delineated in this field. Normal hematopoietic elements are present in the background. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by metastatic neuroblastoma; confirmation with immunohistochemistry (PHOX2B, synaptophysin) on the core biopsy and urine catecholamines is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are discohesive, lack nuclear molding and neuropil, and are CD45/TdT-positive rather than PHOX2B/synaptophysin-positive.
Ewing sarcoma cells form clusters with PAS-positive cytoplasmic glycogen vacuoles but lack fibrillary neuropil, and are CD99/NKX2.2-positive with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Rhabdomyosarcoma may show clusters and multinucleated cells with vacuolated cytoplasm but no neuropil, and expresses desmin/myogenin.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocyte clusters or bone marrow stromal fragments
ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are large with abundant granular cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei, and stromal fragments contain fat and vessels rather than molded small blue cells.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic neuroblastoma in bone marrow — cohesive small round blue cells with nuclear molding around fibrillary neuropil (Homer-Wright rosette)
pearls_zh: 考法：指中央粉紅纖維狀物質問「這是什麼構造？」答 neuropil，周圍腫瘤細胞排列成 Homer-Wright rosette（中央無真正管腔）。
IHC：PHOX2B、synaptophysin、chromogranin、CD56 陽性；CD45、CD99、TdT 陰性。Flow 可見 CD45−/CD56+/GD2+ 族群。
臨床關聯：尿液 catecholamine 代謝物（VMA、HVA）上升；MIBG 掃描評估轉移。
預後關鍵：MYCN amplification 為高風險指標；骨髓侵犯屬遠端轉移，需雙側骨髓切片分期。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被誤認為 ALL 芽細胞團；ALL 細胞為分散單顆、無 nuclear molding 與 neuropil，且 CD45/TdT 陽性，而神經母細胞瘤為黏聚成團並有纖維狀 neuropil。

quiz.q: 圖中腫瘤細胞中央的粉紅色纖維狀物質稱為什麼？這種排列稱為哪種 rosette？
quiz.a: Neuropil；Homer-Wright rosette。

65805.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的造血細胞顆粒中有數條細長、蜷曲呈 S 形或環形的蠕蟲狀構造，體內可見排列成柱狀的細小深染核（nuclear column），尾端逐漸變尖，這是微絲蚴（microfilaria）的特徵。
features: Several elongated, thread-like, coiled and S-shaped organisms within a marrow particle
Organism length many times the diameter of surrounding hematopoietic cells, with a uniform narrow width
Internal column of small, densely packed basophilic nuclei along the body
Tapered tail; a faint pale outline possibly representing a sheath, not definitively resolved
Background of cellular marrow with mixed hematopoietic cells and scattered red cells
65805.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle containing several elongated, coiled, worm-like organisms many times longer than the surrounding hematopoietic cells. The organisms have a uniform narrow width, a tapered tail and an internal column of small basophilic nuclei, consistent with microfilariae. A sheath is not clearly resolved, and species identification (such as Wuchereria bancrofti, Brugia malayi or Loa loa) requires assessment of the sheath and tail nuclei on thick peripheral blood films. The surrounding hematopoietic elements show no specific associated abnormality in this field.

ddx.vs: Fibers and fibrin lack an internal column of nuclei and a defined tapering tail.
Strongyloides rhabditiform larvae are found in stool or sputum, are larger, and have a visible esophagus and genital primordium.
Trypanosomes are much shorter, lie between red cells, and have an undulating membrane, flagellum and kinetoplast.

ddx.dx: Crushed megakaryocyte cytoplasm or elongated stromal cells
ddx.vs: Stromal cells have a single oval nucleus rather than a chain of nuclei along a worm-shaped body.

exam.answer_en: Microfilariae in bone marrow aspirate — coiled thread-like larvae with an internal column of nuclei and tapered tail
pearls_zh: 考法：骨髓抹片中意外發現蜷曲的線狀蟲體，考官問「是什麼、怎麼分種」：微絲蚴；分種不能靠骨髓抹片，需回頭做厚血片看鞘與尾端核。
採血時機依週期性：W. bancrofti、Brugia 夜間週期（約 22:00–02:00）；Loa loa 日間週期；骨髓中偶然發現可見於流行區或移民、旅遊者。
常見伴隨表現為嗜伊紅性球增多，但無症狀微絲蚴血症也可能嗜伊紅性球正常；淋巴絲蟲慢性期可致淋巴水腫、陰囊水腫與乳糜尿。
治療前需確認是否合併 Loa loa 或 Onchocerca：高 Loa loa 負荷下使用 DEC 可能誘發腦病變，onchocerciasis 使用 DEC 可能加重眼部病變。
exam.pitfall_zh: 骨髓中易誤認為纖維、fibrin 或拉長的基質細胞：假影沒有沿蟲體排列的核柱與逐漸變細的尾端；基質細胞只有單一卵圓核，不會形成等寬長條蟲體。

quiz.q: 骨髓抹片中這些蜷曲、內含一列細核的線狀構造是什麼？要確定種別應改做什麼檢查？
quiz.a: Microfilariae；依週期時間採血做 Giemsa 厚血片（看鞘與尾端核）或濃縮法/抗原檢測

64333.recognize_zh: 流式散佈圖中，淋巴球閘門內橘色的 CD19+ B 細胞群 CD20 亮陽性，輕鏈只表現 lambda（lambda restriction），同時 CD5 陽性、CD43 弱至中度陽性（藍色 T 細胞為 CD5/CD43 強陽性作對照），表示單株性 CD5+ B 細胞，符合被套細胞淋巴瘤的免疫表型。
features: CD45 vs SSC: gated lymphocytes (orange) are CD45 bright with low side scatter
CD19 vs CD20: orange B-cell population is CD19 positive with bright CD20
Kappa vs lambda: orange B cells express lambda only (lambda light chain restriction), with no kappa-positive population
CD5 vs CD43: orange B cells are CD5 positive (slightly dimmer than T cells) with dim to moderate CD43
Blue background T cells serve as internal control, bright for CD5 and CD43
64333.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of viable events shows an expanded lymphoid population (orange) with bright CD45 and low side scatter. These cells are CD19 positive and CD20 bright, show surface lambda light chain restriction, and co-express CD5 and CD43 at a lower intensity than the background T cells (blue). The findings indicate a clonal CD5-positive, CD43-positive mature B-cell neoplasm. Together with CD10 negativity, CD23 and CD200 negativity, the phenotype is consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by cyclin D1/SOX11 immunostaining or t(11;14) CCND1 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: CLL is also CD5+ CD43+ but shows dim CD20, dim surface light chain, and CD23 and CD200 positivity, whereas this population is CD20 bright.
MZL is usually CD5 negative; the CD5-positive subset requires cyclin D1 and CCND1 testing to exclude MCL.
CD5+ DLBCL has large cells with high forward scatter and is cyclin D1 negative.
B-PLL shows prominent nucleolated prolymphocytes and bright CD20, and cases with t(11;14) are reclassified as MCL.

65613.recognize_zh: 一顆核呈折疊腎形、細胞質灰藍的單核球，胞質中有數顆明顯大於正常嗜天青顆粒、邊界清楚的深紫色圓形顆粒，即假性 Chédiak-Higashi 顆粒（pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules），常見於 AML、MDS 等骨髓腫瘤。
features: Mature-appearing monocyte with indented/folded nucleus and lacy, moderately condensed chromatin
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with irregular outline
Several discrete, round, dark purple cytoplasmic granules much larger than normal azurophilic granules
No Auer rods or vacuolation
Background red cells with numerous echinocytes/crenated cells and a few poikilocytes
65613.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a monocyte with a folded nucleus, lacy chromatin and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm containing several discrete, large, round dark purple granules that are considerably larger than normal azurophilic granules. No Auer rods are identified. Background red cells show crenation with echinocytes, likely partly artifactual. Findings are consistent with pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules, which are acquired giant granules seen in myeloid neoplasms such as AML and MDS and should prompt further evaluation.

ddx.vs: Inherited giant granules involve all granulated leukocytes (neutrophils, eosinophils, lymphocytes) in a child with oculocutaneous albinism and immunodeficiency, not isolated cells in an adult myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed material or intracellular organisms (e.g., Histoplasma, Ehrlichia morula)
ddx.vs: Organisms show a halo or internal structure (yeast with capsule, stippled morula) whereas pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules are homogeneous dense granules.
Alder-Reilly granules are diffuse, fine-to-coarse dark granules throughout the cytoplasm of many leukocytes in mucopolysaccharidoses rather than a few discrete giant granules.
Toxic granules are numerous, small and evenly distributed in neutrophils during infection rather than a few large globules.

65421.recognize_zh: 拼圖中的異常前骨髓球細胞質內，可見多條細長桿狀的 Auer rod 交錯成束，像一捆柴（faggot cell）；細胞質充滿粗大的紫紅色嗜苯胺藍顆粒，核常呈不規則或雙葉狀。成束 Auer rod 加上粗顆粒，是高顆粒型 APL（M3）的典型表現，應立即安排 PML::RARA 檢測。
features: Large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse purple-red azurophilic granules
Multiple Auer rods arranged in crossing bundles or stacks (faggot cells)
Nuclei round to irregular or reniform, sometimes obscured by granules, with a visible nucleolus in some cells
Cytoplasmic granules extend to the cell border with some granule spillage
Background dominated by abnormal promyelocytes with few normal maturing cells
65421.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear, composite of high-power fields, shows sheets of abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely filled with coarse azurophilic granules and round to irregular nuclei. Several cells contain multiple Auer rods arranged in bundles, forming characteristic faggot cells. Normal maturing myeloid and erythroid elements are sparse. Findings are consistent with hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and coagulation assessment for DIC are recommended.

ddx.vs: t(8;21) AML shows single long slender Auer rods, perinuclear hof and salmon-colored granules, not bundles of rods in hypergranular promyelocytes.
Reactive promyelocytes have a perinuclear Golgi hof, orderly maturation and never contain Auer rods.
M3v shows bilobed nuclei with sparse or dust-like granules and few Auer rods, whereas this is the hypergranular form with obvious faggot bundles.

ddx.dx: APL-like AML with RARA variant partners (e.g., ZBTB16::RARA)
ddx.vs: Variant RARA translocations can look similar, with ZBTB16 cases showing regular nuclei and fewer Auer rods, so molecular testing is required and ATRA response differs.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular) — abnormal promyelocytes with faggot cells (bundles of Auer rods)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指含成束交錯 Auer rod 的細胞問名稱（faggot cell）與診斷，接著追問必做遺傳檢查：t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2) PML::RARA。
流式典型表型：CD33 均質強陽、CD117+、CD13 異質，CD34−、HLA-DR−、CD11b−；細胞化學 MPO 強陽性。
急症：APL 合併 DIC／纖溶亢進，早期出血死亡是主要風險；形態懷疑即應立即給 ATRA，不等基因報告，並積極補充血小板與 fibrinogen。
治療：低中風險以 ATRA＋arsenic trioxide（ATO）為標準；注意 differentiation syndrome 與 ATO 相關 QTc 延長。
分類：WHO 5th 的 APL with PML::RARA 不設 blast 比例門檻；ICC 2022 則要求 blasts ≥10%。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 t(8;21) AML 的單根細長 Auer rod 或 G-CSF 後反應性前骨髓球混淆；成束 Auer rod、無 Golgi 淡染區與 CD34−/HLA-DR− 支持 APL。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞質內含成束交錯桿狀物的細胞叫什麼？最關鍵的確認檢查為何？
quiz.a: Faggot cell；PML::RARA（t(15;17)）FISH 或 RT-PCR

65485.recognize_zh: 多顆大型單核樣細胞聚在一起，核有摺痕或凹陷、染色質細緻如花邊（lacy），部分可見淡色核仁；細胞質量中等、灰藍色，偶有細小空泡，沒有明顯粗顆粒或 Auer rod。這些核摺、細緻染色質的細胞是前單核球（promonocyte），在 AML 中算作芽細胞等同物。
features: Large cells with moderate to abundant grey-blue cytoplasm
Nuclei round to oval with delicate folds, grooves or indentations
Finely dispersed lacy chromatin; small nucleoli visible in some cells
Occasional fine cytoplasmic vacuoles; no coarse granules or Auer rods seen
Cells cluster together; background red cells show stacking and a few crenated forms
65485.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous large circulating cells with moderate grey-blue cytoplasm and round to folded nuclei containing finely dispersed lacy chromatin and occasional small nucleoli. Fine cytoplasmic vacuoles are occasionally seen, while coarse granules and Auer rods are not identified. The nuclear folding with immature chromatin identifies these cells as promonocytes, which count as blast equivalents. Findings are consistent with acute monocytic leukemia; confirmation with non-specific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b, CD4) is recommended.

ddx.vs: CMML shows mature monocytes with clumped chromatin and <20% blasts plus promonocytes, whereas these cells have fine lacy chromatin and dominate the smear.
Reactive monocytes have condensed chromatin, abundant vacuolated cytoplasm and no nucleoli.
M3v cells have bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei and are strongly MPO positive, CD34/HLA-DR negative, and may show occasional Auer rods, while monocytic cells are NSE positive.

ddx.dx: Blastoid mantle cell lymphoma or other large lymphoid cells
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells have higher N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm and express B-cell markers rather than monocytic antigens.

exam.answer_en: Acute monocytic leukemia — circulating promonocytes with folded nuclei, fine lacy chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指核有摺痕、染色質細緻的細胞問「monoblast、promonocyte 還是 mature monocyte？」promonocyte 屬 blast equivalent，要計入 blast%。
細胞化學：NSE（α-naphthyl butyrate esterase）陽性且可被 NaF 抑制；MPO 多為弱陽或陰性。
流式：CD14、CD64、CD11b、CD4、CD36 等單核球標記；monoblast 常 CD34 陰性，不能因 CD34− 就排除 AML。
臨床：單核球性 AML 常見齒齦增生、leukemia cutis、CNS 侵犯與高白血球，並與 KMT2A 重組（如 t(9;11)）相關。
分類：acute monocytic leukemia 要求單核球系 ≥80%；若嗜中性球系 ≥20% 則歸為 acute myelomonocytic leukemia。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被當成 CMML 或反應性單核球增多；promonocyte 染色質細緻、可見核仁並計入 blast，成熟單核球染色質粗塊、不計入。

quiz.q: 圖中核有摺痕、染色質細緻的細胞在 blast 計數時如何處理？
quiz.a: 屬 promonocyte，視為 blast equivalent 計入 blast%

65229.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中多顆組織球細胞質內塞滿許多 2–4 µm 的小圓形酵母，每顆周圍有透明暈圈（假莢膜）並可見偏位的月牙形小核，部分游離於細胞外；組織球內大量均一小酵母，符合莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）感染。
features: Histiocytes distended by numerous small, uniform, round to oval yeast forms (about 2-4 um)
Each yeast with a clear halo (pseudocapsule) around a small, dot-like or crescentic basophilic nucleus
Clusters of yeasts within cytoplasmic vacuoles and occasional extracellular organisms
Mixed background of hematopoietic cells, plasma cells and interstitial histiocytes
Large fat spaces at the edges of the field; H&E stain
65229.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows an interstitial histiocytic infiltrate among residual hematopoietic cells and fat. Many histiocytes contain clusters of small, uniform, round to oval yeast forms measuring approximately 2-4 um, each with a clear halo and a small crescentic nucleus, and occasional organisms appear extracellular. Well-formed granulomas and necrosis are not evident in this field. The findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis, and confirmation with GMS/PAS stains, culture or urine antigen is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have both a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast, lack a clear halo, and are GMS/PAS-negative, whereas Histoplasma is GMS-positive with narrow-based budding.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and include elongated sausage forms, unlike budding Histoplasma.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable (4-10 um) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic without halos and Pneumocystis cysts are extracellular cup-shaped forms, neither filling histiocytes with haloed yeasts.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis in bone marrow biopsy — histiocytes stuffed with small uniform 2–4 µm yeasts with clear halos
pearls_zh: 考法：指組織球內帶透明暈圈的小顆粒問病原；答 Histoplasma capsulatum，並說明 H&E 需以 GMS/PAS 確認（可見窄基出芽）。
骨髓侵犯代表播散性感染，多見於 HIV、移植、TNF 抑制劑等免疫低下者；表現為發燒、pancytopenia、肝脾腫大，可繼發 HLH。
快速診斷：urine/serum Histoplasma antigen 敏感度高，另有培養；免疫低下者骨髓常無明顯肉芽腫。中重度播散型先用 liposomal amphotericin B，再改 itraconazole。
台灣與東南亞 HIV 病人需與 Talaromyces marneffei 鑑別：後者以橫隔分裂（binary fission）、可見臘腸形長菌體。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Leishmania amastigote；Histoplasma 有暈圈、無 kinetoplast、GMS/PAS 陽性，Leishmania 有桿狀 kinetoplast 且 GMS 陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中組織球內帶暈圈的小生物，用哪一種特殊染色可確認為黴菌？最可能為何菌？
quiz.a: GMS（或 PAS）陽性；Histoplasma capsulatum。

65165.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中數顆紅血球被寄生蟲幾乎填滿，蟲體呈圓形、紫藍色、細胞質內散布細小棕色瘧色素，被感染的紅血球與周圍正常紅血球同大或略大，下方四張放大圖以配子體與成熟滋養體為主；配合旅遊史，符合間日瘧（Plasmodium vivax）感染。
features: Several parasitized RBCs containing large rounded parasites that fill most of the red cell
Parasite cytoplasm blue-purple with dispersed fine golden-brown hemozoin pigment and pinkish-red chromatin
Infected RBCs normal-sized to slightly enlarged compared with neighboring uninfected cells
Magnified insets 1-4 show round gametocytes and mature amoeboid trophozoites
No multiple small ring forms or banana-shaped gametocytes; a normal band/segmented neutrophil at right
65165.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood film shows scattered parasitized red cells among otherwise unremarkable erythrocytes and a neutrophil. The infected red cells are normal to slightly enlarged and contain large round to amoeboid parasites with blue cytoplasm, pink chromatin and fine dispersed brown pigment, representing mature trophozoites and round gametocytes as highlighted in the enlarged insets. Multiply infected cells, appliqué rings and crescent-shaped gametocytes are not seen. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax infection; Schüffner stippling is not clearly resolved at this magnification, and species confirmation by PCR or a reference laboratory is recommended, as was performed here.

ddx.vs: P. ovale also enlarges RBCs and shows Schüffner dots but infected cells are oval with fimbriated edges and the parasite is more compact.
P. malariae infects normal-sized or small RBCs with coarse dark pigment and characteristic band-form trophozoites and rosette schizonts.
P. falciparum shows numerous small delicate rings, multiply infected RBCs and banana-shaped gametocytes, with mature stages rarely seen in peripheral blood.
Babesia forms small pleomorphic rings or Maltese cross tetrads without hemozoin pigment or gametocytes.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium vivax malaria — normal-to-enlarged RBCs with large amoeboid trophozoites and round gametocytes containing fine brown hemozoin
pearls_zh: 考法：指含大型圓形蟲體的紅血球問種別與期別；答 P. vivax 的 mature trophozoite 或 round gametocyte，重點為紅血球腫大、Schüffner dots、周邊血可見各期。
長潛伏與復發：P. vivax 與 P. ovale 有肝內休眠體 hypnozoite，可在感染後數月至數年才發病或復發，本例即長潛伏。
根治需加 primaquine 或 tafenoquine 清除 hypnozoite，用藥前必須檢測 G6PD（缺乏者會溶血），台灣 G6PD 缺乏並不少見。
P. vivax 偏好感染 reticulocyte，並以 Duffy antigen 為受體；仍可造成嚴重貧血、脾破裂等重症，不應視為必然良性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 大型滋養體與配子體易與 P. ovale 或 P. malariae 混淆；P. ovale 紅血球卵圓且邊緣鬚狀，P. malariae 紅血球不腫大並見 band form，P. vivax 紅血球腫大、蟲體變形蟲狀。

quiz.q: P. vivax 急性期治療後為何還需加用 primaquine？使用前要驗什麼？
quiz.a: 清除肝內 hypnozoite 以防復發；需先驗 G6PD。

65101.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 2 倍低倍：結構保留，可見多個小而萎縮的濾泡，部分生發中心淡染或呈粉紅玻璃樣變，套區邊界不清，濾泡間區明顯擴大且呈粉紫色，右側門部血管增生，這種低倍型態提示多中心 Castleman 病。
features: Preserved nodal architecture with multiple small, widely spaced follicles
Regressed germinal centers, some with pale eosinophilic hyalinized centers
Poorly defined, attenuated mantle zones
Markedly expanded interfollicular areas with a pink-purple cellular infiltrate (plasma cells at higher power)
Prominent vessels and fibrous tissue at the hilum/capsule on the right; artifactual cracks in section
65101.describe_en: Lymph node section (H&E, 2x) shows preserved architecture with multiple small, widely spaced follicles containing regressed germinal centers, some with central hyalinization, and poorly delineated mantle zones. The interfollicular areas are markedly expanded by a dense cellular infiltrate, which at higher power comprises sheets of mature plasma cells, accompanied by prominent vascularity at the hilum. Individual cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification, and sectioning artifact (cracks) is present. Findings are consistent with the plasma cell pattern of multicentric Castleman disease; HHV8 (LANA-1) immunostaining is required for classification.

ddx.vs: iMCD shows similar regressed follicles and interfollicular plasmacytosis but lacks LANA-1-positive plasmablasts.

ddx.dx: Nodal involvement by plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: Plasmacytoma effaces architecture with monotypic plasma cells, whereas here follicles are preserved and plasma cells are interfollicular.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphadenopathy in autoimmune disease or HIV
ddx.vs: Reactive nodes usually show hyperplastic germinal centers with tingible body macrophages rather than regressed, hyalinized follicles.
AITL shows effaced architecture with arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded FDC meshworks and clear-cell atypical TFH cells (CD10/PD1+), not preserved follicles.

65037.recognize_zh: 淋巴結副皮質區被不規則、粉紅色的膠原束切割，膠原間夾雜小淋巴球、漿細胞與肥胖的梭形／肌纖維母細胞及小血管；周邊仍保有密集的淋巴組織，無明顯異型大細胞，屬發炎性偽瘤的纖維化發炎區。
features: Irregular, anastomosing bands of eosinophilic collagen expanding the paracortex
Mixed inflammatory infiltrate of small lymphocytes and plasma cells between collagen bundles
Plump spindle (fibroblastic/myofibroblastic) cells and small vessels within the fibrotic area
Adjacent preserved lymphoid tissue with dense small lymphocytes and interfollicular sinusoids
No large atypical cells or Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like cells evident at this magnification
65037.describe_en: Lymph node section shows the paracortex expanded by irregular, anastomosing bands of eosinophilic collagen. Between the collagen bundles are small lymphocytes, plasma cells, plump spindle cells and small vessels, while adjacent lymphoid parenchyma remains dense and cellular. No atypical large cells, necrosis or granulomas are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with the paracortical fibroinflammatory stage of nodal inflammatory pseudotumor; IgG4/IgG plasma cell counts, ALK and CD30 immunostains are appropriate to exclude mimics.

ddx.vs: IgG4-related disease shows storiform fibrosis with obliterative phlebitis and markedly increased IgG4+ plasma cells (>100/HPF, IgG4/IgG >40%), which was not reached in this case.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma (nodular sclerosis or lymphocyte-depleted)
ddx.vs: Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells within the fibroinflammatory background, which are not identified here.
The EBV-positive inflammatory FDC sarcoma shows scattered atypical spindle cells that are CD21/CD35 positive and EBER positive, unlike the bland spindle cells of reactive pseudotumor.

64269.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量大型原始細胞，圓核、染色質細緻並有核仁，細胞質呈深藍嗜鹼性並常見邊緣泡突與小空泡，偶見雙核，呈現原紅血球樣原始細胞的一致性浸潤。
features: Numerous large blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin and occasional visible nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone in some cells
Cytoplasmic blebs and fine peripheral vacuoles; occasional binucleate forms
No granules or Auer rods identified
Scattered smudged/disrupted cells, small lymphocytes and a few mature granulocytes in the background
64269.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows many large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and nucleoli, and deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs and occasional small vacuoles; rare binucleate forms are present. Auer rods are not seen, and smudged cells and a few mature leukocytes are present in the background. The blasts have proerythroblast-like features; together with immunohistochemistry demonstrating erythroid lineage (E-cadherin, CD71), the findings are consistent with pure erythroid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts share basophilic blebby cytoplasm but are CD41/CD61/CD42b positive and negative for E-cadherin and glycophorin A.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with many sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and a mature B-cell phenotype (CD19, CD10, sIg light chain).
Megaloblastic marrow shows orderly maturation to megaloblastic normoblasts, giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, and responds to B12/folate.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are CD138/MUM1 positive and CD71/E-cadherin negative in this pattern.

exam.answer_en: Pure erythroid leukemia — sheets of proerythroblast-like blasts with deeply basophilic, vacuolated, blebby agranular cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：大量深藍胞質、帶泡突與小空泡的原始細胞，問可能系別與確認方法；答紅血球系，需 E-cadherin、CD71、glycophorin A 證明。
門檻：erythroid precursors ≥80% 且 proerythroblasts ≥30%；此型不以 myeloblast 百分比計算，故 myeloblast 常很少。
預後極差，常與 TP53 突變、complex karyotype 或治療相關（therapy-related）背景有關。
Flow 上 proerythroblast 常 CD45 dim/陰性、CD34 與 HLA-DR 陰性、CD36 與 CD71 陽性，易被誤當非造血腫瘤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 Burkitt 或 megakaryoblastic leukemia：Burkitt 空泡為邊界清楚的脂質空泡且為成熟 B 細胞表型（CD10、sIg）；megakaryoblast 為 CD61/CD42b 陽性。空泡與雙核在此支持紅血球系。

quiz.q: 純紅血球白血病的診斷門檻為何（兩個百分比）？
quiz.a: Erythroid precursors ≥80%，其中 proerythroblasts ≥30%。

64461.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以骨髓球、後骨髓球與桿狀球為主（myelocyte bulge），中央有一個組織球，細胞質淡藍、呈纖維狀或條紋狀（類似皺褶紙），核偏心，即 CML 背景中的假戈謝細胞（pseudo-Gaucher cell）。
features: Central histiocyte with abundant pale blue cytoplasm showing fibrillar/striated, crumpled-paper texture and an eccentric nucleus
Marked granulocytic hyperplasia dominated by myelocytes and metamyelocytes (myelocyte bulge)
Bands and segmented neutrophils present; blasts not increased in this field
Scattered basophil-like and eosinophilic granulocytes
Background of platelets and red cells; erythroid precursors sparse
64461.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with marked granulocytic hyperplasia showing a full spectrum of maturation, predominantly myelocytes and metamyelocytes, with bands and segmented neutrophils; blasts are not increased in this field. A central histiocyte contains abundant pale blue cytoplasm with a fibrillar, striated texture resembling crumpled tissue paper and an eccentric nucleus. In the setting of BCR::ABL1-positive disease, this represents a pseudo-Gaucher cell arising from increased cell turnover. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia with pseudo-Gaucher histiocytes.

ddx.vs: True Gaucher cells look identical on smear, but occur without a myeloproliferative background and are confirmed by low glucocerebrosidase activity and GBA variants.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules (ceroid) rather than fibrillar striated cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial infection (e.g., M. avium complex) in histiocytes
ddx.vs: Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes show negative-image rods on Wright stain and are acid-fast positive.
Leukemoid reactions show toxic changes and lack the myelocyte bulge, basophilia, and BCR::ABL1 fusion.

exam.answer_en: Pseudo-Gaucher cell in chronic myeloid leukemia — histiocyte with striated 'crumpled paper' cytoplasm amid granulocytic hyperplasia with myelocyte bulge
pearls_zh: 考法：CML 骨髓中指這顆條紋狀細胞質的組織球問「是 Gaucher 病嗎？」——答 pseudo-Gaucher cell，源自腫瘤細胞高週轉、巨噬細胞吞噬過量膜脂質，酵素活性正常。
Pseudo-Gaucher cell 也見於 multiple myeloma、β-thalassemia、MDS/AML、分枝桿菌（MAC）感染；CML 骨髓亦常見 sea-blue histiocyte。
CML 骨髓其他特徵：高度增生、M:E 比明顯上升、小型低分葉（dwarf）巨核細胞、嗜酸與嗜鹼性球增加；可合併 reticulin 纖維化。
分枝桿菌感染的組織球在 Wright 染色可見負影桿菌（negative image），需加做 AFB 染色排除。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為真正的 Gaucher cell；兩者光顯形態幾乎相同，區分靠背景疾病（此處是 CML 的骨髓球增生）與 glucocerebrosidase 酵素活性。

quiz.q: CML 骨髓中出現圖中細胞質呈皺紋紙狀的組織球，應稱為什麼？與真 Gaucher cell 如何區分？
quiz.a: Pseudo-Gaucher cell；依背景疾病與 glucocerebrosidase 活性（Gaucher 病活性低下）

64141.recognize_zh: 高細胞密度骨髓切片中巨核細胞明顯增多、分布散在，許多巨核細胞的核為圓形單一小核或僅少數分葉，細胞質豐富粉紅，這種單葉型巨核細胞增生是 del(5q) MDS 的典型表現。
features: Hypercellular marrow with scattered adipocytes and a bony trabecula (lower right)
Markedly increased megakaryocytes distributed singly throughout the interstitium
Many megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
No tight megakaryocyte clusters or bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei
Background of maturing granulocytic and erythroid cells
64141.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with scattered adipocytes adjacent to a bony trabecula. Megakaryocytes are markedly increased and dispersed singly through the interstitium, and many show round non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm. Tight clustering, hyperlobated staghorn nuclei and bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei are not seen, and no sheets of immature cells are evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with the megakaryocytic changes of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q), to be confirmed by cytogenetics and blast enumeration.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with deeply hyperlobated staghorn nuclei, rather than monolobated nuclei.
PMF shows dense megakaryocyte clusters with atypical cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei and reticulin/collagen fibrosis.
MECOM-rearranged neoplasms also show small monolobated or bilobed megakaryocytes, so karyotype distinguishes them, often alongside increased blasts.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but show normal multilobated nuclei without dysplasia.

exam.answer_en: MDS with isolated del(5q) — markedly increased, dispersed megakaryocytes with round non-lobated/hypolobated nuclei, no clustering or staghorn forms
pearls_zh: 考法：切片中巨核細胞明顯增多，問是 MPN 還是 MDS；關鍵在核形態——單一圓核、低分葉、不緊密群聚，指向 del(5q) MDS。
類似的單葉小核巨核細胞也見於 MECOM 重排（inv(3)/t(3;3)）髓系腫瘤，後者血小板常正常或升高，但 blast 常增加且預後差。
WHO 5th MDS-5q 診斷需：del(5q) 單獨或加一個非 -7/del(7q) 異常、骨髓 blast <5%、周邊 blast <2%。
治療連結：輸血依賴的低風險 MDS-5q，lenalidomide 可達紅血球反應與細胞遺傳反應。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 ET：兩者巨核細胞都多、血小板都可能高，但 ET 為大型過度分葉（staghorn）核，del(5q) 為單一圓核；需以 karyotype/FISH 與 JAK2/CALR/MPL 區分。

quiz.q: 與 del(5q) MDS 一樣出現單葉小核巨核細胞、且常伴血小板不低的另一種預後差的遺傳異常是什麼？
quiz.a: inv(3)(q21q26)/t(3;3)，MECOM 重排。

64077.recognize_zh: 四格免疫染色中，瀰漫成片的腫瘤細胞 CD3（A）與 CD10（B）陽性，CD33（D）強陽性；搭配 T 淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤的臨床背景，提示帶有異常骨髓標記（CD33）的 T 母細胞腫瘤。TdT（C）在此解析度下染色偏弱、核內定位不明確。
features: Diffuse sheets of uniformly stained tumor cells at low-to-medium power with delicate intervening vessels
CD3 (A): strong diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic positivity in the tumor sheet
CD10 (B): diffuse positivity with a granular/dot-like pattern in most tumor cells
TdT (C): weak, patchy staining at this magnification; crisp nuclear localization is difficult to confirm
CD33 (D): strong diffuse positivity, indicating aberrant myeloid antigen expression
No architectural heterogeneity or residual follicles are evident in these fields
64077.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stains performed on the biopsy show a diffuse, sheet-like proliferation of tumor cells. The neoplastic cells are positive for CD3 and CD10, with strong aberrant expression of CD33. TdT staining is weak and patchy at this magnification, and nuclear localization cannot be reliably assessed in this image; correlation with a well-controlled TdT stain (or flow cytometry) is recommended. In the appropriate morphologic context, the immunophenotype supports T-lymphoblastic lymphoma with aberrant CD33 expression.

ddx.vs: ETP-ALL is CD1a-/CD8- with weak or absent CD5 and expresses stem/myeloid markers such as CD117, CD34 or CD33, so CD5, CD1a, CD8 and CD117 are needed to exclude it.
MPAL T/myeloid requires MPO positivity (or monocytic differentiation) in addition to cytoplasmic CD3; CD33 alone does not establish myeloid lineage.
Myeloid sarcoma is CD33/CD117/MPO positive but lacks cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT-positive T-lineage phenotype.
PTCL consists of mature T cells that are TdT-negative and usually CD10-negative, often with loss of pan-T antigens and a pleomorphic cytology.

64013.recognize_zh: 兩顆被寄生的紅血球比周圍紅血球大、形狀不規則，細胞內有形狀不規則、伸出偽足的阿米巴樣滋養體（ameboid trophozoite），含紫紅色染色質與少量金褐色瘧色素，紅血球表面布滿細小粉紅色 Schüffner 小點，符合間日瘧（P. vivax）。
features: Two parasitized red cells that are enlarged and irregularly shaped compared with surrounding uninfected red cells
Irregular, ameboid trophozoites with spread-out, pseudopod-like blue cytoplasm filling much of the red cell
Magenta-red chromatin masses within the parasites
Small amounts of golden-brown hemozoin pigment within the trophozoites
Fine, evenly distributed pink-red stippling (Schüffner's dots) across the infected red cells
No multiply-infected red cells, banana-shaped gametocytes or appliqué forms
64013.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows two parasitized red cells that are enlarged and irregular compared with the surrounding normal-sized red cells. Each contains a large irregular ameboid trophozoite with spread-out cytoplasm, magenta chromatin and fine golden-brown hemozoin pigment, and the host cells show fine uniform pink stippling consistent with Schüffner's dots. No multiply infected cells, crescent-shaped gametocytes or high parasitemia are evident in this field. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax infection; P. ovale should be excluded, ideally with PCR or antigen testing, and a parasitemia count should be reported.

ddx.vs: P. ovale also enlarges red cells with Schüffner's (James) dots but the host cells are oval with fimbriated edges and the trophozoites are compact rather than ameboid.
P. falciparum infects normal-sized red cells with delicate small rings, frequent multiple infections, appliqué forms, Maurer's clefts and banana-shaped gametocytes.
P. malariae infects normal or small red cells without stippling and shows band-form trophozoites with coarse pigment.
Babesia forms small pleomorphic rings or tetrads (Maltese cross) without hemozoin pigment or Schüffner's dots and does not enlarge the red cell.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium vivax amoeboid trophozoites — enlarged host RBCs with Schüffner's dots containing irregular amoeboid parasites with pigment
pearls_zh: 考法：指變大的受感染紅血球問物種與依據；答 P. vivax：宿主紅血球變大、Schüffner dots、trophozoite 呈不規則阿米巴狀。
P. vivax 偏好感染 reticulocyte，入侵需 Duffy antigen（DARC）；Duffy 陰性族群（多數西非血統）對其有較高抵抗力，但非絕對。
肝內 hypnozoites 會造成數週到數月後復發（relapse），需以 primaquine 或 tafenoquine 做 radical cure，用藥前必須檢測 G6PD。
報告需包含物種與 parasitemia；瘧疾在台灣屬法定傳染病，多為境外移入，確診需通報並可送疾管署確認（如 PCR）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 P. ovale 混淆：兩者都使紅血球變大並有 Schüffner（James）dots 與 hypnozoite；ovale 感染的紅血球常呈橢圓、邊緣鋸齒（fimbriated），trophozoite 較緻密不呈阿米巴狀。

quiz.q: 圖中受感染紅血球變大並有細小粉紅點，這些點稱為什麼？寄生蟲最可能為哪一種？
quiz.a: Schüffner's dots；Plasmodium vivax（ameboid trophozoite）。

63757.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀點圖加抗原總表：CD45 弱陽性、低 SSC 的芽細胞群同時表現骨髓系（MPO、CD117）、T 系（cyCD3、CD7、CD1a）與 B 系（CD19、cyCD22、CD79a）抗原，外加 TdT、HLA-DR；三系抗原同時出現在同一群芽細胞上，是極罕見的 B/T/骨髓系混合表現型急性白血病（MPAL）。
features: Flow cytometry figure: 12 dot plots plus a summary table (Panel G) of positive and negative antigens
Blast gate (A) with dim CD45 and low side scatter
Gated blasts co-express CD117 and HLA-DR, with TdT and cytoplasmic CD3 positivity on a single population
CD7 positive with variable (partial) CD34 expression; CD99, CD9, CD200 and CD45RA positive

Table lists myeloid (MPO, CD117), T-lineage (cyCD3, CD1a, CD7, CD99) and B-lineage (CD19, cyCD22, CD79a, TdT, HLA-DR, CD200) antigens as positive; CD2, CD4, CD5, CD8, CD10, CD13, CD20, CD23, CD33, CD38, CD56 negative
63757.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis identifies a blast population with dim CD45 and low side scatter. The blasts co-express HLA-DR, CD117, TdT and cytoplasmic CD3, and are positive for CD7, CD99, CD9, CD200 and CD45RA with variable CD34; the summary panel additionally reports MPO, CD1a, CD19, cytoplasmic CD22 and CD79a positivity, with CD2, CD4, CD5, CD8, CD10, CD13, CD20, CD23, CD33, CD38 and CD56 negative. Expression of lineage-defining markers of myeloid (MPO), T (cytoplasmic CD3) and B (CD19 with cyCD22/CD79a) lineages on the same blasts fulfils criteria for a trilineage mixed phenotype acute leukemia (B/T/myeloid). Lineage assignment should be confirmed by assessing intensity of cyCD3 and CD19 relative to normal populations, and BCR::ABL1 and KMT2A rearrangements should be excluded.

ddx.vs: ETP-ALL is cyCD3+ CD7+ with stem/myeloid markers (CD117, CD34, HLA-DR) but lacks MPO and CD1a and does not show strong B-lineage CD19 expression.

ddx.dx: AML with aberrant lymphoid antigen expression
ddx.vs: AML may express CD7 or CD19 aberrantly, but true MPAL requires lineage-defining markers such as bright cytoplasmic CD3 or strong CD19 with CD79a/cyCD22, not a single weak lymphoid antigen.

ddx.dx: MPAL with BCR::ABL1 or KMT2A rearrangement
ddx.vs: These genetically defined MPAL subtypes share the mixed phenotype and are separated only by cytogenetic and molecular testing.
Mixed-lineage blast crisis arises with a prior or concurrent CML history and BCR::ABL1 in all cases, which must be excluded before diagnosing de novo MPAL.

63821.recognize_zh: 這張血片紅血球形態非常雜：大量無中央淡染的小而深染球形紅血球（spherocytes），夾雜卵圓形／橢圓形紅血球、三角形或頭盔狀破碎紅血球（schistocytes）、帶尾巴的淚滴細胞（dacrocytes），以及少數偏大偏藍的多染性紅血球；多種異形並存即為明顯的異形紅血球症（poikilocytosis）。
features: Numerous small dense spherocytes lacking central pallor
Ovalocytes and elongated elliptical red cells, some large
Fragmented red cells including triangular and helmet-shaped schistocytes and microspherocytic fragments
Occasional teardrop cells (dacrocytes) with tapered tails
A few larger, slightly bluish polychromatophilic red cells; platelets present; stain with a blue-grey cast
63821.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis. There are numerous spherocytes and microspherocytes, together with ovalocytes, elliptocytes, schistocytes including helmet and triangular forms, and occasional dacrocytes. Scattered polychromatophilic red cells indicate a reticulocyte response, and platelets are present. No leukocytes are included in this field. These findings indicate a hemolytic process with red cell fragmentation and are nonspecific in etiology; the proposed interpretation of myelodysplasia with secondary immune hemolysis requires DAT, hemolysis markers, bone marrow examination and, in a young child, exclusion of inherited membrane disorders.

ddx.vs: In a young child, marked microspherocytes, fragments and elliptocytes with a very low MCV suggest HPP, confirmed by thermal sensitivity, EMA binding or spectrin gene testing with a negative DAT.
HS shows spherocytes with polychromasia but few schistocytes, elliptocytes or teardrop cells, a negative DAT and a positive family history or reduced EMA binding.
TMA shows abundant schistocytes with thrombocytopenia, renal or neurologic involvement and, in TTP, severely reduced ADAMTS13, whereas platelets here are not obviously reduced.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes and polychromasia with a positive DAT (IgG) but lacks prominent fragmentation, elliptocytes and dacrocytes.

63693.recognize_zh: 箭頭處是一個細胞質仍相連、中間已明顯內縮的細胞，兩端各有一顆圓形、染色質濃縮的子核，符合有絲分裂末期（telophase）與細胞質分裂（cytokinesis）；藍灰色細胞質提示為紅血球系前驅細胞。
features: Single cell with a central constriction (cleavage furrow) forming two conjoined halves
Two round, equal daughter nuclei at opposite poles with coarse condensed chromatin and no nucleoli
Moderate blue-gray (polychromatophilic) cytoplasm suggesting an erythroid precursor
Nearby polychromatophilic erythroblasts and a larger basophilic erythroblast with granular chromatin
Background red cells and small platelet clumps
63693.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered erythroid precursors at various stages of maturation, mature red cells, and small platelet clumps. The arrowed cell has two round, symmetric daughter nuclei with condensed chromatin at opposite poles and a cleavage furrow constricting the shared polychromatophilic cytoplasm. This represents late telophase with cytokinesis, apparently in a polychromatophilic erythroblast. The daughter nuclei are equal in size without an internuclear chromatin bridge. Findings are consistent with a normal telophase mitotic figure.

ddx.vs: A dysplastic binucleate erythroblast has two nuclei, often unequal, within an intact round cytoplasm without a cleavage furrow.
Adjacent cells each have a complete, separate cytoplasmic outline rather than a shared furrowed cytoplasm.
In CDA I a thin chromatin strand links two separated erythroblast nuclei, which is not seen here.
Anaphase shows filamentous condensed chromosome groups without reformed round nuclei or a furrow.

63565.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的紅血球中央有一塊血紅素染色的圓點，外圍一圈淡色環，再外面又是一圈粉紅邊緣，形成「靶心」外觀，即標靶細胞（target cell, codocyte）。
features: Red cells with a central dense hemoglobinized spot surrounded by a pale ring and a peripheral rim of hemoglobin (bull's-eye pattern)
Target cells are normal to slightly large in size and constitute a substantial proportion of the field
Admixed normocytic red cells with preserved or lost central pallor; a few folded cells showing linear pallor/drying artifact
No spherocytes, sickle cells, or red cell inclusions evident
Scattered small platelets in the background; low cell density area of the smear
63565.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear viewed at high power in a thin area shows numerous target cells (codocytes), characterized by a central hemoglobinized zone, a surrounding pale annulus and a peripheral rim of hemoglobin (arrows). The remaining red cells are largely normocytic; a few show folding or linear pallor consistent with slide preparation artifact. No sickle cells, spherocytes, basophilic stippling or inclusions are identified in this field, and platelets appear adequate on this limited view. Findings are consistent with target cell formation; correlation with hemoglobin electrophoresis and liver function is recommended to distinguish hemoglobinopathy, thalassemia and liver disease.

ddx.vs: Stomatocytes have a slit-like or mouth-shaped central pallor rather than a central hemoglobin dot within a pale ring.
Artifactual targets are confined to thick areas or one field and often show refractile, irregular pallor, whereas true target cells are evenly distributed in the monolayer.
HbC and HbSC disease show intraerythrocytic rhomboid or 'Washington monument' crystals and folded cells in addition to targets, which are not seen here.

exam.answer_en: Target cells (codocytes) — red cells with central hemoglobinized spot, pale annulus and peripheral hemoglobin rim
pearls_zh: 考法：指靶心狀紅血球問名稱與病因分類：血紅素病（HbC、HbE、HbS）、地中海貧血、肝病（尤其阻塞性黃疸）、脾切除後。
機轉：細胞膜面積相對於血紅素含量過多；地中海貧血為血紅素不足，肝病則是膜上 cholesterol 與 phospholipid 增加。
下一步：看 MCV、Hb 電泳/HPLC 與肝功能；小球性貧血合併標靶細胞應優先考慮地中海貧血。
抹片厚區或乾燥慢的區域可出現假性標靶細胞，應在紅血球剛好不重疊的薄區評估。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 stomatocyte 或乾燥偽影看成標靶細胞；真正標靶細胞有中央血紅素點加外圈環形淡染，stomatocyte 則為一字嘴狀淡染區。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指紅血球名稱？列出兩種常見相關疾病。
quiz.a: Target cell (codocyte)；thalassemia、liver disease（或 HbC）

63501.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群非造血來源的腫瘤細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻，排列成花環狀圍繞中央淡藍色細纖維狀物質（neuropil），形成 Homer Wright 玫瑰花結（rosette），符合轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Cohesive cluster of small-to-medium round tumor cells foreign to the marrow
Rosette arrangement: nuclei arranged peripherally around a central pale blue fibrillary core (neuropil; Homer Wright rosette)
Round to oval nuclei with fine to slightly coarse chromatin, occasional nuclear molding, and high N:C ratio
Scant basophilic cytoplasm merging into the central fibrillary material
Scattered single tumor cells nearby; background red cells, a neutrophil, and platelet clumps
63501.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of small-to-medium round cells that are foreign to the normal hematopoietic population. The cells have round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin, focal nuclear molding, and scant basophilic cytoplasm, and they are arranged in a rosette around a central core of pale blue fibrillary material consistent with neuropil. Similar single cells are scattered in the background among red cells and occasional granulocytes. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma forming Homer Wright rosettes, supported by synaptophysin, chromogranin, CD56, and PGP9.5 expression.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are dispersed singly without cohesive clusters or neuropil-containing rosettes and express TdT and CD19/CD3 rather than neuroendocrine markers.
Ewing sarcoma cells are clustered small round cells with vacuolated PAS-positive cytoplasm, usually lacking neuropil, and express CD99 and NKX2.2 with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells often show more cytoplasm with vacuoles and multinucleated forms and express desmin and myogenin.
Hematopoietic clusters lack cohesion and fibrillary cores, and megakaryocytes are large cells with lobulated nuclei and granular cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic neuroblastoma in marrow — cohesive small round tumor cells forming Homer Wright rosettes around fibrillary neuropil
pearls_zh: 考法：兒童骨髓抹片一團小圓細胞，考官指中央淡藍纖維狀物問名稱；答 neuropil 形成的 Homer Wright rosette。
IHC：PHOX2B、synaptophysin、chromogranin、CD56 陽性，CD45 與 CD99 陰性；Ewing sarcoma 則 CD99 膜染色強陽性並有 EWSR1 重組。
檢驗：尿液 VMA/HVA（catecholamine 代謝物）升高，MIBG 掃描；MYCN amplification 為重要的高風險預後因子。
骨髓侵犯屬遠端轉移（INRG stage M），分期需雙側骨髓抽吸與切片。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 ALL 淋巴母細胞；ALL 細胞散在不黏附、TdT/CD19 或 CD3 陽性，神經母細胞瘤成團並有 neuropil 玫瑰花結、CD45 陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中腫瘤細胞圍繞中央纖維狀物排列的結構叫什麼？哪一項基因變化代表高風險？
quiz.a: Homer Wright rosette（圍繞 neuropil）；MYCN amplification

63373.recognize_zh: 兩張背部皮膚臨床照片：左圖是全身散佈的紅紫色斑塊與丘疹，部分中央有出血結痂與潰瘍（進展期皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤）；右圖為全身皮膚電子治療（TSET）後色素沉著、多處潰瘍與大片黃綠色焦痂（eschar）。
features: Clinical photograph composite of the trunk (non-microscopic)
Left panel: innumerable erythematous-violaceous papules, plaques and nodules, many with hemorrhagic crusts and central ulceration
Left panel: coalescing plaques forming a larger ulcerated tumor-stage lesion
Right panel: diffuse post-radiation hyperpigmentation with residual scaly pink macules
Right panel: multiple punched-out ulcers and a large irregular eschar with yellow-green slough
63373.describe_en: Paired clinical photographs of the trunk. Before treatment, there are widespread erythematous to violaceous papules, plaques and ulcerated nodules with hemorrhagic crusting, consistent with advanced cutaneous T-cell lymphoma. After total skin electron beam therapy, the plaques have flattened into hyperpigmented patches, but there are multiple ulcers and a large eschar with slough, consistent with radiation-related skin injury with possible superinfection. Histologic diagnosis cannot be assessed from clinical photographs.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma / lymphomatoid papulosis
ddx.vs: LyP shows self-healing crops of papulonodules and C-ALCL solitary tumors, with CD30-positive large cells on biopsy.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: This entity presents with rapidly ulcerating necrotic lesions and is separated by CD8+/cytotoxic phenotype on biopsy.
Infectious ulcers require culture and histology showing organisms rather than atypical lymphoid infiltrate.

63309.recognize_zh: 一顆位於中央、核淡染而胞質邊界不清的巨噬細胞，被一圈胞質深藍、核圓而緻密的紅母細胞環繞，形成紅血球生成島（erythroblastic island），也就是「保母細胞」（nurse cell）。
features: Central macrophage with a pale pink, finely reticular nucleus and ill-defined pale cytoplasm
Rosette of about nine erythroblasts arranged around the macrophage
Erythroblasts with round, centrally placed nuclei with condensed chromatin and deeply basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm
Erythroblasts adhere to the macrophage surface without intracytoplasmic engulfment
Background of red cells in a thick area and scattered isolated lymphocytes
63309.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (MGG) shows an erythroblastic island composed of a central macrophage with a pale, reticular nucleus and indistinct cytoplasm surrounded by a rosette of basophilic and polychromatic erythroblasts. The erythroblasts show round nuclei with progressively condensed chromatin and are attached to, but not enclosed by, the macrophage. There is no dysplasia or hemophagocytosis evident in this field. Findings represent a normal erythroblastic island (nurse cell), in which the central macrophage supports erythroid maturation and iron transfer.

ddx.vs: In hemophagocytosis the cells lie within cytoplasmic phagosomes of the macrophage rather than arranged around its periphery.
Tumor clusters are cohesive cells with atypical, pleomorphic nuclei and no central macrophage, unlike maturing erythroblasts with uniform round nuclei.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell cluster around a macrophage
ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof, whereas erythroblasts have central round nuclei without a hof.

63181.recognize_zh: 抹片較厚區域中大量中到大型淋巴球，細胞質量多且呈淡藍到深藍色、核圓且染色質略開放，看起來像母細胞；但混有成熟嗜中性球，細胞大小與形態呈連續光譜而非單一型態，符合登革熱的反應性（轉化型）淋巴球。
features: Numerous medium to large lymphoid cells with moderate to abundant pale-to-deep basophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nuclei with moderately condensed to partly open chromatin; some appear blast-like
Heterogeneous spectrum of cell size and cytoplasmic basophilia rather than a monotonous population
Scattered mature segmented neutrophils admixed
Thick, poorly spread area of the smear with overlapping cells, limiting fine nuclear detail
63181.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, from a thick area of the film, shows numerous medium to large lymphoid cells admixed with segmented neutrophils. The lymphoid cells have moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm and round to indented nuclei with somewhat open chromatin, imparting a blast-like appearance. However, the cells show a range of sizes and cytoplasmic basophilia, without Auer rods or a monotonous blast population. Interpretation is limited by cell crowding in this thick area. In the clinical context of dengue infection, findings are consistent with reactive (transformed) lymphocytosis mimicking blasts; flow cytometry can be used if doubt persists.

ddx.vs: Blasts form a monotonous population with fine uniform chromatin, high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm, whereas these cells are heterogeneous with abundant basophilic cytoplasm.
Plasma cells show eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin, which are not prominent in this heterogeneous population.

ddx.dx: Circulating lymphoma cells (e.g., large B-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are clonal and more uniform with nuclear irregularity; a light-chain-restricted or aberrant phenotype on flow cytometry separates them from reactive cells.

exam.answer_en: Reactive (transformed) lymphocytes in dengue mimicking blasts — heterogeneous spectrum of medium-large lymphoid cells with abundant basophilic cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官給「像母細胞」的一片，要你說出為何是反應性：細胞大小與胞質嗜鹼性呈連續光譜、非單一型態，且無 Auer rod。
登革熱血片常見 plasmacytoid／transformed lymphocytes，合併白血球低下與血小板低下；Hct 上升同時血小板快速下降是血漿滲漏的警訊。
反應性淋巴球（Downey type II）胞質邊緣深藍並沿紅血球擁抱（scalloping），EBV、CMV、登革熱與藥物反應皆可見。
若仍無法排除白血病：flow 顯示多株 T/NK 為主、無 CD34/TdT 表現的母細胞族群即支持反應性，並於數週後追蹤抹片。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤判為急性白血病；母細胞單一型態、胞質少、染色質均勻細緻，此處細胞異質性高且胞質豐富。另注意本視野為厚片區，細節判讀需換到單層區。

quiz.q: 發燒病人血片見這些「像母細胞」的淋巴球，哪一形態特點最支持反應性而非白血病？
quiz.a: 細胞大小與胞質嗜鹼性呈連續光譜（異質性），非單一型態族群

63117.recognize_zh: 血片中多數紅血球小而淡染，並有大量標靶細胞（target cell），同時散在數個兩端尖、細長鐮刀狀的紅血球（sickle cell）；小球性低色素加上鐮刀細胞，提示鐮刀型 β 地中海型貧血。
features: Microcytic, hypochromic red cells with anisocytosis
Numerous target cells (codocytes)
Several elongated sickle cells (drepanocytes) with pointed ends
Mild poikilocytosis with occasional irregular fragments
One neutrophil with normal segmented morphology
Smartphone photomicrograph with uneven focus limits fine detail
63117.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows microcytic, hypochromic red cells with anisopoikilocytosis, numerous target cells, and several elongated sickle cells with tapered ends. A neutrophil with normal segmentation is present, and platelets are seen scattered. Image quality (smartphone capture, uneven focus) limits assessment of fine inclusions. The combination of microcytic hypochromic indices, target cells, and sickle cells is suggestive of sickle β-thalassemia, which requires confirmation by hemoglobin HPLC and/or mutation analysis, as was performed in this case.

ddx.vs: HbSS usually has normocytic indices with more numerous sickle cells and Howell-Jolly bodies from autosplenectomy, whereas microcytosis with hypochromia favors Sβ-thalassemia; HPLC (HbA2 elevated, HbA absent/reduced) and molecular testing separate them.
HbSC shows many target cells and characteristic HbC crystals and folded/boat-shaped cells, with fewer classic sickle cells and HbC on HPLC.
β-thalassemia shows microcytosis, target cells, and nucleated red cells but no sickle cells, and HbS is absent on HPLC.
Iron deficiency has microcytic hypochromic cells and pencil cells but lacks sickle cells and prominent target cells, with low ferritin.

exam.answer_en: Sickle β-thalassemia — microcytic hypochromic red cells with numerous target cells and scattered sickle cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指兩端尖細長的細胞（sickle cell）與標靶細胞，問「同時小球性低色素＋鐮刀細胞」要想到什麼：HbS/β-thalassemia。
HPLC 判讀：S/β0 無 HbA，以 HbS 為主並 HbA2 升高；S/β+ 有少量 HbA 但 HbS > HbA；sickle trait 則 HbA > HbS，且形態正常。
Sickling（solubility）test 在 SS、S/β-thal 與 trait 皆陽性，無法區分基因型，需 HPLC 或電泳加基因檢測。
S/β0-thalassemia 臨床嚴重度接近 HbSS，同樣可使用 hydroxyurea 並需血管阻塞危象、脾功能低下與感染預防等照護。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 HbSS；HbSS 多為正球性且無 HbA2 明顯升高，但 HbSS 合併 α-thalassemia 也會小球性，最終仍需 HPLC 與基因分析確認。

quiz.q: 此片見小球性低色素、標靶細胞與鐮刀細胞，確認診斷首選哪項檢查？S/β0 的典型結果？
quiz.a: Hemoglobin HPLC（或電泳）；無 HbA、以 HbS 為主並 HbA2 升高

63053.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多個大型組織球的細胞質內含被吞噬的完整有核細胞（嗜中性球、紅系前驅細胞、淋巴球），被吞入的細胞周圍有清楚的空泡暈圈，即噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large histiocytes (roughly 30-50 um) with abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm and a single oval nucleus with fine chromatin
Engulfed intact nucleated cells within phagocytic vacuoles: neutrophil (A), erythroid precursors and lymphocytes (B-G)
Clear halo surrounding phagocytosed cells indicating phagosomes
Some histiocytes contain multiple ingested cells (C, E)
Background of maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors and red cells
63053.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (composite, scale bar 20 um) shows numerous large histiocytes with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing ingested intact hematopoietic cells, including neutrophils, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes, each surrounded by a clear phagocytic halo. Several histiocytes contain two or more engulfed cells. Background hematopoiesis is present without an obvious neoplastic infiltrate. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis; in the appropriate setting, this supports hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis associated with SARS-CoV-2 infection, although hemophagocytosis alone is not diagnostic of HLH.

ddx.vs: Isolated hemophagocytosis is non-specific; HLH requires HLH-2004 criteria (fever, splenomegaly, cytopenias, ferritin, triglycerides/fibrinogen, sCD25).
Lymphoma-associated HLH shows an atypical lymphoid infiltrate on biopsy/IHC, which is not evident in these fields.
Emperipolesis occurs within megakaryocytes with lobulated nuclei and the passenger cells remain viable, without phagocytic vacuoles.
Tumor cell cannibalism involves atypical, cohesive nonhematopoietic cells, not bland histiocytes with oval nuclei.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis in bone marrow (SARS-CoV-2–associated HLH) — macrophages engulfing intact neutrophils, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes in phagocytic vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指巨噬細胞內被空泡包住的細胞，要你分辨被吞的是哪一系（A 嗜中性球、B–G 紅系前驅與淋巴球），並回答「噬血現象不等於 HLH」。
HLH-2004 需 8 項中 5 項：發燒、脾腫大、≥2 系血球減少、高三酸甘油酯和/或低纖維蛋白原、組織噬血、NK 活性低或缺乏、ferritin ≥500 ng/mL、sCD25 ≥2400 U/mL。
噬血現象敏感度與特異度都有限：輸血、敗血症後也可見，骨髓未見也不能排除 HLH；HScore 可協助估計成人 HLH 機率。
成人繼發性 HLH 需找誘因：病毒（EBV、COVID-19）、淋巴瘤（尤其 T/NK 細胞）、自體免疫（MAS）；治療以控制誘因並依嚴重度給予 dexamethasone、etoposide 等。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 RDD 的 emperipolesis 或巨核細胞內的 emperipolesis；噬血現象的被吞細胞位於吞噬空泡內並逐漸被分解，宿主是 CD68+/S100− 巨噬細胞。

quiz.q: 骨髓中見到如圖的噬血現象，是否足以診斷 HLH？依 HLH-2004 需符合幾項標準？
quiz.a: 不足以單獨診斷；需符合 8 項中 5 項（或 HLH 相關基因突變）

62989.recognize_zh: 高倍下濾泡間區充滿核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀（clock-face）、核旁有淡染區（perinuclear hof）的成熟漿細胞，並被許多內皮細胞明顯的小血管分隔成巢狀，屬於反應性濾泡間漿細胞增多。
features: Sheets and nests of mature plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and coarse clock-face chromatin
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof in many cells
No significant nuclear atypia, prominent nucleoli or mitotic activity among plasma cells
Numerous prominent small vessels with plump endothelial cells separating the plasma cell nests
Admixed small lymphocytes and occasional histiocytes
62989.describe_en: High-power view of the interfollicular area shows a marked increase in mature-appearing plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin and perinuclear hofs. They are arranged in nests and cords separated by numerous prominent small vessels lined by plump endothelial cells. Plasma cell atypia is not evident. Findings are consistent with interfollicular plasmacytosis with vascular proliferation; clonality (kappa/lambda) and IgG4 studies are needed to separate reactive, IgG4-related and neoplastic processes.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; it is defined by increased IgG4+ plasma cells with IgG4:IgG ratio >40% on immunostains.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell variant of Castleman disease
ddx.vs: Castleman disease adds regressed, hyalinized germinal centers with sheets of interfollicular plasma cells and is often associated with HHV8 or systemic IL-6 features.

ddx.dx: Extramedullary plasmacytoma / lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cells show light-chain restriction and may show atypia, whereas reactive plasma cells are polytypic.
AITL has arborizing HEVs with clear atypical CD4+/PD1+/CD10+ T-cells and expanded FDC meshworks, not a pure mature plasma cell population.

62925.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中紅血球大小不均並有標靶細胞、鋸齒狀細胞與不規則碎片，可見兩個小而深染核的有核紅血球，部分紅血球內有細小深色點狀物（可能是嗜鹼性點彩或 Howell-Jolly 小體，解析度不足以確認），整體符合重型乙型地中海貧血。
features: Anisocytosis with microcytes and normocytes
Target cells, crenated/echinocytic cells, and irregular fragments
Two nucleated red blood cells with small dense nuclei
Fine dark punctate dots within some red cells, possibly basophilic stippling or small Howell-Jolly bodies (not resolvable here)
Numerous small platelets scattered in the background
62925.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with microcytes, target cells, crenated forms, and red cell fragments. Two nucleated red blood cells with small dense nuclei are seen. Some red cells contain fine dark punctate dots that may represent basophilic stippling or small Howell-Jolly bodies, but these cannot be characterized reliably at this resolution. Platelets are numerous. Findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia major.

ddx.vs: Trait shows microcytosis and target cells with basophilic stippling but only mild poikilocytosis and no circulating NRBCs.
Lead toxicity gives coarse basophilic stippling in hypochromic cells but without target cells, fragments, or NRBCs.
Hb H disease shows golf-ball inclusions on supravital staining and typically fewer NRBCs.

62861.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有多顆體積小的晚期紅血球母細胞，核深染、細胞質量少且持續偏藍（持續性細胞質嗜鹼性），呈微小正母細胞（micronormoblast）樣，並有少數核不規則等輕度紅系異生，旁邊顆粒球系成熟完整。
features: Small erythroblasts (micronormoblasts) with dense pyknotic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Persistent cytoplasmic basophilia in late-stage erythroblasts, indicating defective hemoglobinization
Occasional erythroblasts with irregular nuclear outlines (mild dyserythropoiesis)
Abundant maturing granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands) with normal granulation
Crenated red cells in the background
62861.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows trilineage hematopoiesis with abundant maturing granulocytic precursors. The erythroid precursors are small (micronormoblastic) with dense nuclei and scant, ragged cytoplasm that retains basophilia at late stages of maturation, reflecting impaired hemoglobinization. A few erythroblasts show irregular nuclear contours, consistent with mild dyserythropoiesis. Granulocytic maturation appears normal and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with a disorder of heme synthesis or iron utilization such as sideroblastic anemia; an iron stain is required to demonstrate ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: Micronormoblasts with ragged basophilic cytoplasm are also typical, but marrow storage iron is absent and ring sideroblasts are not seen.
Thalassemia marrow shows marked erythroid hyperplasia with micronormoblasts but normal to increased iron without ring sideroblasts, and abnormal hemoglobin studies.
MDS shows more pronounced multilineage dysplasia (megaloblastoid change, hypolobated megakaryocytes, hypogranular neutrophils) and clonal genetic abnormalities.

62797.recognize_zh: 這是血紅素HPLC報告：Ao峰57.1%為最大峰，S-window峰32.9%，HbA2 3.0%、HbF 0.8%，HbA多於HbS且兩者並存，符合鐮刀型血紅素帶因者（sickle cell trait）。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC chromatogram with peak table
Dominant Ao peak at 2.45 min (57.1%)
Second major peak in the S-window at 4.34 min (32.9%)
HbA2 3.0% (3.62 min) and HbF 0.8% (1.09 min); minor P2/P3 peaks
Non-morphologic image; HbA2 may be mildly overestimated in the presence of HbS adducts
62797.describe_en: Cation-exchange high-performance liquid chromatography shows a dominant Ao peak (57.1%) and a second major peak in the S-window at 4.34 minutes (32.9%). HbA2 is 3.0% and HbF is 0.8%, with small P2 and P3 peaks. The HbA fraction exceeds the HbS fraction, and no additional variant peak is identified. Findings are consistent with heterozygous HbS (sickle cell trait).

ddx.vs: In HbS/β+-thalassemia HbS exceeds HbA, with elevated HbA2 (>3.5%) and microcytosis, the reverse of the A>S ratio here.
Coinherited α-thalassemia lowers the HbS fraction to about 25–30% with microcytosis; the 32.9% here is near the usual trait range but indices should be checked.
HbD elutes earlier in the D-window (about 4.0–4.1 min) and gives a negative sickle solubility test.

62669.recognize_zh: MUM1 染色中，成群的大型腫瘤細胞核呈強棕色陽性（部分也有細胞質染色），周圍小型淋巴球大多陰性；表示腫瘤細胞為漿母細胞/後生發中心分化，是 PEL 的典型表現型。
features: Clusters of large tumor cells with strong nuclear MUM1/IRF4 staining
Additional granular cytoplasmic staining in many tumor cells
Large, irregular to lobulated nuclei with visible chromatin texture
Background small lymphocytes largely negative with scattered positive cells
Sharp demarcation between positive tumor aggregates and negative lymphoid tissue
62669.describe_en: MUM1 immunohistochemistry shows cohesive aggregates of large neoplastic cells with strong nuclear staining, accompanied by granular cytoplasmic staining, while the intervening small lymphocytes are largely negative with only scattered positive cells. The tumor nuclei are large and irregular. The findings indicate a post-germinal center/plasmablastic phenotype of the neoplastic cells. Findings are consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma in conjunction with HHV8 positivity and loss of B-cell markers.

ddx.vs: Also MUM1-positive with loss of CD20/PAX5, but HHV8 (LANA-1)-negative.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, non-germinal center type
ddx.vs: MUM1-positive but retains CD20 and PAX5 and is HHV8-negative.
May be MUM1-positive, but is CD30 strong with ALK or T-cell antigens and HHV8-negative.

62541.recognize_zh: 中央有一顆體積偏小、細胞質含細顆粒、兩個圓形細胞核彼此分離的巨核細胞（分離核的小型巨核細胞），屬巨核細胞發育不良；右側兩顆為深藍細胞質的嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞，符合 RCC 抹片表現。
features: Small binucleate megakaryocyte with two widely separated round nuclei and finely granular pink-lilac cytoplasm (dysplastic megakaryocyte)
Adjacent large mass of granular cytoplasm/platelet material from another megakaryocyte at left
Two large basophilic erythroblasts with round nuclei, stippled chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm at right
Scattered maturing erythroid and granulocytic precursors
62541.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a small megakaryocyte with two separate, round nuclei and granular cytoplasm, a dysplastic megakaryocytic form. Adjacent are fragments of megakaryocytic cytoplasm and platelets, and two large basophilic erythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm are present at right. Blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia, which in the appropriate clinical context supports refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.vs: ITP shows increased but morphologically normal megakaryocytes with lobulated nuclei, without separated-nuclei or micromegakaryocytic forms.
AMKL shows at least 20% blasts with cytoplasmic blebs and CD41/CD61 positivity, rather than isolated dysplastic mature megakaryocytes.
Transient reactive changes resolve with removal of the cause, so persistence over time and cytogenetics are needed to support MDS.

62477.recognize_zh: CD5 染色中只有散在的反應性 T 細胞呈陽性，並在血管周圍與結節之間較密集；構成結節主體的腫瘤性 B 細胞是 CD5 陰性，可藉此與 CLL 及被套細胞淋巴瘤區分。
features: Nodular lymphoid areas composed predominantly of CD5-negative cells (blue counterstain)
Scattered individual CD5-positive small T cells within nodules
Denser CD5-positive T-cell collections in perivascular/periarteriolar areas and between nodules
Linear tissue cracks are sectioning artifact
62477.describe_en: CD5 immunohistochemical stain on spleen shows nodular lymphoid infiltrates in which the majority of cells are negative. CD5 highlights scattered reactive T cells within the nodules and denser collections of T cells in perivascular regions and between nodules. Linear cracks represent sectioning artifact. The neoplastic B cells are CD5 negative, which argues against CLL/SLL and mantle cell lymphoma and supports splenic marginal zone lymphoma in context.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL B cells co-express CD5 (weaker than T cells), so the nodules would appear diffusely CD5 positive.
Mantle cell lymphoma cells are CD5 positive and cyclin D1 positive, unlike these CD5-negative nodules.
A minority of SMZL express CD5, which would show diffuse staining of nodular B cells and requires cyclin D1 and SOX11 to exclude mantle cell lymphoma.

62413.recognize_zh: lambda 輕鏈原位雜交（ISH）染色的骨髓組織中，整個視野只有極少數細胞呈深藍黑色陽性訊號，其餘造血細胞與脂肪皆為陰性；需與 kappa ISH 對照，kappa 陽性漿細胞遠多於 lambda，即表示輕鏈限制（kappa restriction）。
features: Bone marrow tissue with interspersed fat spaces and eosinophilic hematopoietic background
Only rare cells show dark blue-black cytoplasmic lambda ISH signal
The vast majority of nucleated cells are lambda-negative
No specific signal in adipocytes or red cells
Low resolution and pale counterstain limit cytologic detail
62413.describe_en: In situ hybridization for lambda light-chain mRNA on a bone marrow section shows only rare positive cells with dark cytoplasmic signal scattered among fat spaces and lambda-negative hematopoietic elements. Image resolution and the pale counterstain limit cytologic assessment of the positive cells. When compared with the kappa ISH on the same specimen, which highlights many plasma cells, the markedly skewed kappa-to-lambda ratio indicates a clonal, kappa-restricted plasma cell population. In the context of a small lymphocytic infiltrate with plasmacytic differentiation, findings support lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells show a kappa-to-lambda ratio of roughly 1-3:1 rather than near-exclusive kappa expression with rare lambda cells.
Myeloma also shows light-chain restriction but consists of sheets of plasma cells without an accompanying clonal small B-lymphocyte population and usually lacks MYD88 L265P.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Light-chain restriction is shared, so distinction relies on clinical IgM paraprotein, marrow pattern and MYD88 L265P status.
A true negative requires internal positive controls (and a successful kappa stain), because a failed probe can mimic lambda negativity.

62349.recognize_zh: 高倍下萎縮的生發中心內充滿粉紅色透明化物質與少量濾泡樹突細胞，一條透明化血管從下方斜向穿入，周圍小淋巴球一層層包繞，這種血管穿入萎縮生發中心加上層狀外套區就是透明血管型 Castleman 病的特徵。
features: Atretic germinal center composed of hyalinized eosinophilic deposits and scattered follicular dendritic/endothelial cells
Hyalinized vessel with plump endothelial cells penetrating obliquely into the germinal center
Surrounding mantle zone of small round lymphocytes with dense chromatin and scant cytoplasm arranged in layers
Lymphocytes are monotonous-appearing but cytologically bland without atypia
No mitotic activity, necrosis or large atypical cells evident
62349.describe_en: High-power view of a lymph node follicle shows a markedly atretic germinal center replaced by hyalinized eosinophilic material with scattered follicular dendritic and endothelial cells. A hyalinized vessel penetrates the germinal center from the periphery. The surrounding mantle zone is composed of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with round, dense nuclei, arranged in a layered fashion. There are no atypical large cells or mitotic figures. Findings are consistent with Castleman disease, hyaline vascular type.

ddx.vs: MCL cells have slightly irregular nuclei and are CD5/cyclin D1/SOX11-positive with light-chain restriction, while Castleman mantle lymphocytes are polyclonal IgD-positive and cyclin D1-negative.
HIV lymphadenitis shows follicle lysis and depletion with plasmacytosis in an appropriate clinical context rather than uniformly broad concentric mantles around multiple atretic centers.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell or HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease
ddx.vs: Those variants show sheets of interfollicular plasma cells, and HHV8-associated disease has LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zone, which are not evident in this field.

exam.answer_en: Hyaline vascular Castleman disease — atretic hyalinized germinal center penetrated by a vessel, surrounded by layered small lymphocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍指生發中心內粉紅透明物與殘存細胞，問其組成：萎縮的生發中心，以 follicular dendritic cells 與透明化血管為主，缺乏生發中心 B 細胞。
IHC：CD21/CD23 顯示擴大或不規則的 FDC meshwork；HHV-8 LANA-1 陰性；外套層小淋巴球 cyclin D1−、light chain polytypic。
Castleman 分類：unicentric（多為 hyaline vascular）、HHV-8 相關 MCD（多見於 HIV）、idiopathic MCD（含 TAFRO），以及 POEMS 相關 MCD。
iMCD 為 IL-6 驅動的全身發炎，治療首選 anti-IL-6 的 siltuximab；UCD 則以手術切除為主。
exam.pitfall_zh: 萎縮、透明化的生發中心易誤判為 follicular lymphoma 或 HIV 淋巴結病的退化期：FL 濾泡擴大、BCL2+ 且擁擠；本圖為縮小生發中心加層狀 polyclonal 外套層。

quiz.q: 圖中萎縮生發中心內殘存、核呈卵圓泡狀的細胞主要是什麼？可用哪兩個 IHC 凸顯？
quiz.a: Follicular dendritic cells；CD21 與 CD23

62285.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見大型紅血球前驅細胞，核染色質開放呈細點狀，細胞質從深藍到灰紫（多色性）不等，染色質成熟度落後於細胞質，部分細胞核形不規則，背景紅血球偏大且呈卵圓形，符合巨母紅血球性變化。
features: Large basophilic erythroblast with open chromatin and deep blue cytoplasm (upper field)
Polychromatic erythroblasts with stippled open chromatin despite gray-lilac hemoglobinizing cytoplasm
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony; some precursors with irregular nuclear outlines
Occasional small, dense late erythroblast for size comparison
Background oval macrocytes and scattered small platelets
62285.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid precursors at various stages of maturation that are enlarged for their stage. A large basophilic erythroblast with open chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm is present, and several polychromatic erythroblasts retain stippled open chromatin despite gray-lilac hemoglobinizing cytoplasm, indicating nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony; some show irregular nuclear contours. The background red cells include oval macrocytes. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis, as seen in vitamin B12 or folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: MDS megaloblastoid change coexists with dysplasia in other lineages or ring sideroblasts and does not correct with B12/folate.
These cause round macrocytes with normoblastic marrow maturation rather than oval macrocytes with megaloblastic precursors.
Normoblasts show progressive chromatin condensation synchronized with hemoglobinization, without enlarged cells or open chromatin in late forms.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia — stage-for-stage enlarged erythroblasts with stippled open chromatin despite hemoglobinized cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：比較上方大型 basophilic erythroblast 與旁邊小而緻密的晚期前驅細胞，問哪顆顯示 asynchrony：細胞質已灰紫色（血紅素化）但染色質仍開放的 polychromatic erythroblast。
B12 缺乏常見原因：pernicious anemia、胃切除、回腸切除或 Crohn disease、嚴格素食、metformin 或 PPI 長期使用、nitrous oxide 暴露。
Folate 缺乏常見原因：飲食不足、酒精、懷孕、溶血性貧血需求增加、methotrexate 或 trimethoprim 等藥物。
B12 缺乏合併神經症狀或吸收不良時，初期多以肌肉注射補充；口服高劑量也可用於部分病人。
exam.pitfall_zh: 早期大型紅血球前驅細胞易誤當 myeloblast：紅血球系前驅細胞細胞質深藍、常有核周淡染區、無顆粒，且可見同系成熟序列；必要時以 CD71/glycophorin 確認。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞質已呈灰紫色但核染色質仍開放點狀的細胞代表什麼現象？這是哪一類造血異常的標誌？
quiz.a: Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony；megaloblastic erythropoiesis（B12/folate 缺乏）

62221.recognize_zh: 淋巴結右半部由大型上皮樣（epithelioid）細胞片狀取代，細胞質豐富淡粉紅、核圓並有核仁，與左側小淋巴球區界線清楚；本圖未見黑色素，需免疫染色（S100、SOX10、Melan-A）確認為轉移性黑色素瘤。
features: Sharply demarcated sheet of large epithelioid cells replacing the right half of the node
Abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with round to oval vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli
Loosely cohesive growth without gland formation; no melanin pigment visible
Residual lymphoid tissue with a lymphoid follicle and small lymphocytes on the left
Congested vessels at the interface between tumor and lymphoid tissue
62221.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows residual lymphoid tissue with a follicle on the left and a sharply demarcated sheet of large epithelioid cells replacing the cortex on the right. The tumor cells have abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, round vesicular nuclei and conspicuous nucleoli, and grow in solid sheets without gland formation. Melanin pigment is not apparent at this magnification. Findings are consistent with metastatic malignant neoplasm, compatible with metastatic melanoma in the appropriate clinical and immunohistochemical context (S100, SOX10, Melan-A, HMB45).

ddx.vs: Carcinoma is more cohesive, may form glands or nests with desmoplasia, and is cytokeratin positive and melanocytic-marker negative.
ALCL cells often fill sinuses, include horseshoe-shaped hallmark cells and are CD30 positive (± ALK) and negative for S100/SOX10.
Nodal nevi are small bland melanocytes confined to the capsule or trabeculae, not large atypical cells with nucleoli replacing the parenchyma.
Histiocytes have bland nuclei and are sinusoidal; RDD cells show emperipolesis and are S100 positive but SOX10 and Melan-A negative.

62093.recognize_zh: A 圖 H&E 骨髓細胞稀少，脂肪細胞縮小，其間被淡粉紅、細顆粒狀的無定形膠狀物質填滿；B 圖 Alcian blue 將此物質染成藍色（富含玻尿酸），C 圖 S100 顯示萎縮的脂肪細胞外膜，符合漿液性脂肪萎縮（膠狀轉化）。
features: A (H&E): hypocellular marrow with small, atrophic adipocytes of variable size
Intertrabecular spaces filled with pale pink, finely granular amorphous extracellular material
Residual hematopoietic cells in thin cords between the gelatinous material
B (Alcian blue, pH 2.5): extracellular material stains blue, indicating acid mucopolysaccharide (hyaluronic acid)
C (S100): highlights shrunken, irregular atrophic adipocyte membranes
62093.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (A, H&E) shows a hypocellular marrow in which adipocytes are reduced in size and number and the intertrabecular spaces are occupied by pale pink, finely granular, amorphous extracellular material, with residual hematopoietic cells in thin cords. An Alcian blue stain at pH 2.5 (B) highlights the extracellular material blue, consistent with hyaluronic acid-rich ground substance, and S100 (C) outlines small atrophied adipocytes. There is no evidence of a neoplastic infiltrate in these panels. Findings are consistent with severe serous fat atrophy (gelatinous transformation) of the marrow, typically associated with starvation, anorexia, cachexia, or chronic malabsorption, which in this clinical setting mimics aplastic anemia.

ddx.vs: Aplastic marrow is replaced by normal-sized mature fat cells without extracellular Alcian blue-positive gelatinous material.
Amyloid is glassy eosinophilic, often perivascular, Congo red-positive with apple-green birefringence and Alcian blue-negative.
Edema is a paler fluid without mucopolysaccharide staining, and necrosis shows ghost cells and nuclear debris.
Myelofibrosis shows increased reticulin/collagen and atypical megakaryocytes, whereas reticulin was not increased here.
