62093.stain: H&E; Alcian blue pH 2.5; IHC: S100

exam.answer_en: Serous fat atrophy (gelatinous transformation) of bone marrow — hypocellular marrow with atrophic adipocytes and Alcian blue-positive extracellular hyaluronic acid
pearls_zh: 考法：H&E 指脂肪細胞間的淡粉紅無定形物質問是什麼，並問哪種特殊染色確認：Alcian blue（pH 2.5）陽性的酸性黏多醣（hyaluronic acid）。
常見原因：神經性厭食症、嚴重營養不良與惡病質、HIV/AIDS、慢性酒精使用、慢性消耗性疾病；營養改善後可逆轉。
周邊血常見血球低下（可三系）；病史重點為體重減輕與 BMI，治療核心是營養與原發病而非免疫抑制。
與 aplastic anemia 區分：aplastic anemia 為正常大小脂肪細胞取代造血組織、無膠狀基質；本病脂肪細胞縮小且間質為 Alcian blue 陽性物質。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 amyloid 沉積或骨髓水腫／壞死：amyloid 為 Congo red 陽性、偏光呈 apple-green birefringence 且 Alcian blue 不呈此型態；水腫無 Alcian blue 陽性基質。

quiz.q: B 圖中脂肪細胞間的物質經 Alcian blue 染成藍色，其成分為何？此骨髓變化最常見於哪一類病人？
quiz.a: Hyaluronic acid（酸性黏多醣）；嚴重營養不良／神經性厭食症或惡病質

61965.recognize_zh: Perforin染色在大量大型細胞的細胞質呈強烈、粗顆粒至瀰漫性棕色陽性，核周可見淡染的核，而小淋巴球多為陰性，表示腫瘤細胞具細胞毒性顆粒蛋白，符合ALCL的細胞毒性表型。
features: Strong granular to confluent cytoplasmic perforin staining in numerous large cells
Positive cells have abundant cytoplasm surrounding pale, vesicular nuclei
Positive cells arranged in clusters and sheets
Interspersed small lymphocytes negative
61965.describe_en: Perforin immunostain shows strong granular to confluent cytoplasmic staining in numerous large cells with abundant cytoplasm and pale vesicular nuclei, arranged in clusters and sheets, while interspersed small lymphocytes are negative. Expression of perforin by the large neoplastic cells indicates a cytotoxic phenotype, commonly seen in anaplastic large cell lymphoma, and supports T-cell lineage when pan-T antigens are diminished.

ddx.vs: ENKTL expresses perforin but is EBER-positive and CD56-positive with angiocentricity and necrosis, lacking uniform strong CD30 in hallmark cells.
Macrophage cytoplasm may show nonspecific granular staining, but histiocytes are CD163-positive and lack true perforin granules in atypical cells.

61901.recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片可見表皮內大片網狀退化（reticular degeneration）形成的水疱，下方真皮全層有致密的淋巴細胞浸潤並沿血管與附屬器分布，這種水疱加上深部淋巴浸潤的組合符合 HV 樣淋巴增生性疾病（HVLPD）。
features: Large intraepidermal vesicle formed by reticular degeneration, with strands of residual keratinocytes forming septa
Pale edematous papillary dermis beneath the vesicle
Dense lymphoid infiltrate throughout the full thickness of the dermis
Perivascular and periadnexal (perifollicular) accentuation of the infiltrate
Intact thin stratum corneum over the blister at this stage
61901.describe_en: Skin punch biopsy at low power shows a large intraepidermal multiloculated vesicle produced by reticular degeneration of keratinocytes, with residual keratinocyte strands forming septa beneath an intact stratum corneum. The underlying papillary dermis is edematous. A dense lymphoid infiltrate occupies the full thickness of the dermis with perivascular and periadnexal accentuation. Findings, together with an EBER-positive T-cell infiltrate, are consistent with hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Herpetic blisters show ballooning degeneration with multinucleated keratinocytes bearing steel-grey nuclear inclusions, which are not evident here, and the infiltrate is EBER negative.
PMLE shows marked papillary dermal edema with a superficial and deep perivascular lymphocytic infiltrate but lacks intraepidermal reticular vesiculation and EBER-positive cells.
ENKTL shows angiocentric destructive infiltrates with extensive necrosis and CD56-positive cells, rather than photodistributed vesiculation.
Bite reactions show a wedge-shaped superficial and deep infiltrate rich in eosinophils and are EBER negative.

61837.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆漿細胞的細胞質塞滿數十個淡藍色、圓形的球狀包涵體（Russell bodies），把核擠到一旁，看起來像一串葡萄；這就是 Mott 細胞，周圍是成熟嗜中性球。
features: Single plasma cell with cytoplasm packed by numerous round, pale blue, refractile globules (Russell bodies)
Globules of fairly uniform size, giving a grape-cluster or mulberry appearance
Nucleus partly obscured and displaced by the inclusions
Surrounding mature segmented neutrophils and band forms
Background red cells and scattered myeloid precursors; smear has a bluish color cast
61837.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a plasma cell whose cytoplasm is distended by numerous round, uniform, pale blue globular inclusions (Russell bodies), displacing and partially obscuring the nucleus, surrounded by mature neutrophils and band forms. These inclusions represent accumulated, incompletely secreted immunoglobulin. Mott cells are not specific for neoplasia and occur in reactive plasmacytosis, but in the context of a clonal plasma cell proliferation the findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with Mott cell morphology.

ddx.vs: Mott cells also occur in reactive conditions, so clonality must be established by kappa/lambda restriction and plasma cell percentage rather than by the inclusions themselves.
Macrophages have abundant pale cytoplasm with heterogeneous debris and a reniform nucleus, not uniform homogeneous globules in a plasma cell.
Pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules are large azurophilic/eosinophilic granules in myeloid blasts rather than pale blue immunoglobulin globules in a plasma cell.

ddx.dx: Vacuolated plasma cells or lymphoma cells
ddx.vs: Empty lipid or artifact vacuoles appear clear rather than as pale blue, solid, refractile globules.

exam.answer_en: Mott cell — plasma cell with cytoplasm packed by multiple Russell bodies (grape cell), here in plasma cell myeloma
pearls_zh: 考法：指中央這顆「一串葡萄」狀的細胞問名稱，答 Mott cell（grape/morula cell）；再問胞質內球體是什麼：Russell bodies，即滯留在擴張 ER 內的免疫球蛋白。
Russell body 位於胞質；Dutcher body 看似核內包涵體（實為胞質內陷入核），PAS+，常見於 lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma/WM，也可見於骨髓瘤。
Mott cell 本身不代表惡性：反應性漿細胞增多（慢性發炎、自體免疫、感染）也會出現，是否為骨髓瘤要看克隆性（κ/λ 限制）與漿細胞比例。
確認克隆性：CD138 IHC 計數、κ/λ ISH 或 flow（胞質輕鏈），flow 上腫瘤漿細胞常 CD19−、CD45−/dim、CD56+。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為吞噬物質的巨噬細胞或 Chediak-Higashi 巨大顆粒：Mott cell 仍有漿細胞偏心核與深藍胞質，球體大小一致、淡藍透亮；巨噬細胞核較淡且吞噬物大小不一。

quiz.q: 圖中央這顆胞質塞滿淡藍球體的細胞叫什麼？這些球體的成分是什麼？
quiz.a: Mott cell；Russell bodies，為堆積在 ER 內未分泌的免疫球蛋白。

61773.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下有許多大型組織球，細胞質豐富淡粉紅、核圓且泡狀帶明顯核仁，細胞質內包含完整的淋巴球與漿細胞（emperipolesis，右下角尤其明顯），背景有大量淋巴球、漿細胞，符合 Rosai-Dorfman disease。
features: Numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic to foamy cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Histiocyte nuclei are round to oval and vesicular with a distinct central nucleolus; occasional binucleate forms
Emperipolesis: intact lymphocytes and plasma cells within histiocyte cytoplasm, often surrounded by a clear halo (e.g. lower right cluster)
Background of small lymphocytes, many plasma cells and scattered neutrophils
Loose, somewhat dyscohesive architecture with clear spaces and a few red cells
61773.describe_en: Sections show a cellular infiltrate of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with distinct nucleoli, set in a background rich in small lymphocytes and plasma cells. Many histiocytes contain intact lymphocytes and plasma cells within their cytoplasm (emperipolesis), several surrounded by clear halos. No significant nuclear atypia, necrosis or Reed-Sternberg-like cells are evident in this field. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease; confirmation with S100 and OCT2 positivity and CD1a/langerin negativity is recommended.

ddx.vs: Langerhans cells are smaller with grooved, reniform 'coffee-bean' nuclei, eosinophil-rich background and CD1a/langerin positivity, without emperipolesis.
Histiocytes are smaller with bland nuclei, S100 negative, and lack conspicuous emperipolesis.
Features foamy lipid-laden histiocytes with Touton giant cells and fibrosis, S100 usually negative/weak and BRAF V600E frequent.
Contains CD30/CD15-positive Reed-Sternberg cells with macronucleoli, and histiocytes do not show emperipolesis.

exam.answer_en: Rosai-Dorfman disease — large pale histiocytes with vesicular nuclei showing emperipolesis of intact lymphocytes and plasma cells
pearls_zh: 考法：指組織球胞質內完整、帶透明暈的淋巴球/漿細胞，問現象名稱：emperipolesis（被吞入細胞仍存活、未被分解），是 RDD 的關鍵線索。
IHC：病灶組織球 S100+、OCT2+、cyclin D1+、CD68+/CD163+，CD1a−、langerin(CD207)−；S100 染色可把胞質內未染色的淋巴球凸顯出來。
臨床典型：年輕人雙側無痛性巨大頸部淋巴結腫大（sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy）、發燒、多株性高γ球蛋白血症；部分帶 KRAS/MAP2K1 突變。
淋巴結結構：病灶位於擴張的淋巴竇內；RDD 可與 IgG4 陽性漿細胞增加並存，需注意勿直接診斷為 IgG4-related disease。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 HLH 的 hemophagocytosis 或 LCH：吞噬血球時被吞細胞會變性分解且常含紅血球；LCH 核有核溝、伴嗜伊紅球且 CD1a+/langerin+。

quiz.q: 圖中大型組織球胞質內含完整淋巴球的現象叫什麼？這些組織球 S100 與 CD1a 染色結果為何？
quiz.a: Emperipolesis；S100 陽性、CD1a 陰性（Rosai-Dorfman disease）。

61709.recognize_zh: G 帶染色的男性核型圖，23 對染色體（含 X、Y）數目完整、未標示箭頭，第 15 與 17 號外觀成對無明顯易位；在 APL 病例中，看似正常的核型提示 PML::RARA 可能為隱匿性（cryptic）重組。
features: G-banded karyotype arranged 1-22, X, Y (male)
46 chromosomes with no numerical abnormality apparent
No arrows or visible structural rearrangements marked
Chromosomes 15 and 17 appear as normal pairs at this band resolution
Low-to-moderate banding resolution limits detection of subtle changes
61709.describe_en: G-banded karyotype shows an apparently normal male complement, 46,XY, with no numerical or obvious structural abnormalities at this banding resolution. In particular, a t(15;17)(q24;q21) is not visible, and chromosomes 15 and 17 appear paired normally. In a patient with suspected acute promyelocytic leukemia, a normal karyotype does not exclude the diagnosis, because PML::RARA can arise from cryptic insertions or submicroscopic rearrangements detectable only by FISH or RT-PCR.

61645.recognize_zh: 中高倍下一大片密集的較大細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、可見小核仁、細胞質淡嗜鹼性，與左上方含成熟顆粒球及紅血球的正常骨髓分界清楚；這些群聚的未成熟細胞經 glycophorin 證實為紅系前驅細胞，是 PCM1::JAK2 腫瘤的特徵。
features: Dense cohesive sheet of medium to large immature cells with round nuclei
Fine chromatin with small visible nucleoli and pale basophilic cytoplasm
Occasional mitotic figures within the aggregate
Sharp interface with adjacent maturing myeloid marrow containing red cells
Small blood vessel at lower left
61645.describe_en: The bone marrow biopsy shows a dense, cohesive sheet of medium to large immature cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and pale basophilic cytoplasm, sharply demarcated from the adjacent marrow with maturing myeloid elements. Occasional mitoses are present within the aggregate. On H&E the differential includes blasts, immature erythroid precursors and non-hematopoietic tumor; glycophorin C immunostaining identifies these cells as immature erythroid precursors. Findings are consistent with the expanded immature erythroid islands characteristic of myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PCM1::JAK2.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are CD34/CD117 positive and glycophorin/E-cadherin negative.
Morphologically similar immature erythroid sheets, but PEL has more than 80% erythroid cells with at least 30% proerythroblasts and TP53/complex karyotype rather than a JAK2 fusion with eosinophilia.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor or carcinoma
ddx.vs: Tumor cells are keratin or other lineage marker positive, CD45 and glycophorin negative, often with desmoplastic stroma.
Megaloblastic erythroid hyperplasia shows open-chromatin precursors with maturation, nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant bands, with low B12/folate.

61581.recognize_zh: 右小腿皮膚布滿紅紫色丘疹與隆起圓頂狀結節，大小從數毫米到約 1.5 公分，有些聚集成群；病變明顯高出皮面、非平坦紫斑，在 AML 病人提示 leukemia cutis。
features: Numerous red-violet papules and elevated dome-shaped nodules over the lower leg
Size heterogeneity from 2–3 mm papules to nodules about 1–1.5 cm, some in small clusters
Lesions are raised and infiltrated rather than flat purpuric macules
No ulceration, necrosis, crusting or scale
61581.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the lower right leg shows innumerable red-violet papules and raised smooth dome-shaped nodules of variable size, some clustered, distributed over the anterior and lateral surfaces without ulceration or scale. The lesions appear infiltrated rather than purpuric. In a patient with acute myeloid leukemia these findings are suggestive of leukemia cutis; biopsy is needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Vasculitis on the legs produces smaller, uniform palpable purpura that may become vesicular or necrotic, with leukocytoclastic vasculitis rather than a blast infiltrate on biopsy.
Erythema nodosum forms few, tender, poorly circumscribed deep nodules on the shins without overlying papules, and shows septal panniculitis histologically.
Purple nodules on the lower legs may mimic this, but biopsy shows HHV8+ spindle cells and slit-like vascular channels.

61517.recognize_zh: 六個箭頭指出核小而圓、濃縮深染的有核紅血球（NRBC），右下方其中一顆緊鄰一個較大、核染色質較鬆的淋巴球，可直接比較兩者大小與核形；背景大量鋸齒狀紅血球與粉紫色顆粒沉澱，NRBC 數量明顯偏多。
features: Six arrowed nucleated red cells with small, round, dense pyknotic nuclei and scant surrounding cytoplasm
Adjacent larger lymphocyte (lower right) with a bigger, less condensed nucleus for size comparison
Background red cells show crenation, anisocytosis, and some target-like or hypochromic forms
Abundant pink-purple granular precipitate or platelet debris between cells
Suboptimal, bluish staining and uneven smear thickness limit fine morphologic detail
61517.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous nucleated red cells (arrows) with small, round, densely pyknotic nuclei and scant cytoplasm; one lies adjacent to a larger lymphocyte, illustrating the difference in nuclear size and chromatin. The background red cells show anisocytosis, target-like and hypochromic forms, and widespread crenation that is likely artifactual. Granular precipitate and bluish staining limit evaluation of platelets and red cell inclusions. With an NRBC-to-WBC ratio exceeding 100 per 100 WBC, the automated WBC count must be corrected, and a thalassemia, hemolytic, or marrow-infiltrative process should be investigated.

ddx.vs: As shown by the neighboring lymphocyte, lymphocytes are larger with a less dense nucleus and a blue cytoplasmic rim, whereas NRBCs have tiny, homogeneously pyknotic nuclei.
Thalassemia is supported by prominent target cells and hypochromia with NRBCs, and is confirmed by hemoglobin HPLC and globin gene studies.
After splenectomy, NRBCs are accompanied by Howell-Jolly bodies, acanthocytes, and target cells, with a history of splenectomy.
A leukoerythroblastic reaction includes immature granulocytes and teardrop cells in addition to NRBCs.

61453.recognize_zh: G 帶染色核型圖中，第 7 號染色體位置只剩一條（已圈起），其他常染色體皆成對，性染色體為 X 與 Y，即 45,XY,-7 單體 7；用於慢性骨髓單核球性白血病（CMML）的預後分層。
features: G-banded karyotype arranged by chromosome number from a bone marrow metaphase
Only one chromosome 7 is present (circled), indicating monosomy 7
All other autosomes are paired; sex chromosomes X and Y present (Y faintly stained)
No marker chromosome identified (empty 'mar' slot)
Band resolution is modest; subtle structural changes cannot be excluded from this single karyogram
61453.describe_en: G-banded karyogram from an unstimulated bone marrow culture shows a male complement with loss of one chromosome 7, with the remaining homologs paired and no marker chromosomes, interpreted as 45,XY,-7. A single karyogram does not establish clonality; ISCN requires the same chromosome loss in at least three metaphases. Monosomy 7 is a recurrent abnormality in myeloid neoplasms and places CMML in a high-risk cytogenetic category (CPSS). Correlation with FISH for 7q31/CEP7 and the marrow morphology is recommended.

ddx.vs: Non-clonal random loss seen in a single metaphase is not reportable; clonality requires three metaphases with the same loss.
Interstitial or terminal 7q deletion leaves two chromosome 7s, one shortened, rather than a missing homolog.

ddx.dx: Constitutional monosomy 7 mosaicism / germline predisposition (GATA2, SAMD9/SAMD9L)
ddx.vs: Suspected in younger patients and requires non-hematopoietic tissue or germline testing rather than marrow karyotype alone.

61389.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 可見左下方一大片致密、嗜鹼性的發炎細胞浸潤，由潰瘍處向深部延伸，侵入平滑肌束與脂肪組織（右上），邊界相對清楚；在此解析度下潰瘍表面的壞死滲出物不明顯。
features: Dense, band-like basophilic inflammatory infiltrate occupying the lower left of the section
Infiltrate extends deeply into smooth muscle bundles (muscularis propria) and reaches adipose tissue at upper right
Relatively well-demarcated border between the infiltrate and deeper tissue
Pale eosinophilic areas suggestive of fibrinoid necrosis or granulation tissue along the lower left
Cellular detail is not resolvable at this magnification
61389.describe_en: Low-power examination shows a dense, band-like lymphohistiocytic infiltrate extending from the ulcerated surface deep into smooth muscle bundles and the adjacent adipose tissue, with a relatively sharp deep interface. Pale eosinophilic areas at the lower left likely correspond to fibrinoid necrosis or ulcer bed, although a distinct necrotic surface slough is not clearly identified in this field. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. The architecture of a deep, well-circumscribed ulcer-associated infiltrate is compatible with EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer in the appropriate clinical and immunophenotypic context.

ddx.vs: Granulation tissue and mixed inflammation lack the dense lymphoid band and the large EBER-positive HRS-like cells seen at higher power.
Forms a destructive, expansile mass with sheets of large cells rather than a circumscribed ulcer with a polymorphous infiltrate and a sharp deep border.
Transmural lymphoid aggregates with non-necrotizing granulomas and fissuring ulcers, without atypical large cells.

61325.recognize_zh: 這是一張組合圖：A、B 抹片中有母細胞、嗜鹼性球及含深色粗顆粒的異常嗜酸性球；C 核型圖以箭頭標出 9、22 號與 16 號染色體異常；D-F 的 FISH 分別顯示 BCR-ABL1 融合訊號與 CBFB 斷裂分離訊號，連嗜中性球也帶有兩者。
features: Panels A-B: blasts with fine chromatin admixed with maturing granulocytes
Abnormal eosinophils with coarse dark basophilic-appearing granules and increased basophils (arrows)
Panel C: G-banded karyotype with arrows marking abnormal chromosomes 9, 22, and 16, consistent with t(9;22) and inv(16)
Panel D: metaphase FISH showing BCR::ABL1 fusion signals
Panel E: CBFB break-apart probe showing split signals
Panel F: interphase FISH demonstrating both BCR::ABL1 fusion and CBFB rearrangement in neutrophils
61325.describe_en: This composite figure shows marrow/blood smears (A, B) with increased blasts, basophils, and abnormal eosinophils containing coarse dark granules. The G-banded karyotype (C) demonstrates rearrangements involving chromosomes 9 and 22 together with an inversion of chromosome 16, and metaphase FISH confirms a BCR::ABL1 fusion (D) and CBFB rearrangement (E). Interphase FISH shows both abnormalities within mature neutrophils (F), indicating that they coexist in the same clone with myeloid maturation. The findings describe acute myeloid leukemia with coexistent t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) and inv(16)(p13.1q22); the differential with myeloid blast phase of CML requires clinical history.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia, myeloid blast phase with inv(16) as additional abnormality
ddx.vs: Blast phase of CML is supported by a preceding chronic phase or marked basophilia and splenomegaly, and cannot be separated from de novo AML by morphology alone.
De novo AML with BCR::ABL1 lacks the CBFB::MYH11 rearrangement and typically has no prior CML history or marked basophilia.

ddx.dx: AML with inv(16); CBFB::MYH11 without BCR::ABL1
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, but FISH/karyotype lack the BCR::ABL1 fusion, which carries different therapy (TKI) implications.

61261.recognize_zh: 箭頭處是一團黏聚的大型細胞，細胞質大量淡藍到深藍、邊緣模糊，核大、圓至橢圓、染色質細緻、有小核仁，核大小不一，與周圍模糊的紅血球背景相比明顯是非造血來源的上皮細胞團，符合骨髓轉移性腺癌。
features: Cohesive cluster of about a dozen large cells with overlapping, poorly defined borders (arrow)
Large round to oval nuclei with moderate size variation, finely granular chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant pale to deep blue, somewhat frothy cytoplasm with ragged edges
Small dark blue irregular bodies overlying several nuclei, most likely platelets or stain precipitate rather than mitoses
Few background hematopoietic cells; eyepiece photograph with blurred background
61261.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large cells with abundant basophilic, frothy cytoplasm, overlapping borders and large round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate anisonucleosis. Small dark bodies overlying several nuclei likely represent platelets or precipitate. These cells are distinct from normal marrow elements in size and cohesion. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma involving the bone marrow; immunohistochemistry on the biopsy is recommended to confirm and to suggest the primary site.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts show uniform eccentric nuclei with a pale Golgi zone away from the nucleus and lack anisonucleosis.
Histiocytes have smaller bean-shaped nuclei with vacuolated cytoplasm containing debris or hemosiderin.
Sarcoma cells are usually less cohesive, may be spindled or multinucleated and are keratin negative with lineage-specific markers.
Cells may cluster but have horseshoe-shaped hallmark nuclei and are CD30/ALK positive and keratin negative.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic adenocarcinoma in bone marrow — cohesive cluster of large cells with abundant frothy basophilic cytoplasm and anisonucleosis
pearls_zh: 考法：指著箭頭處細胞團，問細胞來源；答題關鍵字是 cohesive cluster、overlapping borders、體積大於所有正常骨髓細胞 → 非造血轉移性癌。
骨髓轉移常見原發：成人為乳癌、攝護腺癌、肺癌；兒童則為 neuroblastoma、rhabdomyosarcoma 等 small round blue cell tumor。
確認與原發部位：切片做 pan-cytokeratin 陽性／CD45 陰性，再加 CK7、CK20、TTF-1、CDX2、GATA3 等 panel；抽吸常因骨髓纖維化而 dry tap，切片較可靠。
臨床意義：骨髓轉移代表 stage IV，常以不明原因血球低下、leukoerythroblastic picture 或 ALP 上升表現。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 macrophage 聚集或 osteoblast 團：巨噬細胞核較小呈豆形、胞質含碎屑或含鐵血黃素，osteoblast 核偏位且一致；此團核大小不一且彼此重疊黏聚，支持癌細胞。

quiz.q: 箭頭處這團細胞與周圍造血細胞相比，哪兩項特徵提示是轉移性癌？
quiz.a: 細胞彼此黏聚成團（cohesive）且體積明顯大於造血細胞、核大小不一

61197.recognize_zh: 背景中散佈大量短胖的藍色桿菌，並可見被嗜中性球與單核細胞吞噬的細胞內桿菌；紅血球內有 Howell-Jolly 小體（箭頭）及刺狀紅血球，提示無脾狀態下的革蘭氏陰性桿菌敗血症。
features: Numerous extracellular short, plump, blue-staining bacilli scattered throughout the smear background
Intracellular bacilli within a neutrophil (lower left) and within a vacuole of a mononuclear cell (top)
Howell-Jolly bodies in red cells (arrows), consistent with asplenia
Marked poikilocytosis with echinocytic/spiculated cells, teardrop forms and polychromatic red cells
A small dense nucleated cell with adherent bacilli (right), likely a nucleated red cell
61197.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows abundant extracellular short bacilli throughout the film, with phagocytosed bacilli in a neutrophil and in a vacuole of a mononuclear cell. Red cells show poikilocytosis with spiculated cells, teardrop forms and polychromasia, and Howell-Jolly bodies are present (arrows), indicating hyposplenism or asplenia. Bacteremia of this magnitude visible on a routine smear indicates overwhelming sepsis; in a patient with pyruvate kinase deficiency and asplenia, the findings are consistent with fulminant gram-negative bacillary sepsis (Klebsiella pneumoniae on culture). Gram stain and blood culture are needed for organism identification.

ddx.dx: Stain precipitate or contaminating bacteria in stain/water
ddx.vs: Contaminants lie on top of cells in varying focal planes and are never phagocytosed, whereas here bacilli are clearly within neutrophil vacuoles.
Capnocytophaga appears as thin fusiform elongated rods, whereas these are short plump bacilli; culture identifies the organism.
Pappenheimer bodies are clustered small granules within red cells that are Prussian blue positive, unlike the single round Howell-Jolly bodies and extracellular rods.
Debris is irregular and variably sized, lacking the uniform rod morphology and intracellular phagocytosis of bacteria.

exam.answer_en: Overwhelming gram-negative bacillary sepsis in asplenia — extracellular and phagocytosed bacilli on smear with Howell-Jolly bodies
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指背景短胖藍色桿菌與中性球內被吞噬的桿菌，問代表什麼 → 高菌量菌血症（overwhelming sepsis）；再指紅血球內圓形小點（Howell-Jolly body），問代表 → 無脾或脾功能低下。
臨床意義：常規抹片能看到細菌表示菌量極高、預後極差，屬急症，應立即通報、抽血培養並給廣效抗生素，不等培養結果；buffy coat 抹片可提高偵測率。
無脾患者（overwhelming post-splenectomy infection, OPSI）最典型病原為莢膜菌：S. pneumoniae、H. influenzae、N. meningitidis；需接種相關疫苗並教育發燒即就醫。
PK deficiency 脾切除後網狀紅血球反而上升，抹片可見 echinocyte 樣棘狀紅血球（prickle cells）；本圖的棘狀紅血球與多染性細胞與此相符。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常把細菌誤認為染液沉澱或污染菌：污染物位於細胞上方不同焦平面且大小不一，不會被吞噬；本圖桿菌形態一致並位於中性球空泡內，為真實菌血症。Howell-Jolly body 亦勿與 Pappenheimer bodies 混淆。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球內箭頭所指的單一圓形小點稱為什麼？代表病人哪種狀態？
quiz.a: Howell-Jolly body；無脾或脾功能低下（asplenia/hyposplenism）

61133.recognize_zh: 表皮棘層內有一個由數顆深染、核不規則的淋巴球聚集而成、周圍有空隙的小團（Pautrier 微膿瘍），基底層附近也可見帶透明空暈（halo）的淋巴球，而周圍角質細胞海綿化輕微，符合蕈狀肉芽腫。
features: Intraepidermal collection of atypical lymphocytes within a clear space in the spinous layer (Pautrier microabscess)
Lymphocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular to cerebriform nuclei, larger than dermal lymphocytes
Haloed lymphocytes (clear perinuclear space) in the basal and lower spinous layers
Epidermotropism with little accompanying spongiosis
Papillary dermis with mild fibrosis and scattered lymphocytes with irregular nuclei
61133.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows a mildly acanthotic epidermis containing an intraepidermal cluster of atypical lymphocytes with hyperchromatic, convoluted nuclei lying within a clear space, consistent with a Pautrier microabscess. Additional single haloed lymphocytes are present in the basal and lower spinous layers, and epidermotropism is disproportionate to the minimal spongiosis. The papillary dermis shows wiry collagen with scattered lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with mycosis fungoides, patch/plaque stage, in the appropriate clinical and immunophenotypic context.

ddx.dx: Spongiotic dermatitis with Langerhans cell microvesicles
ddx.vs: Langerhans cell microgranulomas contain pale reniform-nucleated histiocytic cells in a spongiotic vesicle, rather than hyperchromatic cerebriform lymphocytes without spongiosis.
Lichenoid reactions show basal vacuolar damage, Civatte bodies and a band-like infiltrate of non-atypical lymphocytes.
ATLL can show Pautrier-like microabscesses; separation needs HTLV-1 serology, CD25 expression and peripheral blood flower cells.

ddx.dx: Pagetoid melanoma in situ or Paget disease
ddx.vs: Pagetoid tumor cells have abundant pale cytoplasm and are SOX10 or CK7 positive, not CD3-positive lymphocytes.

exam.answer_en: Mycosis fungoides — epidermotropic atypical cerebriform lymphocytes forming a Pautrier microabscess with minimal spongiosis
pearls_zh: 考法：指表皮內空隙中聚集的深染淋巴球問名稱 → Pautrier microabscess；也常考 haloed lymphocytes 與「epidermotropism 不成比例於 spongiosis」。
免疫表型：典型為 CD3+、CD4+、CD8−，常失去 CD7（及 CD26）；少數為 CD8+ 變異型，TCR 克隆性可輔助診斷。
病程：patch → plaque → tumor；早期 patch 期切片常不典型，需多點切片並結合臨床。Sézary syndrome 為紅皮症、淋巴結腫大加血中 Sézary cells。
Large cell transformation（大細胞佔浸潤 >25% 或形成結節）代表預後較差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為海綿狀皮膚炎的 Langerhans cell microvesicle；後者為淡染腎形核組織球且伴明顯海綿化，Pautrier 則為深染腦迴狀核淋巴球、海綿化輕微。

quiz.q: 表皮棘層內圍繞空隙聚集的非典型淋巴球叫什麼？此病典型免疫表型為何？
quiz.a: Pautrier microabscess；CD3+ CD4+ CD8−，常 CD7 loss（mycosis fungoides）

61069.recognize_zh: PET-CT 軸切面顯示右側前縱膈有一個與心臟大小相近、緊貼心臟且 FDG 高攝取的巨大腫塊，看起來像第二顆心臟（double-heart sign）；切片為單一形態的中小型芽細胞成片排列，插圖核染色瀰漫陽性（推測為 TdT）。
features: PET-CT (A): large, intensely FDG-avid anterior mediastinal mass abutting the right heart border, similar in size to the heart (double-heart appearance)
Histology (B): diffuse sheets of monotonous small to intermediate lymphoid cells
High N:C ratio with round to slightly convoluted nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scattered mitotic figures/apoptotic cells within the sheets
Inset IHC: diffuse strong nuclear positivity in tumor cells (antibody not labeled; pattern typical of TdT)
61069.describe_en: Axial PET-CT shows a large, intensely FDG-avid anterior mediastinal mass abutting the right cardiac border and approximating the heart in size, producing a double-heart appearance. Biopsy shows diffuse sheets of monotonous small to intermediate cells with high N:C ratios, finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. A nuclear immunostain, most likely TdT, is diffusely positive in the tumor cells. Findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic lymphoma presenting as a mediastinal mass, to be confirmed with CD3, CD1a, CD34 and CD99 immunostains.

ddx.dx: Thymoma (type B1/B2) with immature T cells
ddx.vs: Thymoma contains keratin-positive epithelial cells with lobulated fibrous septa, and its TdT+ thymocytes are admixed with epithelial meshworks rather than forming pure sheets.
PMBL consists of large CD20+/CD23+/PD-L1+ cells with clear cytoplasm and compartmentalizing sclerosis, and is TdT-negative.
cHL shows fibrous bands and scattered CD30+/CD15+ lacunar cells in a mixed inflammatory background rather than monotonous TdT+ blasts.
Seminoma cells are larger with clear cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, OCT3/4 and SALL4 positive, and CD45/TdT negative.

exam.answer_en: T-lymphoblastic lymphoma — bulky FDG-avid anterior mediastinal mass (double-heart sign) with sheets of TdT+ lymphoblasts
pearls_zh: 考法：先看 PET-CT 指出前縱膈巨大腫塊，再看切片問細胞類型；插圖核染色（TdT）代表前驅淋巴芽細胞。
免疫表型：cytoplasmic CD3+、TdT+，常 CD1a+、CD99+、CD34±；CD4/CD8 可雙陽或雙陰。
臨床急症：巨大前縱膈腫塊可致 superior vena cava syndrome 與氣道壓迫，鎮靜/全身麻醉有心肺驟停風險；治療初期注意 tumor lysis syndrome。
T-LBL 與 T-ALL 為同一疾病的不同表現；以腫塊為主、骨髓芽細胞 <25% 時習慣稱為 lymphoma。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 thymoma（B1/B2），其亦含 TdT+ 不成熟胸腺細胞；但胸腺瘤有 keratin+ 上皮網絡與分葉纖維隔，T-LBL 為純芽細胞成片。

quiz.q: PET-CT 上的巨大前縱膈腫塊加上插圖核陽性（TdT）的單一小型芽細胞，最可能診斷？
quiz.a: T-lymphoblastic lymphoma

61005.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中央有一顆小型巨核細胞，細胞質粉紅，核分成數個分離的小圓核（核分離／多核狀），屬發育不良型巨核細胞；背景有許多分葉或帶狀核的顆粒球，提示 MDS/MPN（如 aCML）中的骨髓系增生與發育異常。
features: Small megakaryocyte with eosinophilic cytoplasm and multiple widely separated, round nuclear lobes (dysplastic, 'separated nuclei')
Numerous maturing granulocytic cells with band, ring-like and segmented nuclei
Scattered larger cells with open chromatin and nucleoli (immature myeloid or erythroid precursors)
A round cell with a thick, dark ring-shaped outline and pale center (possibly a ring-shaped nucleus or artifact) center-right
Loose, partially disrupted section with scattered red cells; fine detail limited by section quality
61005.describe_en: High-power bone marrow section (likely clot or biopsy) shows a hypercellular population of maturing granulocytes with band and segmented nuclei and scattered immature precursors with open chromatin and nucleoli. A small megakaryocyte in the center contains multiple widely separated round nuclear lobes, a dysplastic feature. A ring-shaped structure at center-right may represent a ring nucleus but cannot be characterized confidently at this resolution. The section is somewhat disrupted, limiting evaluation of architecture. In the appropriate clinical and genetic context (BCR::ABL1-negative leukocytosis with dysgranulopoiesis), the findings are consistent with atypical CML.

ddx.vs: MDS shares megakaryocytic dysplasia but lacks the leukocytosis with >=10% circulating immature granulocytes that defines aCML.
CML megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated ('dwarf') rather than having separated nuclear lobes, and BCR::ABL1 is detected.
PMF megakaryocytes are large, clustered, with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei, accompanied by reticulin fibrosis and a JAK2/CALR/MPL driver.
Tangential sectioning can mimic separated lobes, but true dysplasia is reproducible across many megakaryocytes and on aspirate smears.

60941.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量小至中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、核質比極高、染色質均勻細緻而不呈芽細胞樣、幾乎無核仁與細胞質，與成熟中的顆粒球系及紅血球系細胞混雜；在移植後第 30 天再生期，這是骨髓 hematogones 增生。
features: Numerous small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with very high N:C ratio and scant rim of cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nuclei with homogeneous, smudged-dense chromatin and no or inconspicuous nucleoli
Size spectrum from small lymphocyte to slightly larger cells, lacking a monotonous blast population
Admixed maturing myeloid precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band/segmented neutrophils) and a monocyte
Vacuolated/degenerated background with occasional platelets
60941.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows a marked increase in small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with round to slightly indented nuclei, homogeneous condensed chromatin, absent or inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, forming a continuous spectrum in size. These are admixed with orderly maturing granulocytic precursors and occasional monocytes, without a discrete population of large blasts. In a day-30 post-allogeneic transplant marrow, findings are consistent with regenerative hematogone hyperplasia; flow cytometry showing a normal maturational continuum of CD34/CD10/CD20 expression without aberrancies confirms benignity.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts form a monotonous population with finer chromatin and nucleoli, and by flow show maturation arrest with aberrant antigen expression (e.g., CD58 bright, CD38 dim, myeloid antigens) instead of a continuum.

ddx.dx: Mature small B-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are CD34/CD10/TdT negative with surface light-chain restriction and usually form interstitial or nodular aggregates.
Mature lymphocytes have more cytoplasm and clumped chromatin and are CD3+ rather than TdT/CD10+ B-cell precursors.
Tumor cells form cohesive clumps or rosettes and are CD45 negative.

exam.answer_en: Hematogone hyperplasia in regenerating post-transplant marrow — spectrum of small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with homogeneous chromatin and scant cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：移植後第 30 天骨髓出現大量小淋巴樣細胞，考官問「復發還是再生」→ 形態支持 hematogones（連續大小光譜、染色質均勻、無明顯核仁），但需 flow 確認。
Flow 關鍵：hematogones 呈 CD34/TdT → CD10 → CD20 連續成熟且 CD38 強、CD45 逐漸增強；B-ALL MRD 則有群聚且異常表型，如 CD58 bright、CD38 dim、CD10 異常強或弱。
移植或化療後再生期、兒童與多種反應性情況 hematogones 可大量增加，數量多寡本身不代表惡性；比對診斷時的 leukemia-associated immunophenotype 最有幫助。
移植後評估也應併做 chimerism 分析；若病人原為 B-ALL，可加做分子 MRD（如 IG/TR 重組或融合基因）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤判為 B-ALL 復發：lymphoblast 通常較大、表型均一、可見核仁且缺乏連續成熟光譜；hematogones 大小不一、染色質均勻緻密，流式呈正常成熟連續體。

quiz.q: 移植後第 30 天骨髓見圖中大量染色質均勻的小淋巴樣細胞，最可能是什麼？與 B-ALL 復發區分的檢查及關鍵發現為何？
quiz.a: Hematogones（再生性增生）；flow cytometry 顯示 CD34/TdT→CD10→CD20 正常連續成熟、無異常表型

60877.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間的髓腔幾乎全部是脂肪空泡，只有極少數散在細胞與出血，看不到造血細胞群或巨核細胞，對青少年而言明顯低於年齡應有的細胞量，符合再生不良性貧血。
features: Low-power trephine core with intertrabecular spaces almost entirely replaced by fat (markedly hypocellular for age)
Rare scattered interstitial cells; no identifiable hematopoietic clusters or megakaryocytes at this magnification
Focal hemorrhage/extravasated red cells along the right edge
Bony trabeculae with irregular dark basophilic staining, likely processing/decalcification artifact
No fibrosis, infiltrate or granulomas evident
60877.describe_en: Low-power image of a hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow trephine biopsy shows bony trabeculae separated by marrow spaces that are diffusely and almost completely occupied by adipose tissue. Hematopoietic elements are virtually absent, with only rare scattered interstitial cells and a focus of hemorrhage; megakaryocytes are not identified at this magnification. The trabeculae show patchy basophilic staining, likely a processing artifact. No fibrosis or abnormal infiltrate is seen. Findings represent a markedly hypocellular marrow for age, consistent with aplastic anemia in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Hypoplastic MDS contains residual foci with dysplastic megakaryocytes, abnormally localized immature precursors or increased CD34+ cells, which are not seen here.

ddx.dx: Inherited bone marrow failure (e.g., Fanconi anemia, telomere biology disorders)
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; chromosome breakage studies, telomere length and germline genetic testing are required, especially in a teenager.

ddx.dx: Paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria with marrow hypoplasia
ddx.vs: Marrow can look the same; PNH is separated by flow cytometry showing loss of GPI-anchored proteins (FLAER/CD59) on granulocytes and red cells.
Subcortical marrow is physiologically hypocellular; true aplasia shows uniform fat replacement across a core of adequate length with multiple intertrabecular spaces as here.

exam.answer_en: Aplastic anemia — markedly hypocellular trephine with intertrabecular spaces diffusely replaced by fat, hematopoiesis virtually absent
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍切片，考官問「估計細胞量多少？合乎年齡嗎？」→ 遠低於年齡預期（青少年應明顯高於此），接著問要排除什麼。
判讀條件：需足夠長度、含多個骨小樑間隙的切片；只有皮質下骨髓時生理上就偏低細胞，不能據此診斷。
青少年再生不良必查先天性骨髓衰竭：Fanconi anemia（DEB/MMC chromosome breakage）、telomere biology disorder（telomere length），因會影響移植前處置與捐贈者選擇。
PNH clone 在 AA 常見，需以 FLAER flow 檢查；AA 與 PNH、hypoplastic MDS 可互相轉變，需長期追蹤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把取樣不足或皮質下骨髓當成再生不良：皮質下區域本就細胞少；真正 AA 在多個骨小樑間隙都呈均勻脂肪取代，如本圖。

quiz.q: 青少年骨髓切片呈現圖中的廣泛脂肪取代，移植前必須排除哪一種先天性骨髓衰竭？用什麼檢查？
quiz.a: Fanconi anemia；DEB 或 MMC chromosome breakage test（亦需考慮 telomere length 檢測）

60813.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見多形性大型非典型細胞，其中有核大、深染的 Hodgkin 樣細胞（視野中央），混雜小淋巴球、組織球與空泡狀背景，這種多形性浸潤是 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍的典型組成。
features: Scattered large pleomorphic cells, including a large hyperchromatic Hodgkin-like cell in the center
Intermediate to large cells with vesicular, irregular nuclei and occasional nucleoli
Admixed small mature lymphocytes and histiocytes (polymorphous background)
Numerous clear vacuolated spaces and loose edematous stroma
Occasional apoptotic bodies; no well-formed granulomas
60813.describe_en: High-power H&E shows a polymorphous infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and numerous intermediate to large atypical cells with irregular vesicular nuclei. Scattered pleomorphic Hodgkin-like cells with large hyperchromatic nuclei are present, set in a loose, vacuolated stroma with scattered apoptotic debris. Findings, together with the ulcer architecture, CD20 and EBER positivity, are consistent with EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer.

ddx.vs: HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak or absent CD20 and lack the many EBER+ small cells, and the lesion is usually nodal rather than a solitary mucosal ulcer.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Sheets of large B cells with a less polymorphous background and no self-limited circumscribed ulcer.
Shows angiocentric, angiodestructive infiltrate primarily in lung with EBV+ B cells, rather than a mucosal ulcer.

60621.recognize_zh: 抹片中滿是中大型異常淋巴細胞，核圓或有凹陷、染色質粗、胞質深嗜鹼性；切片細胞密集並見多個核分裂；FISH 顯示 MYC 分離訊號、IGH/BCL2 融合及 BCL6 分離訊號，三者皆重組即「三重打擊」（triple-hit）淋巴瘤。
features: Smear: numerous medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio, round to indented nuclei, condensed-to-open chromatin, some visible nucleoli
Scant to moderate, deeply basophilic cytoplasm; no prominent vacuoles in most cells
Tissue section: sheets of medium to large cells with vesicular nuclei, small nucleoli and frequent mitotic figures
FISH MYC break-apart probe: separated orange and green signals (MYC rearrangement)
Dual-fusion FISH: MYC/IGH fusion signal and IGH/BCL2 fusion signals (arrows)
BCL6 break-apart probe: split orange and green signals (BCL6 rearrangement)
60621.describe_en: The smear shows numerous circulating medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, irregular or indented nuclei, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The accompanying tissue section shows a diffuse proliferation of medium to large lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin and abundant mitotic figures. Interphase FISH demonstrates MYC rearrangement (break-apart and MYC/IGH fusion), IGH/BCL2 fusion, and BCL6 rearrangement. Findings are consistent with a leukemic presentation of high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements ("triple-hit").

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are monotonous with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and carry MYC-IG translocation without BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangements.
Lymphoblasts have finer chromatin and scant cytoplasm and express TdT/CD34 with absent surface immunoglobulin.
Blastoid MCL can look identical but expresses cyclin D1/SOX11 with CCND1-IGH fusion.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS with MYC rearrangement only
ddx.vs: Morphology cannot separate them, so FISH showing no concurrent BCL2 rearrangement is required.

60685.recognize_zh: 芽細胞核質比高、染色質細緻，細胞核一側有一個淡染的杯口狀凹陷，凹陷處由淡藍細胞質填充而看起來像杯子（cup-like），這是 NPM1 與 FLT3-ITD 突變 AML 常見的型態線索。
features: Medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio and a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Prominent cup-shaped nuclear invagination occupied by pale cytoplasm, spanning a sizable portion of the nuclear diameter (fish-mouth/cuplike appearance)
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules evident
Background red cells normal; no other leukocytes in view
60685.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. Each blast shows a distinct cup-like nuclear invagination filled with pale cytoplasm, imparting a fish-mouth appearance. Auer rods and granules are not seen. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, a morphology associated with NPM1 and FLT3-ITD mutations; molecular testing is required for classification.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL cells have bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei with fine granules and often Auer rod bundles, and PML::RARA fusion, rather than a single cup-shaped invagination.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, folded or convoluted nuclei and nonspecific esterase positivity rather than scant cytoplasm with a cuplike invagination.
Lymphoblasts may show nuclear clefts but are MPO negative and express lymphoid markers, whereas cup-like AML blasts are typically MPO positive, CD34 and HLA-DR negative.
These are mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin and cerebriform or cleaved nuclei, not blasts with fine chromatin.

exam.answer_en: AML with cup-like blasts (NPM1 and FLT3-ITD mutated) — blasts with fine chromatin and a cup-shaped nuclear invagination filled with pale cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指核一側杯口狀凹陷的 blast 問名稱（cup-like/fish-mouth blast），並要求說出最相關的兩個突變：NPM1 與 FLT3-ITD。
表型：典型 CD34 陰性、HLA-DR 陰性且 MPO 陽性——與 APL 相似，因此必須先排除 PML::RARA 以免延誤 ATRA；NPM1 突變可用 IHC 見 NPM1 異常位於胞質。
分類門檻：AML with NPM1 mutation 在 WHO 5th 無 blast 比例下限；ICC 2022 則要求 blast ≥10%。
預後與治療：ELN 2022 中 NPM1 突變不伴 FLT3-ITD 屬 favorable，伴 FLT3-ITD 屬 intermediate；FLT3 突變者誘導化療合併 FLT3 inhibitor（midostaurin，FLT3-ITD 亦可用 quizartinib）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 microgranular APL：兩者都 CD34−/HLA-DR−，但 APL 核呈雙葉蝴蝶狀、常有 Auer rod 束且為 PML::RARA 陽性；cup-like blast 為圓核單一杯狀凹陷，應緊急做 PML::RARA 排除 APL。

quiz.q: 這種核呈杯口狀凹陷的 blasts 最常與哪兩個基因突變相關？其 CD34/HLA-DR 表型容易與哪種白血病混淆？
quiz.a: NPM1 與 FLT3-ITD；CD34−/HLA-DR− 易與 APL 混淆。

60749.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的腫瘤漿細胞核偏位、染色質粗，細胞質內塞滿大量粗大、紅紫色、圓形至多角形的顆粒狀包涵體，乍看像嗜酸或肥大細胞；膜狀免疫染色與細胞質顆粒狀免疫染色證實這些為漿細胞，符合含大量細胞質顆粒的漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Large plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin and occasional binucleation (A3)
Cytoplasm stuffed with numerous coarse, round-to-angular, reddish-purple granules/inclusions, often obscuring the cytoplasm
Some plasma cells with finely granular gray-blue cytoplasm without the coarse inclusions (A1, lower cell)
H&E section (B): sheets of cells with abundant granular to finely vacuolated eosinophilic cytoplasm
IHC: crisp membranous staining (C1, compatible with CD138) and coarse granular cytoplasmic staining of the inclusions (C2, compatible with immunoglobulin light chain); antibodies unlabeled
60749.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show large atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and coarse chromatin whose cytoplasm is filled with innumerable coarse, reddish-purple, round-to-angular granular inclusions, including binucleate forms. The core biopsy shows sheets of cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates membranous positivity in the neoplastic cells and granular cytoplasmic staining that decorates the inclusions (antibodies not labeled in the figure). Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with abundant cytoplasmic granules (immunoglobulin inclusions), a morphologic variant that can mimic mast cells, eosinophilic precursors or histiocytes.

ddx.vs: Mast cells have purple-black metachromatic granules with round/spindled nuclei and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive and CD138 negative.
Eosinophilic precursors have uniform orange-refractile granules, an immature granulocytic nucleus and are MPO positive without a perinuclear hof or CD138 expression.
Crystal-storing histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive macrophages with needle-like crystals, while these cells are the plasma cells themselves.
Mott cells contain larger, pale grape-like globules, whereas these are smaller, dense, dark granules; both represent immunoglobulin accumulation.

captions: Plasma cell packed with coarse granules above a plasma cell with finely granular cytoplasm
Plasma cell with eccentric nucleus and dense cytoplasmic granules
Binucleate plasma cell with abundant coarse cytoplasmic granules
H&E: cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm
IHC: membranous staining of plasma cells
IHC: granular cytoplasmic staining of the inclusions

60557.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指是一個較小的橢圓形紅血球，細胞內有一條紫色細線沿邊緣繞行並扭成長條迴圈狀，符合 Cabot 環；背景紅血球大小不一，另有淚滴狀與不規則形紅血球。
features: Small oval red cell (arrow) containing a thin violet threadlike loop running along and folding within the cell periphery
Ring lacks a chromatin dot and is not beaded
Background red cells show anisocytosis and poikilocytosis, including a teardrop cell and an irregularly contoured cell with central pallor
Most red cells are normochromic with little central pallor
No Howell-Jolly body, parasites, or leukocytes evident in this field
60557.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with a teardrop cell and occasional irregularly shaped red cells. A small oval red cell contains a thin, violet-staining, looped thread-like inclusion tracing its periphery, consistent with a Cabot ring; its elongated, folded configuration reflects the variable figure-of-eight or loop forms these structures can adopt. No intraerythrocytic parasites are seen. Findings are consistent with a Cabot ring in a patient with hemolytic anemia.

ddx.dx: Plasmodium ring form or ameboid trophozoite
ddx.vs: Malaria parasites show blue cytoplasm with a red chromatin dot and may have pigment, whereas this inclusion is a fine dot-less thread following the cell outline.
Babesia shows small multiple rings or Maltese-cross tetrads within cells, not a single peripheral loop.
A stomatocytic slit is a central pale linear area without staining, while a Cabot ring is a stained violet line that persists on focusing.

exam.answer_en: Cabot ring — elongated, folded violet thread-like loop tracing the periphery of a small red cell in hemolytic anemia
pearls_zh: 考法：環形不規則、被拉長折疊時較難認，考官會問「這條細線是什麼？」→ Cabot ring 可呈環形、8 字形或不規則折疊。
判讀原則：Cabot ring 為無顆粒、粗細一致的細線，無核點亦無細胞質團塊，這是與寄生蟲最重要的鑑別。
溶血性貧血背景下出現 Cabot ring 代表紅系造血加速；應搭配 reticulocyte、LDH、haptoglobin、DAT 評估病因。
同視野可見 teardrop 與不規則紅血球，報告時應完整描述 poikilocytosis 型態。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 P. vivax 的 ameboid trophozoite 或 Babesia：寄生蟲有核點與藍色細胞質、vivax 寄生紅血球變大伴 Schüffner dots；Cabot ring 只是細線、紅血球不變大。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球內沿周邊折疊的紫色細線是什麼？它與寄生蟲的主要差別為何？
quiz.a: Cabot ring；無核點（chromatin dot）與細胞質團

60493.recognize_zh: CD56 免疫染色下，瀰漫片狀的中型腫瘤細胞幾乎全部呈強烈細胞膜陽性，形成蜂巢狀棕色網格；配合鼻腔等結外部位與 EBER 陽性，支持結外 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheet-like infiltrate of medium-sized cells
Strong, crisp membranous CD56 staining in nearly all tumor cells
Honeycomb pattern of stained cell membranes outlining round to oval nuclei
No residual architecture or negative background compartment evident in this field
Mild crush/stromal spaces between cells
60493.describe_en: CD56 immunohistochemical stain shows a diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized neoplastic cells with strong membranous positivity in nearly all cells, producing a honeycomb pattern. No significant CD56-negative population is present in this field. CD56 expression in a diffuse atypical lymphoid infiltrate at an extranodal (e.g. nasal) site supports an NK-cell phenotype; together with cytoplasmic CD3, cytotoxic granule proteins and EBER positivity, findings are consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.

ddx.vs: ANKL shares the CD56+/EBV+ phenotype but presents with systemic marrow, blood and liver involvement rather than a localized nasal/extranodal mass.
BPDCN is also CD56+ but is CD4+/CD123+/TCL1+, EBER-negative and lacks cytotoxic granules, typically involving skin.
MEITL is CD56+/CD8+ but arises in the intestine with epitheliotropism and is EBV-negative.
Plasma cell neoplasms can be CD56+ but are CD138/MUM1 positive and CD3/CD2 negative.

60429.recognize_zh: 左側粉紅色骨小樑表面緊貼著一大片單一形態的小淋巴球浸潤，把正常造血細胞（右上、右下帶紅色顆粒的骨髓系細胞）推到遠離骨小樑的區域；細胞小、核輪廓略不規則（有凹痕），正是濾泡性淋巴瘤貼骨小樑（paratrabecular）浸潤的典型樣貌。
features: Dense lymphoid infiltrate directly abutting and spreading along the bony trabecula (paratrabecular pattern)
Monotonous small lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm and slightly irregular, angulated to notched nuclear contours (centrocyte-like)
Condensed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli; mitoses infrequent
Fine interstitial vessels/stroma within the infiltrate
Residual normal hematopoiesis (granulocytic precursors with eosinophilic granules, erythroid cells) displaced to the right side away from bone
60429.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, high power) shows a dense infiltrate of small lymphoid cells that lies directly against the trabecular bone surface and extends along it. The cells are monotonous, with scant cytoplasm, condensed chromatin and slightly irregular to notched nuclear contours, consistent with centrocyte-like cells. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis, including eosinophilic granulocytic precursors, is pushed away from the trabecula. The paratrabecular distribution of small cleaved lymphocytes is characteristic of bone marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma, which should be confirmed by CD20, CD10, BCL2 and BCL6 immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Benign aggregates are small, round, well-circumscribed, non-paratrabecular and composed of mixed T and B cells, unlike this large paratrabecular sheet of monotonous cells.
MCL may be paratrabecular but more often nodular/interstitial, and is CD5-positive, cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD10-negative.
CLL/SLL cells are round with clumped 'soccer-ball' chromatin, typically in nonparatrabecular nodules or diffuse pattern, and are CD5/CD23/LEF1-positive.
MZL usually forms intertrabecular nodules or intrasinusoidal infiltrates with monocytoid/plasmacytoid cells and is CD10- and BCL6-negative.

exam.answer_en: Follicular lymphoma involving bone marrow — paratrabecular infiltrate of small cleaved centrocyte-like lymphocytes hugging bony trabecula
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指緊貼骨小樑、把正常造血推開的小淋巴球浸潤，問此型態名稱與最典型的淋巴瘤（paratrabecular → FL）。
IHC：CD20+、CD10+、BCL6+、BCL2+；但正常 T 與 B 淋巴球本身也 BCL2+，在骨髓中 BCL2 不能區分良性與惡性，且骨髓內 FL 細胞 CD10 可減弱。
骨髓浸潤型態口訣：FL → paratrabecular；CLL → 間質性/結節性/瀰漫；MCL → 結節/間質（可有貼骨）；良性淋巴聚集 → 骨小樑間、邊界清楚且小。
臨床意義：骨髓侵犯屬 Ann Arbor stage IV；FL 的 t(14;18) IGH::BCL2 可用 FISH 或 PCR 協助確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為良性淋巴聚集；良性聚集位於骨小樑之間、體積小、邊界清楚且細胞多樣，FL 則沿骨小樑表面延伸、細胞單一並有切跡核。

quiz.q: 這些緊貼骨小樑表面延伸的小淋巴細胞浸潤型態叫什麼？最典型見於哪個淋巴瘤？
quiz.a: Paratrabecular infiltrate；follicular lymphoma

60365.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨小樑之間的骨髓腔被單一形態細胞完全填滿（約 100% cellularity），沒有脂肪也看不到正常三系造血；高倍為成片均一的小至中型圓核母細胞、細胞質稀少，符合骨髓被淋巴母細胞取代。
features: Hypercellular marrow (approximately 100%) with complete loss of fat spaces between bony trabeculae
Diffuse, monotonous sheets of small-to-intermediate cells effacing the marrow
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm (high N:C ratio)
Near absence of recognizable megakaryocytes, erythroid islands and maturing granulocytes
Bone trabeculae unremarkable
60365.describe_en: Core biopsy of bone marrow shows a markedly hypercellular marrow (approximately 100% cellularity) with obliteration of fat spaces. At high power, the marrow is diffusely replaced by monotonous sheets of small-to-intermediate blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes, is essentially absent. Together with immunophenotyping, findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Packed marrow by AML blasts looks similar on H&E; separation requires IHC or flow (MPO, CD117 versus CD19/PAX5, TdT).

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by small lymphocytic lymphoma
ddx.vs: SLL cells have condensed chromatin and often form paratrabecular or nodular aggregates with proliferation centers rather than blastic sheets.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma, Ewing sarcoma)
ddx.vs: These form cohesive nests or rosettes with desmoplasia and are negative for CD45/TdT and B-cell markers.

60173.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片細胞密度明顯高於年齡預期（約80–90%），只剩散在的小脂肪空泡，巨核細胞分布其間；在此倍率下無法確切辨認單核球，需搭配周邊血單核球增多與CD14/CD163染色才能支持慢性骨髓單核球性白血病（CMML）。
features: Hypercellular marrow (approximately 80–90%) with only small scattered fat vacuoles
Dense mixed hematopoietic population with myeloid predominance
Megakaryocytes scattered throughout, some small with hypolobated nuclei
Bony trabecula at top and a small vessel at upper left; no fibrosis or lymphoid aggregates evident
Monocytes cannot be reliably distinguished from other myeloid cells at this low magnification
60173.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section at low power shows a hypercellular marrow for age, with cellularity of approximately 80–90% and only small residual fat spaces. The hematopoietic population is dense with myeloid predominance, and megakaryocytes are scattered, including some small forms. No fibrosis, granulomas, or lymphoid aggregates are seen at this magnification, and individual monocytes cannot be confidently identified. In conjunction with persistent peripheral monocytosis, increased marrow monocytes, dysplasia, and <5% blasts, the findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (CMML-1).

ddx.vs: aCML shows a similarly hypercellular granulocytic marrow but lacks significant monocytosis (<10% monocytes) and has prominent dysgranulopoiesis with circulating precursors.
CML can show relative monocytosis but has basophilia, numerous small hypolobated megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1 fusion.
Reactive monocytosis lacks dysplasia and clonal markers (e.g., TET2, SRSF2, ASXL1) and flow shows a normal classical monocyte fraction below 94%.
PMF or PV with monocytosis shows characteristic large atypical MPN-type megakaryocyte clusters and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation with prior MPN features.

60109.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中除成熟中顆粒球外，右下可見一顆帶細胞質泡狀突起的小型異常巨核細胞，周圍有數顆高核質比芽細胞與血小板團塊；小而異常的巨核系細胞配上 blebs，是 ML-DS 的線索。
features: Small atypical megakaryocyte (lower right) with a hypolobated nucleus and cytoplasm with peripheral blebs
Scattered blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
Platelet clumps and large platelet/cytoplasmic fragments in the background
Preserved granulocytic maturation with numerous band and segmented neutrophils
Crenated red cells, consistent with smear artifact
60109.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows preserved granulocytic maturation with numerous bands and segmented neutrophils, admixed with scattered blasts that have a high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. A small atypical megakaryocyte with a hypolobated nucleus and blebbed cytoplasm is present at the lower right, and platelet clumps are seen in the background. Red cells show crenation artifact. In a patient with Down syndrome and 11% blasts, findings are consistent with myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical megakaryoblasts, but TAM occurs in the neonatal period and typically regresses, whereas ML-DS arises later (usually under 4 years).
Reactive marrow lacks increased blasts and atypical hypolobated megakaryocytes with blebbed cytoplasm.
Outside Down syndrome, dysplasia would be multilineage without the megakaryoblastic bias and GATA1 mutation.

29197.recognize_zh: 視野中央一個大型細胞，其多個核葉環狀排列成花冠（rosette）包圍中央嗜酸性胞質，外圍胞質細顆粒帶空泡；周圍有胞質空泡化的異常單核細胞，對應 AML 伴複雜染色體異常的多核原始細胞。
features: Very large cell with multiple dense nuclear lobes/nuclei arranged in a ring (rosette/wreath) around a central pale eosinophilic cytoplasmic zone
Abundant peripheral cytoplasm that is finely granular to vacuolated
Nuclear lobes hyperchromatic without clearly resolvable nucleoli at this resolution
Background of loosely arranged atypical mononuclear cells with vacuolated cytoplasm, scattered red cells and fibrinous material
29197.describe_en: Section (H&E, likely marrow clot or biopsy) shows a markedly enlarged cell in which multiple hyperchromatic nuclear lobes are arranged in a rosette around a central eosinophilic cytoplasmic core, surrounded by a wide rim of finely vacuolated cytoplasm. The background contains loosely cohesive atypical mononuclear cells with vacuolated cytoplasm, red cells and fibrin. Fine chromatin detail cannot be assessed at this resolution. In the appropriate immunophenotypic and cytogenetic context, these rosette-like multinucleated forms are suggestive of dysplastic blasts in acute myeloid leukemia with complex karyotype.

ddx.vs: Touton cells also show a wreath of nuclei around an eosinophilic center, but their periphery is foamy lipid-laden cytoplasm in a xanthomatous lesion and they are CD68/CD163-positive histiocytes rather than CD34/CD117/myeloid-antigen blasts.

ddx.dx: Dysplastic megakaryocyte with separated nuclear lobes (pawn-ball form)
ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have more abundant platelet-forming cytoplasm and are CD61/CD42b-positive, which separates them from monocytic or myeloid blasts.
Osteoclasts have many uniform, discrete oval nuclei scattered through cytoplasm adjacent to bone rather than a ring of lobes around a central core.
RS and hallmark cells have large vesicular nuclei with prominent macronucleoli and CD30 expression, unlike these dense lobated nuclei.

27021.recognize_zh: 多顆紅血球的血紅素被推擠到細胞一側、另一側留下清楚的空白水泡樣區域（blister cells），並有摺疊／船形細胞、標靶細胞及 Howell-Jolly 小體，符合含 HbS 的血紅素病變中的 blister cell 型態。
features: Blister cells: hemoglobin condensed to one side with a sharply demarcated clear, vacuole-like area occupying the rest of the cell
Folded, boat-shaped and irregularly contracted cells, some with straight hemoglobin edges
Target cells and cells with eccentric central pallor
Howell-Jolly bodies (small dense purple dots) in several RBCs, suggesting hyposplenism
Occasional irregular crenated/fragmented cell; no classic elongated sickle cells in this field
27021.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis. Numerous red cells show hemoglobin retracted to one side with a sharply demarcated clear zone (blister cells), accompanied by folded and boat-shaped cells, target cells and occasional irregular contracted forms. Several erythrocytes contain Howell-Jolly bodies, consistent with functional asplenia. Classic long, crescentic sickle cells are not prominent in this field. Findings are suggestive of a sickling hemoglobinopathy (HbS, particularly compound heterozygous states such as HbSC) with blister cell morphology; confirmation requires hemoglobin fractionation.

ddx.dx: Oxidative hemolysis (G6PD deficiency) with blister/bite cells
ddx.vs: G6PD blister cells occur with eccentrocytes and Heinz bodies on supravital stain, and lack folded/boat cells, target cells and an HbS peak on electrophoresis.
HbCC shows abundant target cells and intraerythrocytic hexagonal/rod-shaped crystals, without HbS-related folded and blister forms.
MAHA shows schistocytes, helmet cells and keratocytes with thrombocytopenia, not hemoglobin retraction within intact cells.

27213.recognize_zh: 腸切除標本可見白色、魚肉樣、跨壁性的腫塊；組織切片為片狀、單一型態的小至中型淋巴細胞，核圓、細胞質淡而透亮，缺乏發炎細胞背景——符合單型性親上皮腸道 T 細胞淋巴瘤（MEITL，舊稱 EATL type II）。
features: Panel A (gross): opened bowel with a large, tan-white, fleshy, bulging transmural mass
Panel B (H&E): diffuse sheets of monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells
Round, regular nuclei with condensed-to-fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Rim of pale to clear cytoplasm giving an evenly spaced appearance
Lack of a prominent inflammatory background or necrosis; epithelium not included in this field
27213.describe_en: The resected bowel (A) contains a large, tan-white, fleshy mass replacing the wall and protruding into the lumen. Histologic sections (B) show diffuse sheets of monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a rim of pale cytoplasm, without a significant inflammatory background. Epitheliotropism and adjacent mucosa cannot be assessed in this field. Findings are consistent with monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma (formerly EATL type II) in context, supported by a CD3+, CD8+, CD56+, MATK+ immunophenotype and SETD2 alterations.

ddx.vs: EATL shows pleomorphic medium-to-large cells with abundant inflammatory background and necrosis, is usually CD56-negative and associated with celiac disease.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type, intestinal
ddx.vs: Shows angiocentric necrosis and is EBER-positive with cytoplasmic CD3-epsilon/CD56, whereas MEITL is EBV-negative.

ddx.dx: Intestinal mantle cell lymphoma or other small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: B-cell lymphomas express CD20/PAX5 (and cyclin D1 in mantle cell lymphoma) and lack T-cell markers.
Burkitt cells have basophilic cytoplasm with a starry-sky pattern, and are CD20/CD10+ with MYC rearrangement.

21261.recognize_zh: 周邊血片中單核球（A）及嗜中性球（B）胞質空泡內可見短而粗、兩端鈍圓的深染桿菌（箭頭），部分周圍有透明暈圈；血片直接看到被吞噬的細菌代表高菌量菌血症，但克雷伯氏菌或綠膿桿菌的菌種需靠血液培養確認。
features: Monocyte with vacuolated cytoplasm containing several short, plump, dark-staining bacilli (panel A, arrows)
Neutrophil with multiple cytoplasmic vacuoles, one containing small paired rod-shaped bacteria (panel B, arrow)
Some bacilli surrounded by a clear halo within phagocytic vacuoles
Background red cells crenated (echinocytes), likely storage or drying artifact
No extracellular organisms clearly identified in these fields
21261.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a vacuolated monocyte and a vacuolated neutrophil containing short, plump, darkly staining bacilli within phagocytic vacuoles (arrows), some surrounded by a clear halo. Background red cells are crenated. No intraerythrocytic parasites are identified. Findings are consistent with high-grade bacteremia with intracellular bacilli; morphology cannot identify the species, and Gram stain and blood culture (in this case Klebsiella and Pseudomonas) are required.

ddx.dx: Döhle bodies / toxic vacuolation without organisms
ddx.vs: Toxic changes produce empty vacuoles and pale grey-blue Döhle bodies, without discrete dark rod-shaped bodies inside vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Stain precipitate or overlying platelet granules
ddx.vs: Precipitate is refractile, lies in different focal planes and across cell borders rather than within vacuoles.
Morulae are mulberry-like clusters of tiny cocci forming a single inclusion, not separate rod-shaped bacilli.
Clostridia are large boxcar rods with massive spherocytic hemolysis, and Capnocytophaga are thin fusiform rods, whereas species identity ultimately requires culture.

15117.recognize_zh: 移植後患者口腔可見可刮除的白色乳酪狀斑塊（buccal mucosa），另有舌背萎縮性紅斑與上顎散在白點，疊在 cGVHD 的紅斑黏膜上，符合口腔念珠菌感染（oral candidiasis）合併 cGVHD。
features: Panel A: creamy white curd-like pseudomembranous plaques on erythematous buccal mucosa
Panel B: white plaque with a focal red erosion on buccal mucosa, retracted for exposure
Panel C: diffusely erythematous, depapillated dorsal tongue (erythematous/atrophic pattern)
Panel D: scattered white speckles and small plaques over an erythematous palate
Background mucosal erythema in a post-transplant patient
15117.describe_en: Four clinical photographs of the oral cavity in patients with oral chronic graft-versus-host disease. Panels A and D show multiple creamy white, curd-like plaques on erythematous buccal and palatal mucosa, compatible with pseudomembranous candidiasis. Panel C shows a diffusely red, depapillated dorsal tongue consistent with the erythematous (atrophic) form, and panel B shows a white plaque with focal erosion. Findings are consistent with oral candidiasis superimposed on oral cGVHD; confirmation requires scraping with KOH/PAS or culture, since cGVHD lichenoid plaques are not wipeable.

ddx.vs: Lichenoid cGVHD produces fixed reticular white striae that do not wipe off, whereas candidal pseudomembranes are removable and show hyphae/yeasts on KOH or PAS smear.
Hairy leukoplakia forms corrugated non-removable white plaques on the lateral tongue rather than scattered wipeable curds on buccal and palatal mucosa.

ddx.dx: Mucositis from conditioning or HSV/CMV ulceration
ddx.vs: Viral or chemotherapy mucositis presents as ulcers and fibrinous slough with pain, and HSV is confirmed by PCR or viral cytopathic change rather than fungal elements.

14605.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一個細胞質豐富且呈藍色的大型細胞，胞內透明空泡裡含有形態完整的造血細胞（小型有核細胞與顆粒球），被吞入的細胞沒有被分解，這種「活細胞穿行」即為 emperipolesis。
features: Large cell with abundant pale-blue cytoplasm and a single round-to-oval eccentric nucleus
Intact hematopoietic cells (a small dense nucleated cell and a granulocyte) within clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Engulfed cells retain crisp nuclear detail without degradation, unlike phagocytosed debris
Background marrow aspirate with mixed maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors
No hemosiderin or ingested nuclear debris within the host cell
14605.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows mixed maturing hematopoietic cells. A large cell with abundant pale-blue cytoplasm and an eccentric round nucleus contains intact hematopoietic cells, including a granulocyte and a small dense nucleated cell, sitting within clear cytoplasmic vacuoles without evidence of degradation. The precise identity of the host cell (megakaryocyte versus histiocyte) is difficult to establish at this magnification. Findings represent emperipolesis, a nonspecific phenomenon seen in reactive and neoplastic marrows.

ddx.vs: In hemophagocytosis engulfed cells are destroyed and show pyknosis or digestion within phagolysosomes, whereas in emperipolesis they remain intact and viable.
Rosai-Dorfman shows large S100+ CD68+ histiocytes with emperipolesis of lymphocytes and plasma cells, typically in lymph node or extranodal tissue with lymphadenopathy.
Overlapping cells lie in a different focal plane without a surrounding clear vacuole, whereas true emperipolesis shows a cell enclosed within a cytoplasmic halo.

13837.recognize_zh: 視野中有一個分葉嗜中性球與一個正常小淋巴球作為大小參考，箭頭所指的小型淋巴樣細胞胞質極少、染色質濃縮，核中有一道細深的裂痕（nuclear cleft），即「臀溝細胞（buttock cell）」樣中心細胞，提示濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Small lymphoid cell (arrow) comparable in size to a red cell and to the adjacent normal lymphocyte
Very high N:C ratio with only a thin rim of blue cytoplasm
Condensed chromatin with a narrow linear nuclear cleft or groove
No visible nucleolus
Mature segmented neutrophil and a normal round small lymphocyte in the field for comparison; red cells unremarkable
13837.describe_en: Smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil, a normal-appearing small lymphocyte and, at the arrow, a small lymphoid cell with scant cytoplasm, condensed chromatin and a distinct linear nuclear cleft. No nucleoli, blasts or other atypical cells are present in this field, which is blood-rich and lacks marrow precursors. Findings are suggestive of a circulating or aspirated cleaved lymphoma cell (centrocyte), consistent with follicular lymphoma in context; flow cytometry for a CD10-positive, light-chain-restricted B-cell population and t(14;18) studies are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Normal lymphocytes have a smooth round nucleus without a cleft, as illustrated by the lymphocyte beside the neutrophil.
Mantle cells may be slightly irregular but are CD5+ and cyclin D1+ with t(11;14), whereas follicular lymphoma cells are CD10+ CD5-.
ATLL cells have multilobated flower-shaped nuclei and a CD4+ CD25+ T-cell phenotype with HTLV-1 serology.

exam.answer_en: Follicular lymphoma cell (centrocyte) — small lymphoid cell with scant cytoplasm and deep linear nuclear cleft ('buttock cell')
pearls_zh: 考法：與旁邊正常小淋巴球比較，箭頭細胞差在「核上一道深溝」；考官問名稱 → cleaved cell / buttock cell，提示 FL。
表型：CD19/CD20+、CD10+、BCL6+、BCL2+，單一輕鏈限制；flow 若 CD10 表現較弱仍需結合型態與切片判斷。
遺傳：約八到九成 FL 具 t(14;18)(q32;q21) IGH::BCL2，可用 FISH 檢測；grade 3B 與部分小兒型、十二指腸型等變異可缺乏此轉位。
臨床：骨髓侵犯代表 stage IV；惰性但會轉化為 DLBCL，出現 LDH 快速上升、B 症狀或局部迅速長大時應再切片。
exam.pitfall_zh: 核溝細胞易與 MCL 的不規則核或 ATLL 的花瓣狀核混淆；MCL 為 CD5+、cyclin D1+，ATLL 核呈多葉花瓣狀且為 CD4+ T 細胞，FL 則為 CD10+、BCL2+ B 細胞。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指核上有深裂痕的小淋巴細胞稱為什麼？最具特徵的染色體轉位為何？
quiz.a: Cleaved cell（buttock cell，centrocyte）；t(14;18) IGH::BCL2

13325.recognize_zh: 右側可見一顆細胞質豐富、帶有粗大紫紅色顆粒（azurophilic granules）的大型淋巴球，搭配圖說中慢性貧血的病人，提示 T 細胞大顆粒淋巴球白血病（T-LGL）；但此視野只有一顆顆粒淋巴球，需以流式與 TCR 重排確認。
features: One large lymphoid cell with abundant pale-grey cytoplasm containing scattered coarse azurophilic granules
Eccentric, round-to-oval dense nucleus with condensed chromatin in the granular cell
Two small mature-appearing lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm and no visible granules
Red cells largely normocytic with central pallor; mild anisocytosis
Fine dark punctate dots overlying red cells and background, most consistent with stain precipitate artifact
13325.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with mild anisocytosis and no significant polychromasia. A large lymphocyte with abundant cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules is present, alongside two small mature lymphocytes without visible granules. Fine dark dots overlie many red cells and the background, favored to represent stain precipitate rather than basophilic stippling. In a patient with chronic anemia, large granular lymphocytes raise the possibility of T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia with associated pure red cell aplasia; a single field cannot establish lymphocytosis, and flow cytometry (CD3+, CD8+, CD57+, CD16+) with TCR gene rearrangement studies is required.

ddx.vs: Reactive LGL expansions are polyclonal and transient, so they are separated from T-LGL leukemia by TCR clonality and persistence (>6 months), not morphology.
NK-LPD granular lymphocytes look identical but are surface CD3-negative, CD56+ and lack clonal TCR rearrangement.
Basophils have dark granules that obscure a lobulated nucleus, whereas this cell has sparse granules in abundant pale cytoplasm around a single round nucleus.
True stippling is confined within red cells and often with polychromasia, whereas the dots here also lie in the background, favoring stain precipitate.

12429.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中混有許多中型母細胞，核不規則、染色質細，胞質灰藍無顆粒並有偏心突起，部分細胞膜下可見小空泡排列；背景仍有成熟嗜中性球與紅血球前驅細胞，型態符合 BPDCN 浸潤。
features: Medium-sized blasts with irregular, oval to indented nuclei and fine chromatin
Moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm, some with eccentric tail-like projections
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles aligned beneath the cell membrane
Arrow marks a larger cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a round nucleus
Background residual hematopoiesis: segmented and band neutrophils, erythroid precursors
12429.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed population in which numerous medium-sized blasts are admixed with residual maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors. The blasts have irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm, some with unipolar projections and small submembranous vacuoles. No Auer rods are identified. Findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, TCF4+, MPO-negative).

ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts show fine azurophilic granules, NSE positivity and CD14/CD64/lysozyme expression, whereas BPDCN blasts are agranular, NSE-negative and CD123/TCF4/TCL1 positive.
MDS shows dysplasia across lineages with fewer blasts (<20%) that are usually CD34+ myeloblasts, not CD4+CD56+CD123 bright plasmacytoid dendritic cells.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Mature pDC nodules/aggregates are CD56-negative with low Ki-67 and accompany CMML or AML, unlike the CD56+ blastic infiltrate of BPDCN.

11725.recognize_zh: 這是 CSF 流式細胞圖：淋巴球閘門內 CD19 陽性 B 細胞幾乎全部表現 kappa、lambda 陰性，呈現單一 kappa 輕鏈限制（light chain restriction），證明是單株 B 細胞族群，支持淋巴瘤侵犯。
features: CD45 vs SSC: CD45-bright, low side scatter lymphoid gate containing about 96% of events
CD19 vs kappa: CD19-positive B cells uniformly express surface kappa at moderate-bright intensity
CD19 vs lambda: CD19-positive B cells are lambda-negative (upper left quadrant)
Separate CD19-negative, kappa-negative population representing T cells
Kappa:lambda ratio markedly skewed, indicating monotypic B cells
11725.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the cerebrospinal fluid gated on CD45-bright, low side scatter lymphocytes shows a dominant CD19-positive B-cell population that expresses surface kappa light chain and lacks lambda light chain, together with a minor CD19-negative T-cell population. The findings demonstrate a kappa-restricted monoclonal B-cell population in the CSF. In conjunction with the CD5-positive, CD10-negative, CD23-negative phenotype on companion tubes, results support CNS involvement by mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive B cells show both kappa- and lambda-positive subsets with a normal ratio, whereas this population is exclusively kappa-positive.
CLL typically shows dim surface light chain with CD23 positivity and FMC7 negativity, while MCL shows brighter light chain with CD23-negative, FMC7-positive phenotype.

ddx.dx: Other kappa-restricted B-cell lymphoma (e.g., DLBCL, marginal zone)
ddx.vs: Light chain restriction proves clonality but not subtype; CD5/CD10/CD23 status and cyclin D1 IHC or t(11;14) FISH are needed to assign mantle cell lymphoma.

3021.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央有兩顆比淋巴球大的單核細胞，核圓且偏位、細胞質中等量淡藍色，旁邊一顆小淋巴球與一個細胞碎片；這些細胞可能是循環腫瘤細胞，但單憑本圖無法確定為上皮來源，需以細胞角蛋白等免疫染色確認。
features: Two medium-sized mononuclear cells, larger than the adjacent small lymphocyte
Round, slightly eccentric nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous
Moderate amount of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Cells lie adjacent but do not form a tight cohesive cluster
Background red cells with drying artifact (refractile central inclusions)
3021.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with refractile drying artifact and two medium-sized mononuclear cells with round, slightly eccentric nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and a moderate rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm, next to a small lymphocyte and a small dark nuclear fragment. The cells are not clearly cohesive and lack definitive epithelial features. In a patient with breast cancer, these could represent circulating tumor cells (carcinocythemia), but reactive lymphocytes, monocytoid cells or plasmacytoid cells cannot be excluded; cytokeratin immunocytochemistry or flow cytometry is needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes show deeper basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and occur singly, and are CD45 positive and cytokeratin negative.
Monocytes have folded or reniform nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm.
Plasma cells show clock-face chromatin, deep blue cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof, and are CD138 positive.
Blasts have finer dispersed chromatin with nucleoli and higher N:C ratio, and express CD34/CD45 rather than cytokeratin.

1101.recognize_zh: 整片組織幾乎被帶有鮮紅色粗大顆粒的嗜酸性球（eosinophils）佔滿，多數為雙葉核或未分節核，缺乏其他明顯腫瘤細胞，符合嗜酸性球過多症候群的組織浸潤。
features: Sheets of eosinophils filling the field, both mature (bilobed nuclei) and immature forms (round to indented nuclei)
Abundant coarse, bright eosinophilic cytoplasmic granules
Nuclei with condensed chromatin and no prominent nucleoli
Scattered interspersed mononuclear cells and delicate stroma
No discrete atypical blast population or granulomas evident in this field
1101.describe_en: Section (H&E) shows a dense, diffuse infiltrate composed predominantly of eosinophils, including mature bilobed forms and less segmented immature forms, with abundant coarse eosinophilic granules. Interspersed mononuclear cells are present, but no sheets of blasts, granulomas, or overtly atypical lymphoid cells are identified in this field. The findings indicate marked tissue eosinophilia; in the absence of a clonal or reactive cause, they are consistent with idiopathic hypereosinophilic syndrome.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase gene fusion (e.g., FIP1L1::PDGFRA)
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar; demonstration of PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangement by FISH or molecular testing excludes an idiopathic diagnosis.
Requires increased blasts, dysplasia, or a demonstrable clonal abnormality, none of which can be established from this field alone.
Usually a mixed inflammatory background with a clinical trigger; separation relies on clinical and laboratory workup rather than eosinophil morphology.
Flow cytometry or TCR clonality revealing an aberrant T-cell population distinguishes it from idiopathic disease.

2253.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量細胞的細胞質充滿橙紅色顆粒，包括雙葉核的成熟嗜酸性球及圓核的嗜酸性骨髓細胞（eosinophilic myelocytes），比例明顯升高，符合嗜酸性球增多。
features: Markedly increased eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors throughout the field
Cells with abundant orange-red refractile granules; mature forms with bilobed nuclei
Numerous eosinophilic myelocytes/metamyelocytes with round to indented nuclei
Admixed neutrophils, lymphocytes and scattered erythroid precursors
No obvious increase in blasts at this magnification
2253.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with a marked increase in eosinophils at all stages of maturation, including eosinophilic myelocytes, metamyelocytes and mature bilobed forms with abundant orange-red granules. Neutrophilic and erythroid elements are present, and no overt increase in blasts is evident at this magnification. Findings indicate marrow eosinophilia; further evaluation for reactive versus clonal causes is recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphologically similar maturing eosinophils; clinical history and exclusion of clonal markers are needed.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangement
ddx.vs: Often accompanied by increased mast cells or fibrosis and identified by FISH/molecular testing rather than eosinophil morphology.
Shows increased blasts and abnormal eosinophil precursors with large dark purple-basophilic granules.
CML has a left-shifted granulocytic expansion with basophilia and dwarf megakaryocytes, with BCR::ABL1 detected.

2125.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結免疫組化，淋巴濾泡呈淡染陰性的圓形區塊，濾泡間與副皮質區（paracortex）則充滿密集褐色陽性細胞並成片擴張，呈 T 細胞區擴張型態，符合 ALPS 的副皮質 T 細胞增生；標記未標示。
features: Low-power IHC of lymph node with numerous round, largely negative (pale) follicles
Dense positive (brown) cells filling and expanding the interfollicular/paracortical compartment
Coalescent dark clusters of positive cells, most pronounced in the left upper field
Scattered positive cells within follicles, consistent with intrafollicular T cells
Overall nodal architecture preserved; antibody not labeled
2125.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node shows preserved architecture with numerous negative-staining follicles surrounded by an expanded interfollicular and paracortical compartment containing dense aggregates of positive cells. The distribution corresponds to the T-zone, although the specific antibody is not labeled. In a patient with chronic lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly and autoimmune cytopenias, paracortical expansion by T cells is compatible with autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome, which should be confirmed by showing CD3+ cells lacking CD4 and CD8 and by flow quantitation of TCRαβ+ double-negative T cells.

ddx.vs: Paracortex contains immunoblasts with CD4/CD8-positive T cells and EBER positivity rather than a predominance of CD4-/CD8- T cells.
Sinuses are distended by S100-positive histiocytes with emperipolesis, a feature ALPS nodes can occasionally mimic.
Shows effacement by cytologically atypical T cells with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR, not a preserved reactive architecture.
