1549.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑間的造血組織與脂肪約各半，細胞密度大致正常、結構保留，沒有腫瘤浸潤或纖維化；在低倍下無法判斷紅系前驅細胞是否缺乏，因此 PRCA 的診斷需要高倍或抹片確認紅系缺失與巨大前原紅血球。
features: Low-power core biopsy with preserved architecture and intact bony trabeculae
Cellularity approximately 40-50%, with hematopoietic tissue interspersed among fat spaces
No focal infiltrates, granulomas, or sheets of abnormal cells at this magnification
No evident fibrosis or osteosclerosis
Individual lineages, including the erythroid compartment, cannot be assessed at this magnification
1549.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows preserved architecture with bony trabeculae and hematopoietic marrow admixed with fat, with an estimated cellularity of approximately 40-50%. No focal lesions, fibrosis, or infiltrative process are identified. Lineage composition cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Assessment for pure red cell aplasia requires higher-power review and aspirate correlation to document markedly reduced erythroid precursors and the presence of giant pronormoblasts with viral inclusions; parvovirus B19 immunohistochemistry or PCR would support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows a markedly hypocellular marrow with loss of all lineages, whereas this marrow has preserved overall cellularity.
A normal marrow cannot be distinguished at low power, so higher magnification is needed to confirm absent erythroid islands.
These also show selective erythroid aplasia but lack parvovirus inclusions and may show increased CD8+/CD57+ T cells on immunohistochemistry.

1869.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一團彼此緊密黏合的大型細胞，體積遠大於周圍造血細胞，核大、核質比高，部分細胞質呈淡染空泡狀，屬於轉移性癌細胞群聚（metastatic carcinoma）；影像偏紫、解析度有限。
features: Cohesive cluster of very large cells, many times the size of adjacent hematopoietic cells
Large irregular nuclei with high N:C ratio and nuclear molding/overlap
Coarse, dark chromatin with occasional small nucleolar-like spots
Some cells with pale, vacuolated/clear cytoplasm displacing the nucleus
Background of hematopoietic cells and fat vacuoles; image color and focus limit detail
1869.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a tightly cohesive cluster of very large cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, irregular overlapping nuclei and coarse chromatin, clearly foreign to the marrow. Several cells contain pale vacuolated cytoplasm that displaces the nucleus, a feature compatible with mucin-containing epithelial cells. The surrounding hematopoietic elements are small by comparison, and image color and focus limit finer assessment. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, compatible with the given gastric primary; cytokeratin and mucin stains on the biopsy would support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus and osteoclasts contain many uniform separate nuclei within one cell, whereas this cluster consists of multiple discrete cohesive cells with pleomorphic nuclei.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with multinucleated forms
ddx.vs: Myeloma cells are discohesive with eccentric nuclei and a perinuclear hof and are CD138+/cytokeratin-negative.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or other large-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are generally discohesive and lack mucin vacuoles, and are CD45+ and cytokeratin-negative.

2509.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結切片中，被膜下的副皮質區明顯擴張，形成大片淡染、結節狀的區域，把深染的濾泡推擠到邊緣，這種「淡染副皮質結節」是皮膚病性淋巴結病的特徵。
features: Low-power lymph node with intact capsule and subcapsular sinus
Marked expansion of the paracortex by pale-staining, vaguely nodular areas
Pale zones composed of cells with abundant pale cytoplasm (histiocytes/dendritic cells) at this magnification
Darker lymphoid follicles compressed to the periphery
Nodal architecture preserved; pigment not resolvable at this power
2509.describe_en: Lymph node section at low magnification shows preserved architecture with an intact capsule. The paracortex is markedly expanded by pale-staining, vaguely nodular zones that displace darker-staining lymphoid follicles toward the capsule. At this power the pale areas appear to consist of cells with abundant pale cytoplasm, while pigment cannot be assessed. The pattern is consistent with dermatopathic lymphadenopathy; high-power review for melanin-laden macrophages and S100/CD1a staining would support it and help exclude involvement by mycosis fungoides.

ddx.dx: Nodal involvement by mycosis fungoides / Sézary syndrome
ddx.vs: MF involvement shows clusters or sheets of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes effacing the paracortex, which requires high power and TCR clonality testing to exclude.
LCH preferentially involves sinuses with grooved Langerhans cells and eosinophils, often with necrosis, rather than paracortical expansion with melanophages.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+/CD15+) in a mixed inflammatory background rather than pale nodules of histiocytes and dendritic cells.
Sinus histiocytosis distends the sinuses rather than the paracortex and lacks melanin pigment.

1229.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆遠大於周圍顆粒球系細胞的大型腫瘤細胞，細胞質灰藍且布滿大小不一的透明空泡，核大、染色質粗糙並有核仁，旁邊是正常造血細胞，符合 ALCL 浸潤骨髓。
features: Single very large atypical cell, several times the size of surrounding granulocytic precursors
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm filled with numerous clear vacuoles of variable size
Large, slightly irregular nucleus with coarsely granular chromatin and a distinct nucleolus
Moderate N:C ratio; no cytoplasmic granules or engulfed cells
Background of maturing neutrophils (bands, metamyelocytes), myelocytes and red cells
1229.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements with an admixed markedly enlarged atypical cell. The cell has abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with numerous clear vacuoles and a large, irregular nucleus with coarse chromatin and a visible nucleolus. There is no evidence of phagocytosed cells to suggest a histiocyte. Because such cells may be sparse in marrow involvement, CD30 and ALK immunohistochemistry on the biopsy is recommended. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor cells typically form cohesive clusters and express keratin or myogenin/desmin, whereas ALCL cells are single and CD30+/ALK+.
Histiocytes have a small oval nucleus with fine chromatin and often contain phagocytosed material, unlike this large nucleolated nucleus without ingested cells.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and monotonous with deep blue vacuolated cytoplasm, while ALCL cells are much larger and pleomorphic.
Hodgkin cells show very large inclusion-like nucleoli and lack cytoplasmic vacuoles, with CD15+/PAX5 weak and ALK-negative phenotype.

1165.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的三個巨核細胞體積偏小，細胞核呈單一圓形或僅輕度分葉、偏於一側（hypolobated/monolobated megakaryocytes），周圍是高度細胞性、以不成熟細胞為主的骨髓背景，符合 AML 中的發育不良巨核細胞。
features: Megakaryocytes (arrows) are small to medium-sized relative to normal megakaryocytes
Nuclei are non-lobated or hypolobated, round to oval and often eccentrically placed
Moderate amount of pale blue-grey, finely granular cytoplasm
Markedly hypercellular background dominated by immature mononuclear cells with fine chromatin, suggestive of blasts
Scattered fat vacuoles; residual maturing granulocytes and erythroid cells are sparse
1165.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly cellular. Megakaryocytes are present but dysplastic, including small hypolobated and monolobated forms with round, eccentric nuclei. The background is dominated by immature mononuclear cells with fine chromatin, with relatively little normal trilineage maturation at this magnification. A blast count and immunophenotyping are required for classification. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in the setting of acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: 5q- syndrome shows monolobated megakaryocytes but blasts are <5% and the background is not dominated by immature cells.
AMKL shows many megakaryoblasts with cytoplasmic blebs and CD41/CD61 positivity rather than a few maturing dysplastic megakaryocytes.
Reactive megakaryocytes are normally lobulated and larger, and the background shows orderly trilineage maturation.
This entity characteristically has small hypolobated megakaryocytes as well; separation requires cytogenetics rather than morphology.

exam.answer_en: Dysplastic megakaryocytes in AML — small hypolobated/monolobated megakaryocytes with eccentric round nuclei in a blast-rich marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著箭頭處的巨核細胞，問「這些巨核細胞有何異常？」答案是體積小、核不分葉或低分葉（hypolobated/monolobated）。
小而單圓核的巨核細胞在 MDS with isolated del(5q) 最典型；在 AML 中出現則應想到 AML-MR（myelodysplasia-related）或 inv(3)/t(3;3) MECOM 重組。
MECOM 重組 AML 常見血小板正常或增加、小而低分葉巨核細胞，預後差；需做 karyotype/FISH 確認 inv(3)(q21q26) 或 t(3;3)。
分類時需先確認芽細胞百分比與 flow 表型，再搭配 cytogenetics、molecular（如 TP53、MDS-related 基因突變）決定 WHO 5th / ICC 分類。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 micromegakaryocyte（CML、MDS）或正常小型未成熟巨核細胞混淆；micromegakaryocyte 大小接近骨髓細胞、核小而緻密，而圖中為中小型且胞質豐富的低分葉巨核細胞。

quiz.q: AML 骨髓中出現圖中小而低分葉巨核細胞且血小板偏高，應優先檢查哪一種染色體異常？
quiz.a: inv(3)(q21.3q26.2) 或 t(3;3)（MECOM 重組）

1293.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的漿細胞細胞質塞滿多個淡藍色、圓形、大小相近的球狀包涵體（Russell bodies），像一串葡萄，即 Mott 細胞；背景是大量具偏心核、藍色細胞質的漿細胞。
features: Plasma cell (arrow) with cytoplasm packed with multiple round, pale blue, uniform globules (Russell bodies) — Mott/grape cell
Nucleus of the Mott cell compressed to one side by the inclusions
Background of numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, abundant deep blue cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs
Some background plasma cells are large with open chromatin and visible nucleoli (immature/atypical forms)
Occasional binucleate and irregular plasma cells
1293.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly increased population of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing, including large forms with dispersed chromatin and nucleoli. One plasma cell (arrow) contains numerous round, pale blue cytoplasmic globules of accumulated immunoglobulin (Russell bodies), consistent with a Mott cell. Mott cells themselves are nonspecific, but the sheet-like background of atypical plasma cells is consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm; quantification and clonality studies are required.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrows contain Mott cells among a modest number of mature, polytypic plasma cells rather than sheets of atypical plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Vacuolated cells (e.g., Burkitt cells or blasts with vacuoles)
ddx.vs: Burkitt vacuoles are small, clear, lipid-containing punched-out holes in deeply basophilic cytoplasm, not uniform pale blue immunoglobulin globules.
Dutcher bodies are single intranuclear-appearing PAS-positive pseudoinclusions overlying the nucleus, favoring lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, rather than multiple cytoplasmic globules.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell neoplasm with Mott cell — plasma cell packed with grape-like Russell bodies amid sheets of atypical plasma cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著箭頭問「胞質內的圓球叫什麼？這顆細胞叫什麼？」答 Russell bodies 與 Mott cell（grape/morula cell），再看背景判斷是否為漿細胞腫瘤。
Russell bodies 是堆積在擴張粗面內質網中的免疫球蛋白，PAS 陽性；Mott cell 本身不具診斷特異性，反應性漿細胞增多也會出現。
Myeloma 診斷（IMWG）：骨髓 clonal plasma cells ≥10% 或活檢證實 plasmacytoma，加上 CRAB 或 SLiM 生物標記（clonal PC ≥60%、FLC ratio ≥100、MRI >1 個局灶病灶）。
單株性確認：flow 或 IHC 顯示 κ/λ 輕鏈限制；腫瘤性漿細胞常 CD19−、CD45 弱或陰性、CD56+、CD138+。
exam.pitfall_zh: Mott cell 的 Russell bodies 易與 Burkitt 細胞或芽細胞的空泡混淆；Russell bodies 是淡藍色實心、邊界清楚的球體且細胞具漿細胞核，空泡則為透明中空。

quiz.q: 圖中箭頭細胞胞質內葡萄狀淡藍色圓球的成分是什麼？
quiz.a: 堆積於粗面內質網的免疫球蛋白（Russell bodies）

4237.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的細胞團中，細胞核呈橢圓或腎形、染色質細緻，彼此間隔著大量淡灰色、邊界不清的胞質，形成類似「荷包蛋」的間隔排列，符合毛狀細胞浸潤。
features: Cohesive-appearing aggregate of mononuclear cells separated by abundant pale gray cytoplasm
Oval, reniform, or slightly indented nuclei with finely granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Ill-defined cytoplasmic borders with fine fibrillar edges at the periphery of the aggregate
Scattered erythroid precursors and a macrophage/plasma cell-like cell with gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm
Evenly spaced nuclei reminiscent of the 'fried egg' spacing seen in tissue sections
4237.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an aggregate of medium-sized mononuclear cells with oval to reniform nuclei, finely granular chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli, separated by abundant pale gray cytoplasm with indistinct, fibrillar borders. Scattered erythroid precursors are admixed. The evenly spaced nuclei within abundant cytoplasm recall the fried-egg appearance of hairy cells on biopsy. Findings are consistent with involvement by hairy cell leukemia; note that aspirates are often dry taps and core biopsy with CD20, annexin A1, TRAP/CD123 or BRAF V600E (VE1) staining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mast cells in aspirate clusters are often spindle-shaped with metachromatic granules and are tryptase/CD117 positive rather than CD20/annexin A1 positive.
Monocytic cells have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin, fine granules and vacuoles, and are nonspecific esterase and CD14 positive.
SMZL marrow involvement is typically intrasinusoidal or nodular with smaller cells and lacks CD103/CD25/annexin A1 expression.

4109.recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒（particle）裡、脂肪空泡之間可見數個圓形、細胞質被粗大深紫黑色顆粒填滿的細胞，顆粒遮蔽細胞核，這就是肥大細胞（mast cell）。
features: Several round to oval cells with cytoplasm packed with coarse, dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus
Mast cells lie within a marrow particle among stromal cells and fat vacuoles
Granules are evenly distributed; cells are round rather than spindle-shaped
Background of hematopoietic precursors and lymphocytes with numerous fat spaces
Stain appears somewhat faded/yellowish, limiting fine nuclear detail
4109.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a marrow particle with prominent fat spaces and associated stromal and hematopoietic cells. Several mast cells are seen within the particle, recognized by abundant coarse dark metachromatic granules that obscure the nucleus. The mast cells are round and well granulated without obvious spindle forms in this field. Mast cells are commonly increased within particles in reactive states and myeloid neoplasms; correlation with tryptase, CD25, and KIT mutation status is needed to exclude systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Features atypical spindle or hypogranular mast cells in aggregates, CD25/CD2 expression and KIT D816V, none of which can be confirmed from these round, well-granulated cells.
Basophils are smaller with a segmented nucleus and fewer, water-soluble granules, and are not typically embedded in particles.
Macrophages are larger with irregular golden-brown to blue-black pigment clumps and a visible nucleus, and are Prussian blue positive.

4173.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被大量中型、細緻染色質、N:C 比高、部分可見核仁的芽細胞（blast）佔據，夾雜少數成熟嗜中性球與小淋巴球；此視野主要呈現急性骨髓性白血病成分，典型漿細胞並不明顯。
features: Sheets of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio and scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
No obvious Auer rods or coarse granules in blasts at this magnification
Scattered mature neutrophils and small lymphocytes with markedly reduced normal hematopoiesis
Distinct plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hof are not clearly identified in this field
4173.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is highly cellular and dominated by a population of medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, occasional nucleoli, and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Residual maturing neutrophils and small lymphocytes are present, while erythroid and megakaryocytic elements are sparse. A distinct neoplastic plasma cell population is not evident in this particular field, so the plasma cell myeloma component must be documented on other fields, flow cytometry, or biopsy. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia in the given clinical setting of multiple myeloma (possibly therapy-related).

ddx.vs: Plasmablasts have more basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei with a central prominent nucleolus and are CD138/cytoplasmic light-chain positive but CD34/CD117/MPO negative.
Lymphoblasts are often smaller with scantier cytoplasm and are MPO negative with TdT and CD19 or CD3 expression by flow cytometry.
Recovering marrow shows synchronous maturation with promyelocytes and myelocytes rather than a monotonous blast population of at least 20%.

3917.recognize_zh: 中央那顆胞質藍色的細胞裡，染色體排成上下兩條平行的深紫色帶狀，正往兩極分開，是典型的有絲分裂後期（anaphase）；周圍還有破碎的細胞與幾顆早期造血前驅細胞。
features: Central cell with basophilic cytoplasm containing two parallel bands of condensed chromosomes (anaphase figure)
No nuclear membrane; chromosome sets separated toward opposite poles
Adjacent smudged/disrupted cells with fibrillar cytoplasm
Background erythroid precursors and myeloid cells at the left; red cells in clumps
3917.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cell with basophilic cytoplasm in which two parallel bands of condensed chromosomes are separating toward opposite poles, consistent with a mitotic figure in anaphase. The surrounding field contains smudged cells with fibrillar cytoplasm and scattered erythroid and myeloid precursors. The mitosis appears bipolar and symmetric. Findings are consistent with a normal mitotic figure in a proliferating bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Abnormal mitoses show tripolar spindles, lagging chromosomes or asymmetric chromatin masses, whereas this figure is bipolar and symmetric.
Binucleate cells have two intact nuclei with nuclear membranes and nucleoli, not condensed chromosome bands.
Apoptotic cells show round dense nuclear fragments with shrunken cytoplasm rather than organized chromosome plates.

3789.recognize_zh: 上方淋巴球的淡藍細胞質裡有一顆獨立、圓形、紫紅色的大顆粒（giant azurophilic granule），這是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群淋巴球的典型包涵體；下方為單核球。
features: Lymphocyte (upper cell) with a small rim of pale blue cytoplasm containing a single discrete, round, deeply azurophilic granule
Granule is much larger than normal azurophilic granules of large granular lymphocytes
Lymphocyte nucleus oval with condensed, streaky chromatin
Adjacent monocyte with folded nucleus and pale grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm without abnormal granules
Background red cells overlapping in a thick area; platelets present
3789.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte and an adjacent monocyte. The lymphocyte contains a single, large, round, azurophilic cytoplasmic inclusion, distinctly larger than the fine granules of normal large granular lymphocytes. The monocyte shows unremarkable cytoplasm in this field. Findings are consistent with the giant cytoplasmic granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome; review of neutrophils for giant granules and LYST testing are supportive.

ddx.vs: LGLs contain several fine azurophilic granules, not a single giant inclusion.
Alder-Reilly granules are dense, dark, and distributed throughout leukocyte cytoplasm rather than as one or few giant granules.
May-Hegglin inclusions are pale blue spindle-shaped bodies in neutrophils with giant platelets, not round azurophilic granules in lymphocytes.
A platelet or artifact lies on a different focal plane and is not enclosed within the cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Chediak-Higashi syndrome — lymphocyte with a single giant round azurophilic cytoplasmic granule (adjacent monocyte for comparison)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指上方淋巴球裡那顆異常大的紫紅色顆粒問「這是什麼包涵體、什麼症候群」，答 Chediak-Higashi 的 giant granule；下方單核球是對照組。
遺傳：LYST 基因突變，autosomal recessive，造成溶酶體與分泌顆粒融合異常；嗜中性球的巨大顆粒為 peroxidase 陽性。
臨床四聯：部分眼皮膚白化（銀灰色頭髮）、反覆化膿性感染、出血傾向（血小板 dense granule 缺乏）、進行性周邊神經病變。
Accelerated phase 即 HLH 表現（發燒、肝脾腫大、血球低下），是主要死因；造血幹細胞移植可矯正免疫/血液異常，但無法阻止神經退化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為正常大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）或疊在細胞上的血小板；LGL 是數顆細小嗜天青顆粒，血小板與細胞質不在同一焦平面，CHS 則是單一大顆粒包在細胞質內。

quiz.q: 上方淋巴球的巨大紫紅色顆粒提示哪個基因的突變？
quiz.a: LYST（Chediak-Higashi syndrome）

3597.recognize_zh: 細胞比中性球大，細胞核深度凹折成馬蹄形（U 字形），染色質呈細緻花邊狀（lacy），細胞質是灰藍色、帶細小顆粒與少數空泡；這是典型的單核球。
features: Large cell, about 2 times RBC diameter, with moderate N:C ratio
Deeply folded, horseshoe/U-shaped nucleus
Fine, lacy (stringy) chromatin without visible nucleoli
Grey-blue (ground-glass) cytoplasm with fine azurophilic dust-like granules
Small cytoplasmic vacuoles
3597.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large mononuclear cell with a deeply folded, horseshoe-shaped nucleus and fine, lacy chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant, grey-blue, and finely granular with a few small vacuoles. Surrounding red cells show rouleaux-like overlap consistent with a thick area of the smear. Findings are consistent with a normal mature monocyte.

ddx.vs: Band neutrophils have condensed, clumped chromatin and pink cytoplasm with neutrophilic granules rather than lacy chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm.
Promonocytes have more delicate chromatin, may show nucleoli, and have gentler nuclear folding, while this cell has mature lacy chromatin and a deep fold.
Reactive lymphocytes have clearer blue cytoplasm that hugs adjacent RBCs with a darker basophilic rim and lack the ground-glass granular cytoplasm and folded lacy nucleus.
Metamyelocytes have a kidney-shaped nucleus with clumped chromatin and pink granular cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Normal mature monocyte — large cell with horseshoe-shaped folded nucleus, lacy chromatin and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這顆大細胞問「這是什麼細胞」，重點在核形（馬蹄形/腎形凹折）、花邊狀染色質、毛玻璃灰藍細胞質，而不是只看大小。
細胞化學：單核球 nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate esterase）陽性且可被 NaF 抑制；flow 表型 CD14、CD64、CD11b、CD36 陽性。
單核球增多的意義：持續單核球增多需考慮 CMML；WHO 5th 將 CMML 的前提門檻定為絕對單核球 ≥0.5×10⁹/L 且佔 WBC ≥10%。
在 AML/CMML 中 promonocyte 算作 blast equivalent，而成熟單核球與 abnormal monocyte 不算，這是計算芽細胞比例的常考點。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為帶狀核嗜中性球或 metamyelocyte；區分點是單核球細胞質灰藍毛玻璃樣、無粉紅次級顆粒，且染色質細緻花邊狀而非粗塊。

quiz.q: 圖中這顆具馬蹄形核與灰藍色細胞質的細胞是什麼？哪一種 esterase 染色會陽性且被 NaF 抑制？
quiz.a: 成熟單核球（monocyte）；nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate/acetate esterase）陽性，可被 NaF 抑制。

3661.recognize_zh: 周邊血液左上有一顆大型早期骨髓前驅細胞（前骨髓球樣，核圓、細胞質嗜鹼性帶嗜天青顆粒），另有數顆帶狀核／分葉核嗜中性球布滿粗顆粒；左移合併毒性顆粒，是 G-CSF 使用後的常見表現。
features: Large circulating early myeloid precursor (promyelocyte-like) with round eccentric nucleus, fine chromatin, and basophilic cytoplasm with azurophilic granules
Band and segmented neutrophils with coarse dark toxic-type granulation
Left-shifted granulocytes indicating accelerated marrow release
No blasts with Auer rods or dysplastic hypogranular neutrophils in this field
Red cells normocytic with a few target-like cells
3661.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large early myeloid precursor with a round, eccentric nucleus, finely granular chromatin, and basophilic cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules, resembling a promyelocyte. Band and segmented neutrophils show coarse toxic-type granulation. No Auer rods, blast excess, or dysplastic neutrophils are seen, and red cells are largely unremarkable. In a patient receiving granulocyte colony-stimulating factor, findings are consistent with G-CSF effect with left shift and toxic granulation.

ddx.vs: Accompanied by nucleated red cells and teardrop cells, which are not present here.
Shows a myelocyte bulge with basophilia and persistent leukocytosis with BCR::ABL1 rather than transient left shift.
Shows numerous abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei, heavy granules, and Auer rod bundles plus coagulopathy, not a rare promyelocyte with mature neutrophils.
Morphologically similar; distinguished by clinical history of infection versus growth factor therapy.

3725.recognize_zh: 中央有一顆淡藍灰色、細胞質豐富且含少量吞噬物的巨噬細胞（central macrophage），周圍緊密環繞一圈核圓而濃染、細胞質灰藍至粉紅的晚期紅血球母細胞，這就是紅血球島（erythroblastic island）。
features: Central macrophage with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm, an oval nucleus and a few phagocytic inclusions
Rosette of erythroid precursors tightly clustered around the macrophage
Erythroid precursors mostly polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts with round dense nuclei and clumped chromatin
Occasional earlier erythroblast with deep blue cytoplasm at the periphery of the island
Background of mature red cells and a few neutrophils; no megaloblastic or dysplastic features
3725.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an erythroblastic island consisting of a central macrophage with abundant pale cytoplasm surrounded by a rosette of maturing erythroid precursors, predominantly polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts with round, condensed nuclei. The erythroid cells show normoblastic maturation without nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, multinucleation or megaloblastic change. Erythroblastic islands are the normal microanatomic unit of erythropoiesis and are often prominent when erythropoiesis is stimulated, as in hemolytic anemia.

ddx.vs: Tumor clusters show cohesive large pleomorphic cells with nuclear molding and nucleoli, rather than uniform small round normoblasts arranged around a benign macrophage.
The macrophage has actually engulfed red cells, nucleated cells or platelets within its cytoplasm, rather than having precursors attached around its surface.
Lymphocytes have scant bluish cytoplasm and less condensed chromatin and do not surround a central macrophage in a rosette.

3469.recognize_zh: 單一形態的前骨髓細胞成片出現，細胞質充滿粗大紫紅色顆粒、蓋住核邊界，核呈折疊或雙葉狀，且缺乏後續成熟階段的細胞，較符合 APL 而非反應性骨髓的左移。
features: Monotonous sheet of large cells with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules
Granules often overlie and obscure nuclear borders
Nuclei folded, reniform, or bilobed with fine chromatin
Lack of an orderly spectrum of maturing myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and neutrophils
No distinct perinuclear Golgi hof in most cells; Auer rods not clearly seen in this field
3469.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a monotonous population of large promyelocyte-like cells with abundant cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules that obscure nuclear borders, and folded to bilobed nuclei with fine chromatin. Normal granulocytic maturation is not evident, and only rare small lymphoid or erythroid cells are present. Definite Auer rods are not identified in this field. In this look-alike comparison, the features favor acute promyelocytic leukemia over a reactive promyelocyte-rich marrow; PML::RARA testing is required.

ddx.dx: Reactive marrow with promyelocyte predominance (e.g., recovery after G-CSF or agranulocytosis)
ddx.vs: Reactive promyelocytes have round nuclei, a well-defined Golgi hof, and show synchronous maturation to later stages without Auer rods or bilobed nuclei.
AML with maturation has a distinct population of agranular blasts with maturation, rather than a sheet of hypergranular abnormal promyelocytes.
The microgranular variant shows bilobed nuclei with sparse or dust-like granules, whereas this field shows heavy coarse granulation.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia (favored over reactive marrow) — monotonous hypergranular promyelocytes with folded nuclei, no maturation
pearls_zh: 考法：look-alike 比較題，考官問這是 APL 還是反應性前骨髓細胞增生（agranulocytosis 恢復期、G-CSF 後），要說出形態依據。
反應性前骨髓細胞：核圓、Golgi hof 明顯、後續 myelocyte 到 neutrophil 各階段完整；APL：核折疊或雙葉、顆粒遮核、缺乏成熟階段。
確認：PML::RARA（FISH/RT-PCR）；PML 免疫螢光呈 microspeckled 可快速輔助。病史上的藥物、感染與 G-CSF 使用非常關鍵。
急症：懷疑 APL 即查 PT、fibrinogen、D-dimer 並立即給 ATRA；若為反應性，數天內可見同步成熟、血球回升。
exam.pitfall_zh: G-CSF 後或 agranulocytosis 恢復期骨髓以前骨髓細胞為主，易誤認為 APL；靠圓核、Golgi hof、無 Auer rods、短期內同步成熟與 PML::RARA 陰性區分。

quiz.q: 區分此片與 agranulocytosis 恢復期骨髓，最關鍵的分子檢查是什麼？
quiz.a: PML::RARA（t(15;17)）FISH 或 RT-PCR

3533.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現一個小型、核深染致密、只有少量羽毛狀細胞質的細胞，周圍附著多個血小板碎片，這是循環中的小型巨核細胞（或裸核）；在治療相關骨髓腫瘤中提示骨髓異常。
features: Small cell about the size of a lymphocyte with dense, darkly staining, coarsely clumped nucleus
Scant pale, wispy cytoplasm with attached platelet fragments budding at the periphery
Several adjacent platelet-like granular fragments clustered around the cell
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis, a few target cells, and occasional fine RBC inclusions
3533.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small cell with a dense, darkly staining nucleus and a scant rim of pale, frayed cytoplasm with attached granular platelet fragments, consistent with a circulating micromegakaryocyte or megakaryocyte nucleus shedding platelets. The red cells show mild anisocytosis with occasional target cells. Circulating megakaryocytes or their fragments are an abnormal finding in adults and, in the setting of prior cytotoxic therapy, are suggestive of a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm; bone marrow examination is recommended.

ddx.vs: Satellitism involves platelets around neutrophils rather than lymphocytes, and a lymphocyte shows a defined cytoplasmic rim without budding platelet cytoplasm.
An nRBC has a round pyknotic nucleus with a well-defined orange-pink hemoglobinized cytoplasm, not granular platelet-forming cytoplasm.
Megakaryoblasts have fine chromatin and nucleoli with blebbed agranular cytoplasm, unlike the dense chromatin of this mature small megakaryocyte.

2957.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中紅血球密布，但整個視野只有約五顆白血球，多為小型淋巴球或單核球樣細胞，幾乎看不到分葉嗜中性球，呈現嚴重嗜中性球減少的樣貌。
features: Dense monolayer of red cells with very few leukocytes across a large field
Only about five leukocytes visible, mostly small round mononuclear cells
Segmented neutrophils essentially absent (one cell possibly a monocyte or band)
Individual cell morphology not resolvable at this low magnification
2957.describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows a dense red cell monolayer with strikingly few leukocytes; only about five white cells are present, predominantly small mononuclear cells, and segmented neutrophils are essentially absent. Detailed cytology cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings suggest severe neutropenia, compatible with severe congenital neutropenia (Kostmann syndrome) in the appropriate clinical setting; an absolute neutrophil count is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Cyclic neutropenia (ELANE) shows neutropenia recurring about every 21 days, requiring serial counts rather than a single smear.
Autoimmune neutropenia is usually milder, with anti-neutrophil antibodies and normal marrow maturation to bands and segmented forms.
Shwachman-Diamond includes exocrine pancreatic insufficiency and skeletal anomalies, confirmed by SBDS testing.

2893.recognize_zh: 高倍 GMS 染色：綠色壞死背景中滿布黑灰色輪廓的圓形與卵圓形酵母型真菌，大小不一，部分有出芽，另有拉長的形態，說明乾酪樣肉芽腫是真菌感染所致。
features: Innumerable GMS-positive round to oval yeast forms with dark walls and paler centers
Variation in yeast size with occasional larger forms and narrow-based budding
Elongated/ovoid forms in parallel arrays, without clear septate hyphae
Organisms concentrated at the edge of green-counterstained necrosis
2893.describe_en: High-power GMS stain shows innumerable silver-positive fungal organisms at the margin of green-counterstained necrosis. The organisms are predominantly round to oval yeast forms with dark walls, variable size and occasional narrow-based budding, admixed with elongated ovoid forms; well-formed septate hyphae are not seen. Definitive speciation is not possible from morphology alone at this resolution. Findings are consistent with fungal infection as the cause of the necrotizing splenic granulomas; correlation with culture, mucicarmine, antigen testing or molecular identification is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are small (2–4 µm), uniform and typically intracellular within macrophages, whereas these vary in size.
Cryptococcus shows variable-size yeasts with narrow-based budding and a mucicarmine-positive capsule, which would confirm it.
Blastomyces yeasts are larger (8–15 µm) with thick double-contoured walls and broad-based budding.
Candida shows small budding yeasts together with pseudohyphae with constrictions, which the elongated forms here should be assessed for.

exam.answer_en: Necrotizing splenic granuloma due to fungal infection — GMS highlights innumerable black yeast forms with narrow-based budding at the edge of necrosis
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「這是什麼染色、黑色的是什麼」——GMS（Grocott methenamine silver）將真菌細胞壁染黑、背景綠色 counterstain；答 fungal yeast forms。
型態線索：Histoplasma 2–4 µm 小而均一、常在巨噬細胞內；Cryptococcus 大小差異大、narrow-based budding、mucicarmine 染莢膜；Blastomyces 大且 broad-based budding。
台灣臨床：HIV 或免疫低下者需考慮 Talaromyces marneffei（以 transverse septum 分裂而非出芽）與 Histoplasma；型態重疊，需培養、抗原或分子鑑定。
壞死性肉芽腫的必做組合：GMS/PAS（真菌）、AFB/Ziehl-Neelsen（mycobacteria）、組織培養；型態無法單獨定種。
脾臟肉芽腫 ddx 亦包含 sarcoidosis（non-necrotizing）、Hodgkin lymphoma 伴隨肉芽腫、CVID；有壞死時優先排除感染。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 GMS 陽性的細胞碎片、網狀纖維或 Histoplasma 誤認為 Pneumocystis 或其他酵母；應看大小是否一致、出芽方式（窄/寬基底）及有無莢膜，並以培養確認。

quiz.q: 此脾臟切片所用的特殊染色為何？黑色的圓形/卵圓形構造是什麼？
quiz.a: GMS（Grocott methenamine silver）；fungal yeast forms（真菌酵母型）

2701.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中嗜酸系細胞占多數：左上有雙葉核、橘紅顆粒的成熟嗜酸性球，中間多顆圓核或腎形核細胞的細胞質布滿粗大紫紅顆粒（嗜酸性骨髓球/後骨髓球）；嗜酸系比例明顯增加。
features: Marked increase in eosinophil-lineage cells at multiple stages of maturation
Eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with round or reniform nuclei and coarse purple-red granules
Mature eosinophil with bilobed nucleus and orange granules (upper left)
Occasional cells with dark, basophilic-appearing immature granules
Admixed small lymphocyte and erythroid precursor; no conspicuous blast excess in field
2701.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field with a striking predominance of eosinophil lineage cells, ranging from eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with round to reniform nuclei and coarse granules to a mature bilobed eosinophil. Some precursors contain darker purple immature granules. A small lymphocyte and scattered erythroid elements are present, and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with eosinophilic hyperplasia, which in the absence of a reactive cause or defining molecular/cytogenetic abnormality supports idiopathic hypereosinophilic syndrome.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase gene fusion (PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, JAK2)
ddx.vs: Indistinguishable morphologically; requires FISH/RT-PCR or karyotype to detect the rearrangement, which predicts imatinib response for PDGFRA/B.
CEL is diagnosed when clonality or increased blasts and dysplastic eosinophils are demonstrated, not by eosinophil numbers alone.
Mastocytosis shows spindle-shaped hypogranular mast cell aggregates on biopsy with CD117/CD25 coexpression, elevated tryptase and KIT D816V.

2637.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血液中絕大多數紅血球表面帶有長短不一、分布不規則的尖刺突起，許多細胞較緻密缺乏中央淡染區，符合棘狀紅血球（acanthocyte）為主的spur cell anemia。
features: Majority of red cells bear spiculated projections of variable length and irregular spacing (acanthocytes/spur cells)
Many spiculated cells are smaller and denser with reduced central pallor
Admixed cells with more regular, short crenations (echinocyte-like) and a few elongated or ovoid cells
A single mononuclear leukocyte at the lower right
Few platelets in the field
2637.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a striking predominance of spiculated red cells, many of which have a few irregularly spaced projections of unequal length and a dense appearance with diminished central pallor, consistent with acanthocytes (spur cells). Some cells show more regular, evenly spaced crenations, and scattered ovoid forms are present. A single mononuclear leukocyte is seen. Findings are consistent with spur cell anemia, most commonly associated with advanced liver disease; clinical correlation with liver function and hemolysis markers is recommended.

ddx.dx: Echinocytes (burr cells) from uremia or drying artifact
ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10-30 short, regular, evenly spaced projections with preserved central pallor, while acanthocytes have fewer irregular spicules of varying length.
These show similar acanthocytes, so distinction relies on lipid profile, fat malabsorption, neurologic findings, and absence of liver disease rather than morphology.
Post-splenectomy smears add Howell-Jolly bodies and target cells, and McLeod requires Kell antigen testing.

exam.answer_en: Spur cell anemia — predominance of acanthocytes with irregular unequal spicules and loss of central pallor, typical of advanced liver disease
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指帶不規則尖刺的紅血球，問 acanthocyte 或 echinocyte，並追問最常見的相關疾病 → 末期肝病（常為酒精性肝硬化）。
機轉：肝病造成異常脂蛋白，使紅血球膜 free cholesterol 相對增加、膜變僵硬，再經脾臟修飾與破壞而溶血。
Spur cell anemia 出現代表肝病嚴重、預後差；根本治療為肝臟移植。
其他 acanthocyte 原因：abetalipoproteinemia、neuroacanthocytosis（含 McLeod phenotype）、脾切除後。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 echinocyte（burr cell）混淆：echinocyte 刺短、數量多且規則平均分布、保留中央淡染；acanthocyte 刺少、長短不一且不規則。

quiz.q: 圖中大多數紅血球的型態名稱為何？在成人最常見的相關臨床狀況是？
quiz.a: Acanthocytes（spur cells）；末期肝病／肝硬化（spur cell anemia）

2573.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆大細胞，單一圓核、染色質細顆粒狀，胞質深藍並有多個突出小泡（blebs），右下方另有一顆類似細胞，屬未分葉的不成熟或發育不良巨核細胞，旁邊可見帶狀嗜中性球作大小比較。
features: Large cell with a single round, non-lobated nucleus and fine granular chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with multiple peripheral cytoplasmic blebs
A second similar non-lobated megakaryocytic cell at the lower right
Adjacent band neutrophil for size comparison
No nuclear lobation in either megakaryocytic cell
2573.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows two large megakaryocytic cells with single round non-lobated nuclei, finely granular chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent cytoplasmic blebs. A band neutrophil lies adjacent for scale. Clusters of such immature-appearing, non-lobated megakaryocytes raise concern for dysmegakaryopoiesis. In a hypocellular marrow with cytopenias, findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia of myelodysplastic syndrome; blast enumeration and cytogenetics are needed for classification.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts are smaller with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and nucleoli, and require CD41/CD61 flow and blast count at least 20% for AML.
Occasional promegakaryocytes occur in normal marrow, so dysplasia requires at least 10% dysplastic megakaryocytes in a well-sampled specimen.
Proerythroblasts are smaller, with deep blue cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing but lack the large megakaryocytic size and are CD71/glycophorin positive.

2445.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片大部分是中型原始細胞：胞質少、染色質細緻，許多核輪廓不規則或有凹陷，偶見淡藍胞質邊緣，只殘存少數中性球前驅細胞與有核紅血球；這種單一形態原始細胞片狀取代符合 T 淋巴母細胞白血病（需流式確認）。
features: Sheets of medium-sized blasts replacing the marrow
High N:C ratio with scant pale to moderately basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Round to irregular, occasionally indented or convoluted nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Residual myelocyte, occasional larger myeloid cells and dense erythroid precursors
2445.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows diffuse replacement by a relatively monotonous population of medium-sized blasts with scant agranular cytoplasm, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and frequently irregular or indented nuclear contours. Residual granulocytic precursors and erythroid precursors are sparse. No Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; T-lymphoblastic lineage should be confirmed by flow cytometry (cytoplasmic CD3, CD7, CD1a, TdT).

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps completely; B-lineage markers (CD19, CD79a, PAX5) rather than cytoplasmic CD3 separate them.
Myeloblasts are MPO/CD117/CD13/CD33 positive and cCD3 negative despite similar agranular appearance.
ETP-ALL looks the same but is CD1a and CD8 negative with weak CD5 and expresses stem/myeloid markers, requiring flow cytometry.

2317.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見一群細胞質深藍、含小空泡的大型母細胞，下方有一顆被粗大紫色顆粒覆蓋細胞核的嗜鹼球與一顆帶狀核中性球；母細胞加上嗜鹼球，是 CML 急性轉化的線索。
features: Cluster of large blasts with fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing small vacuoles
Granulocyte with coarse purple granules overlying the nucleus, consistent with a basophil
Band neutrophil adjacent to a blast
Blasts show high N:C ratio and molding
Background red cells with target forms and scattered small dark precipitate/inclusions
2317.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of large blasts with fine chromatin, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and deeply basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. A basophil with coarse granules obscuring the nucleus and a band neutrophil are present nearby. Background red cells include target cells, with small dark dots that likely represent stain precipitate. Findings are consistent with blast phase of CML, BCR-ABL1-positive, with persistent basophilia supporting the CML background.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm too, but are medium-sized with coarser chromatin and multiple nucleoli, express mature B markers and carry MYC rearrangement rather than BCR-ABL1.

ddx.dx: De novo AML with basophilia (e.g., t(6;9))
ddx.vs: AML with DEK::NUP214 can show basophilia but lacks BCR-ABL1 and prior chronic phase.
Accelerated phase shows basophilia with fewer blasts, rather than blasts forming the dominant population.

2061.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下以小至中型、核形不規則、帶有扭曲或裂痕（cleaved, angulated）的中心細胞為主，其間散在少數核較大、染色質空泡狀並有核仁的中心母細胞，細胞質少，這是濾泡性淋巴瘤的細胞學組成。
features: Predominance of small to medium centrocytes with irregular, angulated, twisted and cleaved nuclei
Dense to moderately clumped chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli in centrocytes
Scattered larger centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and one or more nucleoli
Scant pale cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Few interspersed eosinophilic stromal/endothelial elements; no tingible-body macrophages evident
2061.describe_en: High-power section shows a population dominated by small to medium centrocytes with angulated, cleaved nuclei and inconspicuous nucleoli. Scattered larger centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli are admixed, and tingible-body macrophages are not evident. Architecture cannot be assessed in this field. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma, likely low grade based on the proportion of centroblasts in this field, pending formal counting and immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: MCL cells are monotonous with slightly irregular nuclei and no admixed centroblasts, and are CD5 and cyclin D1 positive.
Reactive centers contain numerous tingible-body macrophages and show polarization, with BCL2-negative germinal center B cells.
NMZL cells have more abundant pale cytoplasm (monocytoid) with round to slightly indented nuclei and are CD10 negative.

1933.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中兩顆小型淋巴球，細胞核深染並有細密的溝紋與折疊，呈腦迴狀（cerebriform），胞質極少幾乎看不到，這就是小型 Sézary 細胞的樣子。
features: Two small lymphoid cells, about the size of or slightly larger than red cells
Nuclei with fine grooves and folds producing a cerebriform (convoluted) appearance
Dense, hyperchromatic chromatin without visible nucleoli
Very scant to inapparent cytoplasm, high N:C ratio
Background normochromic red cells with a few target-like cells and scattered platelets
1933.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two small lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, dense hyperchromatic chromatin, and finely grooved, convoluted cerebriform nuclear contours without visible nucleoli. Cytoplasm is scant. Red cells are largely normochromic with occasional target-like forms, and platelets are adequate. Findings are consistent with circulating small Sezary cells; confirmation requires flow cytometry (for example CD4:CD8 ratio of at least 10, loss of CD7 or CD26) and T-cell clonality in the setting of erythroderma.

ddx.dx: Reactive small lymphocytes with nuclear clefts
ddx.vs: Normal lymphocytes may show an occasional cleft, but lack multiple fine grooves across the nucleus and do not form an expanded CD4-positive, CD26-negative clonal population.
ATLL cells have deeply polylobated flower-shaped nuclei rather than finely grooved cerebriform nuclei and are associated with HTLV-1.
T-PLL cells have a visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, with TCL1 overexpression from inv(14)/t(14;14).
CLL cells have round nuclei with coarse block-like soccer-ball chromatin and are CD5/CD23-positive B cells.

exam.answer_en: Circulating small Sézary cells — small lymphoid cells with finely grooved cerebriform nuclei and scant cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：周邊血指著核有細密溝紋的小淋巴球問名稱：Sézary cell（small type，Lutzner cell）；搭配紅皮症病史問診斷 Sézary syndrome。
診斷三要素：erythroderma、全身淋巴結腫大、周邊血與皮膚有相同 T 細胞克隆；血液標準之一為 Sézary cells ≥1000/µL 或 flow 顯示 CD4:CD8 ≥10、CD4+CD7− ≥40% 或 CD4+CD26− ≥30%。
Flow 表型：CD3+、CD4+，常丟失 CD7 與 CD26，CD2/CD5 可保留；需 TCR 單株性分析證明為克隆。
Sézary syndrome 為侵襲性 CTCL；與 mycosis fungoides 同屬皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤家族，易併發 Staphylococcus 皮膚感染與敗血症。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為正常小淋巴球：正常細胞核圓、最多一道淺凹；Sézary cell 核有多道細密溝紋。良性紅皮症也可見少數腦迴狀細胞，須靠 flow 定量與克隆性。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞在 flow cytometry 上最常丟失哪兩個 T 細胞抗原？
quiz.a: CD7 與 CD26

1805.recognize_zh: 這是側位頭顱 X 光：整個顱骨穹窿散布許多小圓形透亮點，邊界尚清楚、大小不一，呈多發性小溶骨病灶的樣子；在淋巴瘤合併高血鈣的病例中，代表骨骼侵犯或骨吸收，需與骨髓瘤的打洞樣病灶和副甲狀腺機能亢進的鹽與胡椒顱骨區分。
features: Lateral skull radiograph
Numerous small, round, scattered lucencies throughout the calvarium
Lesions relatively well-defined, variable in size, without sclerotic rims
No large solitary destructive lesion or pathologic fracture evident
Dentition and skull base visualized; patient appears young
1805.describe_en: This is a lateral skull radiograph rather than a morphologic specimen. Innumerable small, round, relatively well-defined lucencies without sclerotic margins are scattered throughout the calvarium, giving a mottled appearance. No large solitary destructive lesion is evident. In a patient with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and hypercalcemia, the findings are consistent with multifocal osteolytic involvement or accelerated bone resorption; correlation with PTH, PTHrP and 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D levels and cross-sectional imaging is recommended.

ddx.vs: Classically shows larger punched-out lytic lesions of the skull, with serum/urine M-protein and clonal marrow plasma cells.
Produces a fine granular 'salt-and-pepper' skull with subperiosteal resorption of the phalanges and elevated PTH rather than discrete lytic foci.
Usually fewer, larger lytic lesions with beveled edges ('hole within a hole'), confirmed by CD1a/langerin-positive cells on biopsy.
Separated by primary tumor identification and biopsy showing non-hematolymphoid tumor cells.

60301.recognize_zh: 左下方一顆紅血球內可見單一、圓形、深紫色的點狀包涵體（Howell-Jolly body），另有少數紅血球內有小深色點；背景可見多染性紅血球（polychromasia），符合 Howell-Jolly 小體。
features: Single round, dense, dark purple inclusion within a red cell (lower left), typical of a Howell-Jolly body
Occasional additional small dark dot-like inclusions in other red cells
Scattered larger bluish-gray polychromatic red cells
Mild anisocytosis with some small dense cells lacking central pallor
Low-power field; individual inclusions are small and resolution limits detailed assessment
60301.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with mild anisocytosis, scattered polychromatophilic cells and occasional small dense cells. A red cell in the lower left contains a single round, dense, basophilic inclusion, and rare other cells contain small dark dots. The inclusion is single, round and eccentric, consistent with a nuclear remnant rather than platelet overlap. Findings are consistent with Howell-Jolly bodies, which suggest hyposplenism/asplenia or megaloblastic erythropoiesis in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are multiple, small, clustered granules at the cell periphery and stain with Prussian blue, whereas a Howell-Jolly body is usually single, larger and round.
Basophilic stippling consists of numerous fine or coarse dots evenly distributed throughout the cell, not a single dense body.
An overlying platelet is larger, granular with a pale halo and often lies in a different focal plane, unlike the dense homogeneous Howell-Jolly body.
Parasites show a chromatin dot with a blue cytoplasmic ring or tetrad forms, whereas Howell-Jolly bodies are solid round dots without cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Howell-Jolly body — single round dense dark purple inclusion (nuclear DNA remnant) within a red cell, with polychromasia
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指紅血球內單一圓形深紫點，問是什麼包涵體、成分為何、代表什麼臨床意義。
Howell-Jolly body 為核 DNA 殘餘，正常由脾臟清除；出現提示 asplenia／hyposplenism（脾切除、sickle cell disease 自體脾梗塞、celiac disease）。
也可見於 megaloblastic anemia 與 dyserythropoiesis（如 MDS），此時常合併其他紅血球系異常。
功能性無脾病人有 encapsulated bacteria（S. pneumoniae、H. influenzae、N. meningitidis）感染風險，需疫苗接種；考題常以此連結。
Feulgen 染色陽性（DNA）；Prussian blue 陰性，可與含鐵的 Pappenheimer bodies 區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Pappenheimer bodies 或血小板重疊混淆：Pappenheimer 為多顆細小聚集於周邊、鐵染色陽性；重疊血小板較大、有顆粒與淡暈，Howell-Jolly body 為單一均質深色圓點。

quiz.q: 紅血球內這個單一深紫色圓點叫什麼？最常提示病人有什麼器官功能缺失？
quiz.a: Howell-Jolly body；脾臟功能缺失（asplenia/hyposplenism）

60045.recognize_zh: 這顆嗜中性球的細胞核只分成上下兩個圓鈍的葉，中間以一條細絲相連，呈「夾鼻眼鏡」（pince-nez）樣，染色質粗而濃縮，細胞質顆粒正常，符合 Pelger-Huët 異常。
features: Mature-sized granulocyte with a bilobed nucleus: two round-oval lobes joined by a thin chromatin filament (pince-nez configuration)
Coarse, markedly condensed chromatin indicating nuclear maturity despite hypolobation
Cytoplasm pale lilac with normal fine neutrophilic granules; no hypogranulation
No vacuoles, Döhle bodies, or toxic granulation
Background red cells are normocytic and normochromic
60045.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, high power, shows a neutrophil with a symmetric bilobed nucleus composed of two round lobes connected by a thin chromatin bridge, producing a pince-nez appearance. The chromatin is coarsely clumped, indicating a mature cell, and the cytoplasm contains normal neutrophilic granulation without hypogranulation or toxic changes. The surrounding red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a Pelger-Huët cell; distinction between the inherited (LBR-related) anomaly and acquired pseudo-Pelger-Huët change requires evaluation of the proportion of affected cells, other dysplastic features, and clinical history.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët anomaly (MDS, drugs such as mycophenolate/taxanes)
ddx.vs: Acquired form affects only a subset of neutrophils and is often accompanied by hypogranulation and other dysplastic features, whereas the inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils with normal granulation.
A band has a continuous, uniformly thick curved nucleus with less condensed chromatin, not two discrete round lobes joined by a filament.
Eosinophils share a bilobed nucleus but have large refractile orange-red granules instead of fine lilac neutrophilic granules.

ddx.dx: Normal neutrophil in a left shift
ddx.vs: Left-shifted neutrophils show variable lobation with toxic granulation or Döhle bodies rather than uniform, symmetric bilobed nuclei with dense chromatin.

exam.answer_en: Pelger-Huët cell — symmetric bilobed pince-nez nucleus with coarse mature chromatin and normal granulation
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指夾鼻眼鏡形雙葉核，問名稱，接著問「怎麼分遺傳性與後天 pseudo-Pelger？」
遺傳性 Pelger-Huët anomaly：LBR（lamin B receptor）基因變異，體染色體顯性；幾乎所有嗜中性球受影響、顆粒正常、功能正常。
同型合子者嗜中性球核多呈圓形不分葉，可合併骨骼異常。
後天 pseudo-Pelger-Huët：MDS、AML、藥物（mycophenolate、taxanes、valproate 等）；通常只有部分細胞受影響，且常合併 hypogranulation 等其他 dysplasia。
臨床意義：遺傳性者可被自動或人工分類誤報為 left shift，誤以為感染；做家族成員血片可確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 band 或 bilobed eosinophil 混淆：band 為寬度一致的 C/S 形核；eosinophil 有橘紅色大顆粒。Pelger-Huët 為兩個圓鈍葉以細絲相連、染色質粗塊且顆粒為一般嗜中性顆粒。

quiz.q: 遺傳性 Pelger-Huët anomaly 由哪個基因變異造成？與後天 pseudo-Pelger 最重要的區分依據是什麼？
quiz.a: LBR；遺傳性影響幾乎所有嗜中性球且顆粒正常，後天性為部分細胞並常伴其他 dysplasia 或藥物史

141.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被取代，小淋巴球與組織球背景中散在帶有明顯嗜酸性大核仁的大型 Hodgkin 細胞；這些細胞 CD30 膜及 Golgi 陽性、CD15 部分陽性、PAX5 弱陽性（比背景 B 細胞淡）、EBER 陽性，雖有少數 CD20 強陽性，仍支持典型何杰金氏淋巴瘤（cHL）。
features: Effaced lymph node with a diffuse to vaguely nodular infiltrate on low power

Scattered large atypical cells with irregular nuclear contours, vesicular chromatin and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli (Hodgkin and Reed-Sternberg-like cells) in a background of small lymphocytes and epithelioid histiocytes
Large cells CD30 positive (membranous and Golgi-type) and CD15 positive in a subset
PAX5 weak nuclear staining in large cells, dimmer than in background small B cells; OCT2 and BOB1 weak or negative in circled large cells
CD20 negative or weak in most large cells but strongly positive in a focal subset
EBER in situ hybridization positive in the scattered large atypical cells, not in background small lymphocytes
141.describe_en: CT images show bulky conglomerate right cervical lymphadenopathy. Sections of the excised lymph node show effacement of architecture by a diffuse to vaguely nodular lymphohistiocytic infiltrate containing scattered large atypical cells with irregular nuclei and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli; sclerotic bands are not evident in these images. By immunohistochemistry the large cells are CD30 positive, partially CD15 positive, weakly PAX5 positive, and weak to negative for OCT2 and BOB1, while CD20 is negative in most large cells but strongly positive in a focal subset. EBER in situ hybridization highlights the large atypical cells. Findings are consistent with EBV-positive classical Hodgkin lymphoma with focal CD20 expression.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: EBV+ DLBCL shows sheets or numerous large cells with uniformly strong CD20, OCT2 and BOB1 and usually no CD15, whereas here the large cells are a minority with weak B-cell program and CD15 expression.
THRLBCL large cells are strongly CD20, OCT2 and BOB1 positive and CD15/CD30 negative and EBER negative.
LP cells have multilobated popcorn nuclei with small nucleoli and are CD20, OCT2, BOB1 strongly positive and CD30, CD15 and EBER negative.
ALCL shows cohesive sheets of hallmark cells with uniform strong CD30 and T-cell or cytotoxic markers, lacks PAX5 and is EBER negative.

141.stain: H&E; IHC: CD30, CD15, PAX5, CD20, OCT2, BOB1; EBER
captions: Contrast CT (coronal and axial): extensive right cervical lymphadenopathy (circled)
H&E: small lymphocytes with scattered large atypical cells (arrows, A), effaced node at low power (B), Hodgkin-like cells with prominent nucleoli (C)
CD30 and CD15 positive large cells, EBER-positive large cells, weak PAX5 in large cells
CD20 negative/weak in most large cells with focal strong expression; OCT2 and BOB1 weak to negative (circled)

exam.answer_en: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma with focal CD20 expression — HRS cells CD30+ (membrane/Golgi), CD15+, weak PAX5, OCT2/BOB1 loss, EBER+
pearls_zh: 考法：給一張 CD20 局部強陽性的 IHC，問是否推翻 cHL；答案是不會，要看整體：CD30+、CD15+、PAX5 弱、OCT2/BOB1 喪失。
PAX5 弱陽性（比背景 B 細胞淡）是 HRS 細胞的 B 細胞來源證據，也是區分 ALCL 與 cHL 的重要 marker。
部分 cHL 的 HRS 細胞可有 CD20 表現，強度與比例不一；CD45 通常陰性。EBER 陽性較常見於 mixed cellularity 亞型。
若大細胞成片且 B 細胞程式完整保留，要考慮 mediastinal gray zone lymphoma 或 EBV+ DLBCL，治療方向不同。
exam.pitfall_zh: CD20 陽性大細胞易誤判為 NLPHL 或 T-cell/histiocyte-rich LBCL；後兩者 CD20 均勻強、OCT2/BOB1 強、CD30/CD15 陰性、EBV 陰性。

quiz.q: HRS 細胞中 PAX5 的典型染色強度為何？有何診斷意義？
quiz.a: 弱陽性（比背景 B 細胞淡），支持 B 細胞來源的 cHL，並有助排除 ALCL

77.recognize_zh: 肺組織中可見以血管為中心（angiocentric）、侵犯血管壁的非典型大型淋巴細胞浸潤，伴大片壞死；EBER 原位雜交在血管周圍有大量陽性核，大 B 細胞成片分布，符合第 3 級淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫（lymphomatoid granulomatosis）。
features: Angiocentric and angioinvasive lymphoid infiltrate expanding and destroying vessel walls in lung parenchyma
Extensive geographic necrosis with viable perivascular cuffs of lymphoid cells
Numerous large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular to hyperchromatic, pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli, including bizarre forms, forming sheets
Polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes, and apoptotic debris; no well-formed granulomas
IHC shows many large membrane-positive (presumed CD20+) B cells in confluent aggregates
EBER ISH: numerous positive nuclei in large cells, concentrated around vessels
77.describe_en: Wedge biopsy of lung shows a dense lymphoid infiltrate with an angiocentric and angiodestructive pattern, vessel walls infiltrated by lymphoid cells, and extensive surrounding necrosis. The infiltrate is polymorphous, containing small lymphocytes and histiocytes admixed with numerous large atypical lymphoid cells with pleomorphic, vesicular to hyperchromatic nuclei and prominent nucleoli, which form confluent sheets in areas; well-formed granulomas are not seen. Immunohistochemistry (presumed CD20) highlights many large membrane-positive B cells, and EBER in situ hybridization shows abundant positive nuclei in large cells, most concentrated in perivascular zones. Findings are consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis, grade 3.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: EBV+ DLBCL forms nodal or extranodal sheets of large B cells without the dominant pulmonary angiocentric/angiodestructive pattern and T-cell-rich background characteristic of LYG.
ENKTL is also angiocentric, necrotic, and EBER-positive, but the EBV-positive cells are CD3ε+/CD56+/cytotoxic T/NK cells rather than CD20+ B cells.
GPA shows necrotizing granulomatous vasculitis with neutrophilic microabscesses and multinucleated giant cells, lacks atypical EBER-positive large B cells, and is ANCA (PR3) positive.
CHL has Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and CD20 negative, rather than sheets of CD20+ EBV-positive large B cells in an angiocentric distribution.

captions: High power H&E: large pleomorphic atypical lymphoid cells with a bizarre hyperchromatic cell and apoptotic debris.
Low-medium power H&E: diffuse sheet of atypical lymphoid cells with eosinophilic fibrinoid material.
H&E: lung parenchyma with a vessel wall infiltrated by lymphoid cells (angiocentric infiltrate).
H&E: viable cuff of atypical lymphoid cells around a vessel amid necrosis.
H&E: necrotic background with scattered atypical lymphoid cells and small vessels.
H&E low power: vessel with mural lymphoid infiltrate surrounded by extensive necrosis.
IHC low power (presumed CD20): patchy confluent aggregates of positive cells.
IHC medium power: clusters of large cells with membranous positivity.
IHC high power: large atypical cells with strong membranous staining.
IHC: numerous membrane-positive cells surrounding a vessel.
EBER ISH low power: positive nuclei concentrated around vessels in necrotic tissue.
EBER ISH medium power: perivascular cuff of EBER-positive nuclei.
EBER ISH high power: strong nuclear signal in many large atypical cells.

exam.answer_en: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis, grade 3 (lung) — angiocentric, angiodestructive infiltrate with necrosis and sheets of large EBER+ B cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指被淋巴細胞穿透的血管壁與周圍壞死問型態，或指 EBER 陽性大細胞問分級依據。
分級依每高倍視野 EBV+ 大 B 細胞數：grade 1 <5、grade 2 約 5–20、grade 3 >50 或成片；grade 3 臨床上按 EBV+ DLBCL 處理。
LYG 是 EBV 驅動的 B 細胞增生、背景以反應性 T 細胞為主，最常侵犯肺，其次皮膚、中樞神經、腎；與免疫缺陷相關。
治療連結：低級別常考慮 interferon-α；grade 3 用 rituximab 合併化療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 血管中心性壞死易誤認為 GPA 或 extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma：GPA 無 EBV+ 異型大 B 細胞、ANCA 陽性；ENKTL 的 EBER+ 細胞為 CD56+/cCD3ε+ 而非 CD20+。

quiz.q: LYG 的分級依據是什麼？
quiz.a: 每高倍視野 EBV（EBER）陽性大型 B 細胞的數量

13.recognize_zh: 周邊血液 CellaVision 圖庫中是一致的中小型芽細胞：高核質比、細緻染色質、核仁不明顯、胞質稀少淡藍；流式顯示 CD45 弱至陰性芽細胞表現 CD19、CD34、CD10（強）、HLA-DR，缺 CD20 與 CD13/CD117，且三天內芽細胞由 4% 升至 43%，符合 B 淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Uniform small to intermediate blasts, about 1.5-2 times a red cell diameter, with very high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine to slightly condensed chromatin and inconspicuous or small nucleoli
Scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm, some cells with a small cytoplasmic tail or bleb; occasional small punched-out vacuoles or clear dots
Flow: CD45 dim/negative blasts (about 43-44%) positive for CD19, CD34, bright CD10 and HLA-DR; negative for CD20, CD13 and CD117
Serial flow: CD10+CD34+ blast fraction rises from about 4% to 19% to 43% over 72 hours
13.describe_en: Peripheral blood digital morphology images show a monotonous population of small to intermediate blasts with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular pale blue cytoplasm; no Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are seen. Flow cytometry of the peripheral blood identifies a CD45-dim to negative blast population positive for CD19, CD34, bright CD10, CD22, HLA-DR and CD58, and negative for CD20, CD117, CD13, CD33 and surface light chains. Serial studies show the circulating blast population increasing from 4% to 19% to 43% over three days. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable, but T-ALL blasts express cytoplasmic/surface CD3 and CD7 and lack CD19 and CD22, unlike this CD19+CD22+ population.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML blasts may look similarly agranular but express CD13, CD33 or CD117 and lack the CD19/bright CD10 B-lineage profile shown here.

Hematogones show a continuous maturation spectrum from CD34+CD10+ to CD20+ with normal CD45 and CD58 levels, whereas these blasts form a discrete CD20-negative cluster with high CD58 and rapidly rising counts.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are mature CD34-, TdT-, surface light chain-restricted B cells, unlike these CD34+ light chain-negative blasts.

captions: CellaVision gallery of peripheral blood lymphoblasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm
Peripheral blood flow cytometry: CD45-dim blasts positive for CD19, bright CD10, CD34 and HLA-DR, negative for CD20, CD13 and CD117
Serial CD45/SSC and CD10/CD34 plots showing blasts rising from 4% to 19% to 43% over 72 hours

exam.answer_en: B-lymphoblastic leukemia — monotonous agranular high N:C blasts in blood; flow CD19+/CD34+/bright CD10+/CD58+, CD20-, rising from 4% to 43% in 3 days
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指 CellaVision 中高核質比、無顆粒的母細胞問系別，並問流式判讀：CD19＋CD10＋CD34＋HLA-DR、缺 MPO/CD13/CD117 → B 系淋巴母細胞。
CD58 過度表現與 CD10 亮是 B-ALL 常用的 aberrant 標記，可作為日後流式 MRD 追蹤的依據。
白血球快速上升時需預防腫瘤溶解症候群（水分、allopurinol 或 rasburicase、監測鉀磷尿酸）。
兒童 NCI 風險：年齡 1–9.99 歲且 WBC <50×10⁹/L 為標準風險；診斷時須驗 BCR::ABL1、KMT2A、ETV6::RUNX1 與倍體。
exam.pitfall_zh: CD10+/CD34+ 細胞易與 hematogones 混淆：hematogones 呈連續成熟譜（CD34→CD20）、無 CD58 過度表現且數量不會數天內暴增；Burkitt 則 CD34−、TdT−、表面輕鏈陽性。

quiz.q: 流式顯示 CD19+、CD10 亮、CD34+、HLA-DR+、CD13/CD117−，母細胞屬哪一系？
quiz.a: B 淋巴母細胞（B-ALL）

65677.recognize_zh: 密集的小淋巴球浸潤全數不染 cyclin D1（CCND1），只有散在的內皮細胞、組織球及左側非淋巴區的間質／上皮細胞核呈棕色，作為內部陽性對照；在 CLL/SLL 的背景下，這樣的陰性結果可排除被套細胞淋巴瘤（mantle cell lymphoma）。
features: Dense sheet of small, uniform lymphoid cells with round nuclei
Lymphoid cells show no nuclear cyclin D1 (CCND1) staining
Scattered positive nuclei in endothelial cells, histiocytes and stromal cells serve as internal positive control
Left edge shows a non-lymphoid tissue component with more frequent positive nuclei
Clean background without nonspecific staining
65677.describe_en: Cyclin D1 immunohistochemistry shows a dense infiltrate of small lymphoid cells that are entirely negative for nuclear cyclin D1. Scattered endothelial cells, histiocytes and stromal cells, including those in the adjacent non-lymphoid tissue, show nuclear staining and serve as an adequate internal positive control. The lack of cyclin D1 expression in the neoplastic lymphocytes argues against mantle cell lymphoma and, in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD5+, CD23+), is consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma shows diffuse strong nuclear cyclin D1 in the neoplastic small lymphocytes (or SOX11 positivity in cyclin D1-negative cases), whereas here the lymphocytes are negative.

ddx.dx: CLL/SLL with cyclin D1-positive proliferation centers
ddx.vs: CLL/SLL may show weak cyclin D1 in paraimmunoblasts within proliferation centers, but not diffuse staining of the small cells as in MCL.
Hairy cell leukemia can be weakly cyclin D1-positive but is CD5-negative, annexin A1/BRAF V600E-positive and typically involves marrow and red pulp rather than forming a nodular infiltrate like this.

exam.answer_en: Cyclin D1 IHC negative in small lymphoid infiltrate with positive internal controls — argues against mantle cell lymphoma (supports CLL/SLL)
pearls_zh: 考法：先確認內部陽性對照（內皮細胞、組織球、間質細胞核）有染色，才能判定腫瘤細胞為真陰性。
Cyclin D1 核陽性合併 t(11;14)(q13;q32) CCND1::IGH 是 mantle cell lymphoma 特徵；cyclin D1 陰性 MCL 可用 SOX11 協助。
CLL/SLL 典型表型 CD5+、CD23+、LEF1+、cyclin D1−；增生中心偶見弱 cyclin D1 表現。
Cyclin D1 陽性也見於 hairy cell leukemia（多為弱陽性）與帶 t(11;14) 的 plasma cell myeloma。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把內皮細胞與組織球的陽性核誤判為腫瘤陽性；應看小淋巴球本身的核，且 CLL 增生中心的弱染不代表 MCL。

quiz.q: 此染色中腫瘤性小淋巴球的 cyclin D1 結果為何？哪些細胞作為內部對照？
quiz.a: 陰性；內皮細胞、組織球與間質細胞

62605.recognize_zh: 低倍下腸壁由上而下可見完整的黏膜隱窩、黏膜下層及粉紅色的肌層，但肌層以下（及肌層束之間）被密集、藍紫色的片狀細胞浸潤取代並向外擴張，黏膜本身相對保留，呈腸壁深層的破壞性腫塊，是移植後漿細胞瘤樣 PTLD 腫塊的低倍樣貌。
features: Intestinal wall with preserved mucosa (regular crypts) and submucosa at top
Dense, diffuse cellular infiltrate replacing and expanding the muscularis propria/subserosa in the lower half
Infiltrating cells dissect between muscle bundles with a destructive, sheet-like growth pattern
Scattered hemorrhage within the infiltrate; separate strip of lymphoid tissue in submucosa
Cytologic detail (plasmacytoid features) not assessable at this low magnification
62605.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of bowel wall shows preserved mucosa with regularly spaced crypts and an unremarkable submucosa. The muscularis propria and deeper wall are infiltrated and expanded by a dense, diffuse, sheet-like cellular proliferation that dissects between muscle bundles, with focal hemorrhage. Cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification. In a transplant recipient, with high-power plasmacytoid morphology, light-chain restriction and EBER positivity, the findings are consistent with a mass-forming plasmacytoma-like post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, EBV-positive.

ddx.vs: At low power both form destructive masses; high-power large centroblastic/immunoblastic cells with CD20/PAX5 favor DLBCL over mature plasma cells with CD138 and loss of CD20.

ddx.dx: Extramedullary spread of plasma cell myeloma
ddx.vs: Myeloma involvement is EBV-negative and associated with marrow disease and serum M-protein, whereas PTLD is EBV-positive in the post-transplant setting.

ddx.dx: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor or other mesenchymal neoplasm
ddx.vs: GIST is composed of spindle or epithelioid cells expressing CD117/DOG1 rather than discohesive hematolymphoid cells expressing CD45/CD138.
Carcinoma usually arises from mucosa with cohesive cytokeratin-positive nests, whereas here the mucosa is intact and the infiltrate is deep.

1421.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間完全被密集、深染的小至中型圓形細胞瀰漫取代，脂肪與正常造血成分消失，並有細胞拉扯呈流線狀的擠壓假影；形態只能判斷為淋巴芽細胞樣浸潤，T 系需靠免疫染色確認。
features: Packed marrow with complete replacement of intertrabecular spaces by a diffuse infiltrate
Monotonous small to medium cells with dark, high N:C ratio nuclei
Streaming or crush artifact producing elongated, linear arrangements of nuclei
Absence of fat and of recognizable normal trilineage hematopoiesis
Intact bony trabeculae without visible destruction at this power
1421.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a hypercellular, packed marrow in which the intertrabecular spaces are diffusely replaced by a monotonous infiltrate of small to medium hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. The cells show prominent streaming, likely related to crush artifact, and residual fat and normal hematopoietic elements are not identified. Cytologic detail and lineage cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the appropriate immunophenotypic context (TdT, CD34, cytoplasmic CD3 positive), findings are consistent with involvement by T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable; B-ALL is CD19, CD79a, and PAX5 positive, whereas T-ALL expresses cytoplasmic CD3.
Myeloblasts usually have more cytoplasm, may show granules or Auer rods, and are MPO positive on aspirate or immunostain.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma, Ewing sarcoma)
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumors often form clusters or rosettes with desmoplasia and are negative for TdT and CD45 while expressing tumor-specific markers.
